dossier.claim: Several explanations preserve technical nouns while changing the relationships that make them intelligible: what receives magical energy, how Projection uses a supporting object, which event a date modifies, and which magical status or circuit arrangement is described.
dossier.sourcePattern: The Japanese specifies relationships through particles, modifiers and repeated terms. Rin distinguishes energy passed into objects from energy used to initiate effects on nature; Illya distinguishes a supporting object from Projection layered onto it. Other passages distinguish two reported deficiencies, date the leakage of implanted material, describe a creation perfected as a circuit, and identify the recipient in an adoption argument. The crest lesson and the mage/practitioner comparisons similarly depend on the relation between concepts rather than the technical nouns alone.
dossier.englishEffect: The English sometimes preserves those nouns while changing their connections. Objects become the practitioner, a supporting object becomes a Projection, and a creation functioning as a circuit becomes an inheritor of circuits. Coordination becomes immediate causation in Shirou's account of Saber, and a leakage date becomes an implantation date in Kotomine's explanation. Zouken's adoption argument reverses direction and changes who lacks circuits. Elsewhere, learning about crests becomes already knowing them, Caster's comparison of mages becomes a comparison of Masters, and Sakura's warning about accidental exposure introduces an impulse by Rider.
dossier.limits: These findings concern the selected local statements and does not establish their speakers' ultimate factual reliability, a different implantation date, or broader character motives. Rider's next lines retain her lack of control, and Kiritsugu's later speech explicitly preserves the practitioner/mage distinction. Genuine counterexamples also preserve soul-and-emotion conversion, specialist difficulty in freezing formed magecraft, and the qualified possibility of stereotypical magical feats. The evidence supports specific repairs to relations and terminology, not a general claim that technical explanation or the Magic/magecraft distinction has collapsed.
dossier.diagnostic: 571 findings in this category; 10 cited passages.

findings.description: The English turns a contrast between formless tactics and Kuzuki's recognizable method into secrecy, then replaces first-encounter lethality with a statement that the first strike must kill.
findings.sourceReading: The first anchor identifies absence of fixed form as tactical mastery. The second attributes lethality to first exposure, before the opponent understands Kuzuki's unusual form.
findings.explanation: The English turns a contrast between formless tactics and Kuzuki's recognizable method into secrecy, then replaces first-encounter lethality with a statement that the first strike must kill.

contexts.japanese: 戦法とは形がない事を極意とする
contexts.english: Tactics are supposed to be unknown to an opponent.

contexts.japanese: 初見、故に必殺
contexts.english: The first strike must be fatal.

findings.description: The married-couple sword image becomes twin swords.
findings.sourceReading: 夫婦, read めおと, frames the pair as husband and wife, not merely two similar weapons.
findings.explanation: The married-couple sword image becomes twin swords.

contexts.japanese: 白と黒の夫婦剣
contexts.english: The black and white twin swords.

findings.description: Saber closing five ken of distance becomes Caster reciting five verses.
findings.sourceReading: 詰めるは五間 gives the distance to close; the next sentence restates Saber covering ten meters while Caster casts faster.
findings.explanation: Saber closing five ken of distance becomes Caster reciting five verses.

contexts.japanese: 詰めるは五間
contexts.english: She recites five verses.

findings.description: An exclamation about excessive force becomes a usual technical limit on converting curses.
findings.sourceReading: 実力行使にも程がある is the reaction that even using force has its limits: she has overdone turning a leisurely curse into an immediate attack.
findings.explanation: An exclamation about excessive force becomes a usual technical limit on converting curses.

contexts.japanese: 実力行使にも程がある
contexts.english: There's usually a limit to how much force one can use to turn a slow curse into an immediate curse.

findings.description: Command Spells not being an item to hand over becomes something he cannot afford to give.
findings.sourceReading: 令呪は差し出せる物じゃない objects to their being a handable thing, before the separate more important reason of betraying Saber.
findings.explanation: Command Spells not being an item to hand over becomes something he cannot afford to give.

contexts.japanese: 令呪は差し出せる物じゃない
contexts.english: Those aren't something I can afford to give

findings.description: Shirou’s present regret about revealing weaknesses becomes simply getting the point.
findings.sourceReading: 今すっごく後悔してる explicitly admits regret after Rin’s ominous response.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s present regret about revealing weaknesses becomes simply getting the point.

contexts.japanese: 今すっごく後悔してる
contexts.english: look, I get it.

findings.description: Excessive ease of gathering becomes excessive quantity collected.
findings.sourceReading: 集まり易すぎる describes being too easy to gather/accumulate, leaving the phenomenon’s exact meaning unspoken.
findings.explanation: Excessive ease of gathering becomes excessive quantity collected.

contexts.japanese: 集まり易すぎる
contexts.english: collecting way too much

contexts.japanese: 集まり易すぎる
contexts.english: Collecting way too much

findings.description: One of two alternative activation conditions disappears.
findings.sourceReading: 破ったり破るヤツに出会ったら includes breaking Caster’s rules oneself or encountering someone who breaks them.
findings.explanation: One of two alternative activation conditions disappears.

contexts.japanese: 三か条”を破ったり破るヤツに出会ったら
contexts.english: If they come across someone who breaks her three rules

findings.description: A conditional town-wide-control deduction becomes an asserted capability.
findings.sourceReading: The narrator reasons if she can accomplish this remote control, would it not mean she can manipulate the town from here?
findings.explanation: A conditional town-wide-control deduction becomes an asserted capability.

contexts.japanese: という事ではないのか
contexts.english: But Caster can manipulate anybody in town without moving from here

contexts.japanese: 成し得るというのなら
contexts.english: She can control my body from more than a few kilometers away

findings.description: The rapid sigil work gains an all-erased scope.
findings.sourceReading: The first line says most active marks have been erased; the following surprise concerns how quickly marks in the school could be erased, without all.
findings.explanation: The rapid sigil work gains an all-erased scope.

contexts.japanese: 校舎内の呪刻を消せる
contexts.english: erase all the sigils at school

findings.description: Recognition as a mage becomes approval of the person.
findings.sourceReading: 魔術師って認めない gives the threshold for classifying/acknowledging someone as a mage, explaining why his weak energy was not identified that way.
findings.explanation: Recognition as a mage becomes approval of the person.

contexts.japanese: 魔術師って認めない
contexts.english: Mages only approve of others

findings.description: Rare tools become doubting that such a tool exists.
findings.sourceReading: 少ないでしょう gives rarity as the reason she thinks there probably is no Master using one.
findings.explanation: Rare tools become doubting that such a tool exists.

contexts.japanese: 道具なんて少ないでしょう
contexts.english: I doubt there's such a convenient tool

findings.description: Townwide planted eyes disappear from the surveillance deduction.
findings.sourceReading: Archer describes observing the war through eyes laid throughout town, not simply watching from a distance.
findings.explanation: Townwide planted eyes disappear from the surveillance deduction.

contexts.japanese: 町中に張った“眼”で戦況を把握する
contexts.english: watch the war's movements from afar.

findings.description: Ten or more words become ten or more lines.
findings.sourceReading: 十以上の単語 specifies the word count of the incantation, with ten-count ruby layered over instant contract.
findings.explanation: Ten or more words become ten or more lines.

contexts.japanese: 十以上の単語を含んだ魔術詠唱
contexts.english: an incantation of at least ten lines.

findings.description: Caster’s faction becomes her territory.
findings.sourceReading: 陣営 is her side/camp, lacking combat strength and failing to equal Berserker even if she expands her forces/influence.
findings.explanation: Caster’s faction becomes her territory.

contexts.japanese: 君の陣営はいささか戦力不足だ
contexts.english: your territory is too weak.

findings.description: Prior protective cleanliness becomes impurity in place of the field.
findings.sourceReading: 結界に守られていた分 explains why even a small contamination now makes the air feel heavy: it had been protected by the field.
findings.explanation: Prior protective cleanliness becomes impurity in place of the field.

contexts.japanese: 結界に守られていた分
contexts.english: a small amount of impurity in place of the Bounded Field.

findings.description: Caster's appraisal of Rin's magecraft becomes an appraisal of her ability as a Master, blurring the technical comparison that explains Caster's preference for Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Caster acknowledges Rin's proficiency as a mage, places it below her own, and contrasts it with Shirou's immature but distinctive and exploitable ability.
findings.explanation: Caster's appraisal of Rin's magecraft becomes an appraisal of her ability as a Master, blurring the technical comparison that explains Caster's preference for Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 魔術師としては優秀
contexts.english: skilled as a Master

findings.description: The Grail War not lasting becomes the Grail not lasting.
findings.sourceReading: 聖杯戦争 says the conflict will not continue much longer, before the promise to defeat Caster quickly.
findings.explanation: The Grail War not lasting becomes the Grail not lasting.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯戦争も長くは続かない
contexts.english: the Holy Grail won't last much longer.

findings.description: No slightest flaw becomes no minute to waste.
findings.sourceReading: 一分の隙も許されない means not even a tiny defect/gap is allowed in the flawless internal image.
findings.explanation: No slightest flaw becomes no minute to waste.

contexts.japanese: 一分の隙も許されない
contexts.english: doesn't even allow a minute to waste

findings.description: A rebounding curse becomes restoration of a true self.
findings.sourceReading: 自己に返る means the curse returns to the person, causing self-destruction through desire.
findings.explanation: A rebounding curse becomes restoration of a true self.

contexts.japanese: 自己に返る呪い
contexts.english: return to their true selves

findings.description: Spirit form becomes Heroic Spirit identity.
findings.sourceReading: 霊体 contrasts with physical embodiment, not the formal classification 英霊.
findings.explanation: Spirit form becomes Heroic Spirit identity.

contexts.japanese: 霊体としてではなく実体として
contexts.english: physical entity instead of a Heroic Spirit

findings.description: A legitimate mage becomes a legitimate Master.
findings.sourceReading: 正規の魔術師 distinguishes his mage status from Kuzuki’s non-mage status.
findings.explanation: A legitimate mage becomes a legitimate Master.

contexts.japanese: 正規の魔術師
contexts.english: a legitimate Master

findings.description: Being commanded becomes being summoned.
findings.sourceReading: 使役 concerns serving/being controlled by righteous people.
findings.explanation: Being commanded becomes being summoned.

contexts.japanese: 正しい人間にしか使役できない
contexts.english: only be summoned by righteous people

findings.description: A family creation perfected as a Magic Circuit becomes someone who inherited circuits perfected over generations. The English adds an inheritance mechanism and changes what was perfected.
findings.sourceReading: The family's creation has been perfected as a Magic Circuit; it is this creation that they believe can accomplish their aim.
findings.explanation: A family creation perfected as a Magic Circuit becomes someone who inherited circuits perfected over generations. The English adds an inheritance mechanism and changes what was perfected.

contexts.japanese: 魔術回路として完成された一族の作品
contexts.english: who had inherited Magic Circuits perfected over generations

findings.description: The Holy Grail War becomes the Holy Grail starting.
findings.sourceReading: Two months precede the war’s start.
findings.explanation: The Holy Grail War becomes the Holy Grail starting.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯戦争が開始される二月前
contexts.english: Two months before the Holy Grail started.

findings.description: The fifth Grail War becomes the fifth Grail.
findings.sourceReading: The fifth instance is the war, separate from its summoning sites.
findings.explanation: The fifth Grail War becomes the fifth Grail.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯戦争は今回で五回目
contexts.english: This is the fifth Holy Grail

findings.description: An inferior copy becomes an equal shadow.
findings.sourceReading: 真物より落ちる explicitly qualifies the otherwise identical image as inferior to the original.
findings.explanation: An inferior copy becomes an equal shadow.

contexts.japanese: 其は真物より落ちる同一の影
contexts.english: It is an equal shadow cast by the true object.

findings.description: Possessed experience becomes being depended on.
findings.sourceReading: 憑依された経験 is experience residing in/possessing the projected object.
findings.explanation: Possessed experience becomes being depended on.

contexts.japanese: 憑依された経験
contexts.english: the experience of being depended on

findings.description: Two remaining sword creations become two possessed swords.
findings.sourceReading: 残る剣製 counts how many more swords he can make.
findings.explanation: Two remaining sword creations become two possessed swords.

contexts.japanese: 残る剣製は二本だけ
contexts.english: I only have two swords left.

findings.description: A unique self-suggestion formula becomes repeated self-persuasion.
findings.sourceReading: 自己暗示 is the personal magical formula that should have no identical counterpart, uttered word-for-word by Archer.
findings.explanation: A unique self-suggestion formula becomes repeated self-persuasion.

contexts.japanese: 同じモノなどない筈の自己暗示
contexts.english: I keep telling myself it's not possible for him to whisper those words

findings.description: Self-destruction becomes probable nonsurvival.
findings.sourceReading: Archer states that projecting the sacred sword would destroy him.
findings.explanation: Self-destruction becomes probable nonsurvival.

contexts.japanese: 聖剣など投影しては自滅する
contexts.english: I probably won't survive after Projecting a sacred sword.

findings.description: The analyzed volley loses its eighteen-sword count.
findings.sourceReading: 十八 specifies the set he analyzes.
findings.explanation: The analyzed volley loses its eighteen-sword count.

contexts.japanese: 飛び交う十八の剣
contexts.english: the flurry of swords

findings.description: Master status becomes a numerical two-Master threshold for bypassing the boundary.
findings.sourceReading: Rin and Shirou, the two people who are Masters, are unaffected by the temple's barrier.
findings.explanation: Master status becomes a numerical two-Master threshold for bypassing the boundary.

contexts.japanese: マスターである二人なら、柳洞寺の結界も意味はない
contexts.english: Ryudou Temple's Bounded Field means little if there are two Masters.

findings.description: Absence of an original weapon becomes absence of any weapon with an origin.
findings.sourceReading: If a Heroic Spirit owns no Noble Phantasm, no weapon serving as its prototype/original exists for Gilgamesh to possess.
findings.explanation: Absence of an original weapon becomes absence of any weapon with an origin.

contexts.japanese: 自分の宝具を持たない英霊なら、原典になる武器さえ存在しない
contexts.english: if a Heroic Spirit doesn't possess a Noble Phantasm, it means they don't have a weapon that originated from somewhere.

findings.description: Shirou's Projection showing its limitations becomes Gilgamesh noticing it.
findings.sourceReading: ボロが出る says even one projected Archer sword exposes Shirou's inadequacy or strain.
findings.explanation: Shirou's Projection showing its limitations becomes Gilgamesh noticing it.

contexts.japanese: アーチャーの剣を一本投影するだけでボロが出るんだぞ
contexts.english: He can tell that as soon as I Project one of Archer's swords.

findings.description: Lacking stored gems becomes lacking knowledge of storing mana in gems.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says he has no jewels already charged with mana as Rin does.
findings.explanation: Lacking stored gems becomes lacking knowledge of storing mana in gems.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂みたいに宝石に魔力を溜めている訳でもないし
contexts.english: I don't know how to store my magical energy into gems like you.

findings.description: Shirou's doubt that he can use the gems becomes doubt that Rin will agree.
findings.sourceReading: He cannot imagine someone without magical aptitude like him handling them.
findings.explanation: Shirou's doubt that he can use the gems becomes doubt that Rin will agree.

contexts.japanese: 元から魔術の素養がない俺がそれをなんとかできるとは、やっぱり思えない
contexts.english: I don't think she'll agree to that seeing that I don't have any training in magecraft to be able to utilize those gems.

findings.description: Rin's mana plus all Shirou's circuits becomes all of both people's circuits.
findings.sourceReading: The Reality Marble requires Rin's magical energy and Shirou's complete circuit set.
findings.explanation: Rin's mana plus all Shirou's circuits becomes all of both people's circuits.

contexts.japanese: 私の魔力と士郎の全魔術回路を使って初めて
contexts.english: when we fully exert all of our Magic Circuits.

findings.description: Ritual safety becomes Rin's peace of mind.
findings.sourceReading: A familiar contract is formalized enough to ensure safety.
findings.explanation: Ritual safety becomes Rin's peace of mind.

contexts.japanese: 使い魔の契約ほど形式化していれば安全性は確保できる
contexts.english: My mind would be more at ease if this was standardized like the ritual we perform to form contracts with our familiars.

findings.description: The crest's analogy to flesh is narrowed to muscle.
findings.sourceReading: Circuits are blood and bone; the Magic Crest is flesh.
findings.explanation: The crest's analogy to flesh is narrowed to muscle.

contexts.japanese: 魔術刻印は肉と言えるものだ
contexts.english: the crest is their muscle.

findings.description: Magecraft shaped by successive heads becomes work of this generation's head.
findings.sourceReading: Rin uses magecraft that heads throughout the lineage gave form in the inherited crest.
findings.explanation: Magecraft shaped by successive heads becomes work of this generation's head.

contexts.japanese: 歴代の当主が“形”にした魔術を行使できる
contexts.english: magecraft that this generation's family head created.

findings.description: Rin's glowing crest-bearing arm becomes Shirou's arm already receiving mana.
findings.sourceReading: Rin extends her bare left arm; its upper-arm pattern appears as it gains energy.
findings.explanation: Rin's glowing crest-bearing arm becomes Shirou's arm already receiving mana.

contexts.japanese: 腕は剥き出しで、二の腕の模様が魔力を得てうっすらと浮かび上がっていた
contexts.english: As I began receiving magical energy, the pattern on the upper area of my exposed arm faintly started to shine.

findings.description: Being repelled by shared sensation becomes being pulled about by it.
findings.sourceReading: Without focus the synchronized sensation may reject or throw him out.
findings.explanation: Being repelled by shared sensation becomes being pulled about by it.

contexts.japanese: 集中しないと共有感覚に弾かれる
contexts.english: If you don't focus you will be pulled about by our shared senses

findings.description: A world oriented around a visitor's intention becomes a welcoming place.
findings.sourceReading: The completed world has no will; it treats the visitor's intention as operative input.
findings.explanation: A world oriented around a visitor's intention becomes a welcoming place.

contexts.japanese: ここは訪れた者を意図とするもの
contexts.english: This place welcomes visitors.

findings.description: A thrush comparison becomes a bulbul.
findings.sourceReading: トラツグミ names the bird in the invasive-process simile.
findings.explanation: A thrush comparison becomes a bulbul.

contexts.japanese: 悪質なトラツグミに似ている
contexts.english: It is like a malicious bulbul.

findings.description: Little expected bodily effect becomes no effect.
findings.sourceReading: Because the graft is only a mana path, Rin expects it should not affect the body very much.
findings.explanation: Little expected bodily effect becomes no effect.

contexts.japanese: 人体にもそう影響はない筈だし
contexts.english: it shouldn't have any effect on the human body.

findings.description: Rin's reserve of physical grit becomes latent energy after her mana is exhausted.
findings.sourceReading: 底力 is last-ditch inner strength that surprises even her as she runs soaking wet.
findings.explanation: Rin's reserve of physical grit becomes latent energy after her mana is exhausted.

contexts.japanese: 自分でも呆れるぐらいの底力で
contexts.english: with latent energy that shocks even her.

findings.description: Calling the matching weapon to hand becomes reeling in one already at hand.
findings.sourceReading: The moment Shirou sees a Noble Phantasm, he draws/calls the same thing into his grasp.
findings.explanation: Calling the matching weapon to hand becomes reeling in one already at hand.

contexts.japanese: 手元に同じモノをたぐり寄せ
contexts.english: I reel in the same one that I have at hand

findings.description: Projection as Shirou's only fighting power becomes merely his primary weapon.
findings.sourceReading: ただ一つ explicitly says Projection is his sole combat asset at this point.
findings.explanation: Projection as Shirou's only fighting power becomes merely his primary weapon.

contexts.japanese: 投影は、自分にとってただ一つの戦力になっている
contexts.english: Projection has become my primary weapon.

findings.description: A Noble Phantasm powerful enough to stop the legendary spear becomes one that is not superficial.
findings.sourceReading: If the spear follows its legend, no half-measure or ordinary Noble Phantasm will suffice to block it.
findings.explanation: A Noble Phantasm powerful enough to stop the legendary spear becomes one that is not superficial.

contexts.japanese: 防ぐ宝具は生半可な物では済まされまい
contexts.english: the Noble Phantasm that blocks it cannot be superficial.

findings.description: The thrown Gáe Bolg is twice changed into a thrust.
findings.sourceReading: After explicitly saying Lancer will not thrust, the narration describes the spear's property when released or thrown and the legend of its scattering arrowheads when cast at an enemy.
findings.explanation: The thrown Gáe Bolg is twice changed into a thrust.

contexts.japanese: 大きく振りかぶった腕には“放てば必ず心臓を貫く”魔槍。
contexts.english: He holds up the magical spear that "always pierces the heart once it is thrust."

contexts.japanese: その槍は、敵に放てば無数の鏃をまき散らしたという。
contexts.english: That spear scatters numerous arrowheads once it is thrust into the enemy.

findings.description: The spear's impossibility of both evasion and defense becomes two statements about evasion.
findings.sourceReading: Gáe Bolg cannot be evaded and cannot be blocked; the absolute claim sets up the dramatic contradiction of Rho Aias stopping it.
findings.explanation: The spear's impossibility of both evasion and defense becomes two statements about evasion.

contexts.japanese: 躱す事も出来ず、防ぐ事も出来ない。
contexts.english: It cannot be avoided nor dodged.

findings.description: A legendary claim about the seventh petal becomes direct fact.
findings.sourceReading: The spear reaches the seventh petal, which is said never to have been pierced, and still does not slow.
findings.explanation: A legendary claim about the seventh petal becomes direct fact.

contexts.japanese: 決して貫けなかったと言われる七枚目
contexts.english: the seventh petal that has never been pierced through

findings.description: Rin's left-hand Magic Crest is omitted from the reason her abbreviated casting cannot compete.
findings.sourceReading: With no time for leisurely incantation, even the simplified casting through the Magic Crest on her left hand cannot match Caster.
findings.explanation: Rin's left-hand Magic Crest is omitted from the reason her abbreviated casting cannot compete.

contexts.japanese: 左手の魔術刻印による簡易詠唱ではキャスターの魔術に太刀打ちできない。
contexts.english: she cannot match Caster's magecraft with simple spells.

findings.description: A body made of swords becomes the bone of one sword.
findings.sourceReading: The verse states in the present that his body is made of swords.
findings.explanation: A body made of swords becomes the bone of one sword.

contexts.japanese: 体は剣で出来ている。
contexts.english: I am the bone of my sword.

findings.description: Iron blood and a glass heart become a steel body and fiery blood.
findings.sourceReading: The parallel attributes are blood like iron and a heart like glass.
findings.explanation: Iron blood and a glass heart become a steel body and fiery blood.

contexts.japanese: 血潮は鉄で　心は硝子。
contexts.english: Steel is my body, and fire is my blood.

findings.description: Applied anti-magecraft becomes an inherent resistance of the restraints.
findings.sourceReading: Anti-magecraft has been placed on the handcuffs and ankle shackles, disrupting Rin’s circuits and preventing magical-energy generation.
findings.explanation: Applied anti-magecraft becomes an inherent resistance of the restraints.

contexts.japanese: 手錠や足枷は抗魔術がかけられていて
contexts.english: my handcuffs and shackles are magecraft-resistant

findings.description: Shirou’s exhausted Magic Circuits become one exhausted circuit.
findings.sourceReading: His bodily sensations and headache recover, but the Magic Circuits he overused remain depleted without having burned out.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s exhausted Magic Circuits become one exhausted circuit.

contexts.japanese: あれだけ酷使した魔術回路はさすがに消耗したままだが
contexts.english: The Magic Circuit that I overused is still exhausted

findings.description: Knowledge recorded in the original heroic-spirit source becomes knowledge stored in Archer’s body.
findings.sourceReading: The event is registered only as knowledge in the underlying original; the summoned instance does not bodily retain it.
findings.explanation: Knowledge recorded in the original heroic-spirit source becomes knowledge stored in Archer’s body.

contexts.japanese: 知識として大本に記録されるだけだ。
contexts.english: It only stays in his body as knowledge.

findings.description: The general posthumous fate of Guardians becomes Archer's personal agreement to surrender his soul to them and leave the time axis.
findings.sourceReading: Anything that entrusts its posthumous existence as a Guardian is removed from the frame of reincarnation and becomes equivalent to nothing.
findings.explanation: The general posthumous fate of Guardians becomes Archer's personal agreement to surrender his soul to them and leave the time axis.

contexts.japanese: 死後、己が存在を守護者に預けたモノは輪廻の枠から外れ、無と同意になるのだと
contexts.english: I agreed to a fate of nothingness, to give up my soul to the Guardians and be removed from the time axis.

findings.description: Projection completion and Trace Off become Projection commencement and Trace On.
findings.sourceReading: After assembling all eight stages, Shirou says 'Projection, complete'; the ruby marks Trace Off.
findings.explanation: Projection completion and Trace Off become Projection commencement and Trace On.

contexts.japanese: 投影、完了
contexts.english: Trace, on. (Begin Projection.)

findings.description: A projected Kanshou distorting from one hit becomes Shirou creating it and barely deflecting the hit.
findings.sourceReading: The Kanshou made with all his remaining strength is already present; a single blow warps it.
findings.explanation: A projected Kanshou distorting from one hit becomes Shirou creating it and barely deflecting the hit.

contexts.japanese: 残った全精力で作り上げた干将も、わずか一撃で歪曲した。
contexts.english: I scrounge up every bit of mental focus I have left to create a Kanshou, and just barely deflect another slash.

findings.description: Kanshou bending and fading becomes Kanshou breaking while Shirou's life fades.
findings.sourceReading: The distorted Kanshou bends and its own existence grows thin; Shirou then feels pain in his chest from Archer's words.
findings.explanation: Kanshou bending and fading becomes Kanshou breaking while Shirou's life fades.

contexts.japanese: その干将も歪に折れ曲がり、存在そのものが薄れかかっている。
contexts.english: Kanshou breaks, and my life begins to peter out.

findings.description: The English incantation and Japanese gloss trade places at Shirou's recovery beat.
findings.sourceReading: The source foregrounds the English 'I am the bone of my sword' as the uttered spell.
findings.explanation: The English incantation and Japanese gloss trade places at Shirou's recovery beat.

contexts.japanese: I am the bone of my sword.
contexts.english: My body is made of swords. (I am the bone of my sword.)

findings.description: Rin firing raw stored jewel energy becomes charging the jewel with as much energy as possible.
findings.sourceReading: She simply slams out the unprocessed destructive impact of the magical energy already stored in a jewel.
findings.explanation: Rin firing raw stored jewel energy becomes charging the jewel with as much energy as possible.

contexts.japanese: 宝石に籠めた魔力を叩き込むだけ
contexts.english: Tohsaka charges a jewel with as much energy as she can

findings.description: An ability possessed by few Masters becomes an ability possessed by none. This makes dependence on the Grail categorical where Gilgamesh's explanation allows exceptional Masters.
findings.sourceReading: Few Masters can sustain a Servant without Grail assistance; Gilgamesh's own anchor lacked the necessary energy.
findings.explanation: An ability possessed by few Masters becomes an ability possessed by none. This makes dependence on the Grail categorical where Gilgamesh's explanation allows exceptional Masters.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯の助力なしでサーヴァントを維持できるマスターなどそうはいない
contexts.english: no Master could sustain a Servant without the support of the Holy Grail.

findings.description: A deficient Master taking energy from others becomes Gilgamesh taking it himself.
findings.sourceReading: Gilgamesh agrees that when his anchor cannot supply its own deficit, taking from other people is the natural solution; he then reveals he did not actually need that trouble after incarnation.
findings.explanation: A deficient Master taking energy from others becomes Gilgamesh taking it himself.

contexts.japanese: 自己で補えなければ他人から奪うのは当然だろう。
contexts.english: If he can't supply me with energy, then I take it from others

findings.description: Souls that could be called guardians become souls formally known as Guardians.
findings.sourceReading: Gilgamesh says the strongest souls of the primate order—things one might even call guardians—were sought as sacrifice.
findings.explanation: Souls that could be called guardians become souls formally known as Guardians.

contexts.japanese: 守護者とも言える、“霊長最強の魂”
contexts.english: the most powerful souls of the prime species, also known as Guardians.

findings.description: The Grail producing a weapon from Servants becomes the Grail summoning Servants.
findings.sourceReading: Saber asks whether the thing the Grail produces by means of Servants is a weapon.
findings.explanation: The Grail producing a weapon from Servants becomes the Grail summoning Servants.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯が、サーヴァントをもって生み出すモノが兵器だというのか
contexts.english: Do you say that because it can summon Servants

findings.description: A Master serving as the Grail's host becomes a Master serving as the Holy Grail itself.
findings.sourceReading: Gilgamesh says another Master who can become the anchoring host is right here, identifying Shinji as the body to connect with the child's heart.
findings.explanation: A Master serving as the Grail's host becomes a Master serving as the Holy Grail itself.

contexts.japanese: 依り代になるマスターなら、ここにもう一人いるじゃないか
contexts.english: another Master that can serve as a Holy Grail

findings.description: Rin managing the two-way magical-energy allocation becomes the allocation working itself out.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says she can manage because Shirou's share is small relative to Saber's, though reckless output remains impossible.
findings.explanation: Rin managing the two-way magical-energy allocation becomes the allocation working itself out.

contexts.japanese: 士郎に分ける魔力は小さいからなんとかやっていけるわ。
contexts.english: I'm not giving you much power compared to Saber, so it'll work itself out.

findings.description: A later Grail-destroying use made at the risk of disappearance becomes a sword use after which Saber will disappear.
findings.sourceReading: If Saber spends her one safe use on Gilgamesh, destroying the Grail will require another use undertaken with disappearance accepted as the cost.
findings.explanation: A later Grail-destroying use made at the risk of disappearance becomes a sword use after which Saber will disappear.

contexts.japanese: 消滅する事を覚悟の上で、彼女に聖剣を使ってもらう事になる
contexts.english: She's prepared to use the sacred sword knowing that she'll disappear afterward.

findings.description: Caster's inability as a bodiless Servant to anchor another Servant becomes Assassin needing a physical body.
findings.sourceReading: Even a magus cannot sustain a Servant when that magus is herself a non-corporeal Servant; the anchor must belong to the current era, so Caster selected the gate.
findings.explanation: Caster's inability as a bodiless Servant to anchor another Servant becomes Assassin needing a physical body.

contexts.japanese: いかに魔術師と言えど、実体を持たぬサーヴァントにサーヴァントは維持できぬ。
contexts.english: A Servant cannot maintain themselves without a physical body, even if one is a mage.

findings.description: The Grail being active but neither complete nor broken becomes a rule that it cannot break until it returns to its original form.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says there is still time because the Grail has activated, but has neither reached its proper wish-machine form nor yet broken apart.
findings.explanation: The Grail being active but neither complete nor broken becomes a rule that it cannot break until it returns to its original form.

contexts.japanese: 願望機っていう本来の姿になってなければ壊れてもいない。
contexts.english: it won't break as long as it doesn't return to its original wish-granting form.

findings.description: Magic Circuits structurally collapsing become corroding.
findings.sourceReading: The circuits that move Rin's ample supply are failing from their foundations under the load.
findings.explanation: Magic Circuits structurally collapsing become corroding.

contexts.japanese: 回路自体が、根本から倒壊しかけている。
contexts.english: my circuits moving that energy are on the verge of corrosion.

findings.description: His ability to count the magic currently operating in Shirou becomes a broader claim about Shirou's magical capacity. The preceding count of seventeen remains.
findings.sourceReading: Gilgamesh says he can readily discern the number of spells operating in Shirou, explaining his preceding count of seventeen.
findings.explanation: His ability to count the magic currently operating in Shirou becomes a broader claim about Shirou's magical capacity. The preceding count of seventeen remains.

contexts.japanese: おまえに働く魔術の数など、それこそ手に取るように判る
contexts.english: I know exactly how much magecraft you can do.

findings.description: Continuous layered Projection becomes simply releasing all Projections.
findings.sourceReading: Against seventeen simultaneous weapons, Shirou commands unfreezing followed by continuous layered transcription, the one-at-a-time sequence explained two pages later.
findings.explanation: Continuous layered Projection becomes simply releasing all Projections.

contexts.japanese: 停止解凍、全投影連続層写
contexts.english: Release freeze. Release all Projections

findings.description: Gilgamesh's tactical assessment is grammatically malformed.
findings.sourceReading: He calls the decision to extract at least the Grail correct because Shirou cannot beat him.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh's tactical assessment is grammatically malformed.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯だけでも取り外す判断は正しい。
contexts.english: your decision to dismantle just even the Holy Grail is correct.

findings.description: Multiple Magic Circuits progressively disconnecting becomes one circuit disconnecting.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou's circuits fail one after another, causing the magical energy supplied by Rin to lose its destination and return.
findings.explanation: Multiple Magic Circuits progressively disconnecting becomes one circuit disconnecting.

contexts.japanese: 回路は断線していき
contexts.english: My circuit gets disconnected

findings.description: Creating the Reality Marble as the only full defense becomes creating the incoming Noble Phantasms.
findings.sourceReading: With nearly thirty weapons deployed, Shirou concludes that to block them all he now has no choice but to bring his inner world fully into being.
findings.explanation: Creating the Reality Marble as the only full defense becomes creating the incoming Noble Phantasms.

contexts.japanese: 防ぎきるには、もはや作り上げるしかない。
contexts.english: If I want to block them, I'll just have to create them.

findings.description: Shield fractures causing Shirou's body to lose pieces becomes his body being full of holes.
findings.sourceReading: The shield is already moth-eaten with holes; because it is Shirou himself, each fracture has chipped away parts of his body even though the projectiles have not physically reached him.
findings.explanation: Shield fractures causing Shirou's body to lose pieces becomes his body being full of holes.

contexts.japanese: その時点で衛宮士郎の体は欠けている。
contexts.english: my body is full of holes already.

findings.description: The world containing everything and perhaps nothing becomes certainly containing both.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou characterizes the inner world paradoxically but retains おそらく, an epistemic limit on the claim that nothing is there.
findings.explanation: The world containing everything and perhaps nothing becomes certainly containing both.

contexts.japanese: ここには全てがあり、おそらくは何もない。
contexts.english: Everything is here, and nothing is here.

findings.description: Counterpart swords already lying to Shirou's left and right become Gilgamesh's earlier swords themselves surrounding him.
findings.sourceReading: For each sword now floating behind Gilgamesh, its matching counterfeit already sleeps in the Reality Marble beside Shirou.
findings.explanation: Counterpart swords already lying to Shirou's left and right become Gilgamesh's earlier swords themselves surrounding him.

contexts.japanese: 左右には、ヤツの背後に浮かぶ剣が眠っている。
contexts.english: Surrounding me are the swords that were floating behind him earlier.

findings.description: Projection as an extension of Strengthening is reversed into Strengthening as an extension of Projection.
findings.sourceReading: Rin calls Shirou’s method nonsense because he skips both full and abbreviated procedures and attempts Projection by extending his Strengthening process.
findings.explanation: Projection as an extension of Strengthening is reversed into Strengthening as an extension of Projection.

contexts.japanese: 強化の延長で投影をしようなんていう貴方
contexts.english: if you think Strengthening is an extension of Projection.

findings.description: Rin offering to alter Shirou’s procedure for him becomes Shirou changing it himself.
findings.sourceReading: Rin considers that she may be able to make him immediately useful by changing the Projection procedure for him a little.
findings.explanation: Rin offering to alter Shirou’s procedure for him becomes Shirou changing it himself.

contexts.japanese: 少し手順を変えてあげるだけで
contexts.english: if you change your process a bit.

findings.description: Projection becoming an immediate combat asset becomes Shirou himself becoming useful.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says that if he can reproduce Archer’s swords, that capability will constitute immediately deployable fighting strength.
findings.explanation: Projection becoming an immediate combat asset becomes Shirou himself becoming useful.

contexts.japanese: 再現できれば即戦力じゃないっ！
contexts.english: you'll be useful right away if you just recreate that!

findings.description: Rin’s command to master an achieved result becomes a claim that any success proves reproduction at will.
findings.sourceReading: Whether yesterday’s success was accident or necessity, Rin orders Shirou to make it his own now that he has once accomplished it.
findings.explanation: Rin’s command to master an achieved result becomes a claim that any success proves reproduction at will.

contexts.japanese: 出来た以上は偶然だろうが必然だろうがモノにしなさい！
contexts.english: whether on purpose or not, it means you're capable of doing it at will!

findings.description: Kiritsugu’s field ruling out hostile intent becomes ruling out a personal grudge.
findings.sourceReading: Because the alarm is silent, Shirou concludes the visitor is not a human approaching with hostile intent.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu’s field ruling out hostile intent becomes ruling out a personal grudge.

contexts.japanese: 敵意を持つ人間ではない
contexts.english: it can't be anyone with a grudge

findings.description: Releasing a sensation becomes removing a nerve. The English makes the description more concrete, though the magical context does not require literal anatomical extraction.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou disengages the sensation embedded in his spine, after which circuit-related tension releases.
findings.explanation: Releasing a sensation becomes removing a nerve. The English makes the description more concrete, though the magical context does not require literal anatomical extraction.

contexts.japanese: 背骨に抉り込んだ感覚を外す。
contexts.english: I remove the nerve I gouged into my spine.

findings.description: Archer’s specific causal accusation about Shirou’s misconception becomes the broader insult that he does not know what he is doing.
findings.sourceReading: Because Shirou mistakenly treats circuits as something made each time, the circuits meant for use were abandoned and left dormant.
findings.explanation: Archer’s specific causal accusation about Shirou’s misconception becomes the broader insult that he does not know what he is doing.

contexts.japanese: そのような勘違いをしているから、本来使われる筈の回路が放棄され、眠っていたのだ。
contexts.english: Since you don't know what you're doing, the circuit that is supposed to be used has been neglected and is dormant.

findings.description: The explanation mismatches plural “nerves” with singular “its.”
findings.sourceReading: The nerves will eventually remember their normal function as the dormant circuit returns to service.
findings.explanation: The explanation mismatches plural “nerves” with singular “its.”

contexts.japanese: いずれ神経は通常の機能を思い出す
contexts.english: The nerves will eventually recall its normal function

findings.description: Two problems Shirou attributes to his inexperience become a causal chain in which his missing energy supply prevents Saber from taking spirit form. This changes his account of their dependence, without establishing the actual cause beyond this passage.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou reports two deficiencies: Saber cannot become a spirit, and she receives none of the energy normally supplied by a Master. He attributes both to his inexperience.
findings.explanation: Two problems Shirou attributes to his inexperience become a causal chain in which his missing energy supply prevents Saber from taking spirit form. This changes his account of their dependence, without establishing the actual cause beyond this passage.

contexts.japanese: セイバーはアーチャーのように霊体になる事が出来ず、本来マスターから得られる筈の魔力提供もない
contexts.english: Saber can't turn into spirit form like Archer, since unlike the other Masters, I'm not providing her the magical energy that she needs.

findings.description: Incomplete magical replenishment becomes no replenishment under any degree of restraint.
findings.sourceReading: Sleep can suppress consumption, but replenishment cannot be made fully adequate.
findings.explanation: Incomplete magical replenishment becomes no replenishment under any degree of restraint.

contexts.japanese: 魔力の補充は万全とはいかないらしい。
contexts.english: she can't replenish it no matter how much she limits herself.

findings.description: Saber’s drip of self-generated recovery is misattributed to Shirou supplying it through the sealed faucet.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou’s faucet is blocked; Saber recovers only at the drip rate produced by her own circuits.
findings.explanation: Saber’s drip of self-generated recovery is misattributed to Shirou supplying it through the sealed faucet.

contexts.japanese: 俺という蛇口を封じられているセイバーは、魔力回復がとんでもなく遅い
contexts.english: since I am figuratively Saber's faucet, she can only restore magical energy at a slow pace since I am only providing the equivalent of a drip.

findings.description: The English introduces mentally hitting targets during magecraft practice. The Japanese only says that nightly training enables Shirou to make his arrows strike as imagined.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou credits his nightly magecraft training with enabling arrows to strike as he imagines, explaining why he expects to retain his former archery results.
findings.explanation: The English introduces mentally hitting targets during magecraft practice. The Japanese only says that nightly training enables Shirou to make his arrows strike as imagined.

contexts.japanese: 魔術の鍛錬があるからこそ、イメージ通りに矢を的中させられる
contexts.english: I can hit the target like I do mentally while I'm working on magecraft.

findings.description: Becoming a circuit changes to making a circuit. This loses the explicit identification of practitioner and conduit, although the surrounding discussion still preserves self-erasure.
findings.sourceReading: The practitioner suppresses the self and becomes a circuit, paralleling the self-emptying discipline of archery.
findings.explanation: Becoming a circuit changes to making a circuit. This loses the explicit identification of practitioner and conduit, although the surrounding discussion still preserves self-erasure.

contexts.japanese: 自己を消して一つの『回路』になる事
contexts.english: erase oneself to make a circuit

findings.description: Saber's assessment of breathing ideal for a human becomes breathing suited to Kuzuki's particular body, changing the standard of her praise.
findings.sourceReading: Saber judges Kuzuki's breathing ideal by human standards, while restricting her admiration to breathing.
findings.explanation: Saber's assessment of breathing ideal for a human becomes breathing suited to Kuzuki's particular body, changing the standard of her praise.

contexts.japanese: 先ほどの人物の呼吸は、ヒトとして理想的だった。
contexts.english: It was ideal for his body.

findings.description: The class as a role-shaped shell worn by the summoned Heroic Spirit disappears into simple assignment.
findings.sourceReading: The Grail calls compatible spirits into one of seven prepared vessels; what wears the shell of that role is called a Servant.
findings.explanation: The class as a role-shaped shell worn by the summoned Heroic Spirit disappears into simple assignment.

contexts.japanese: 役割という殻を被ったモノ
contexts.english: those who are assigned to these classes

findings.description: Magi practicing magecraft as their vocation becomes “use magecraft as a living.”
findings.sourceReading: Because Masters are professional or life-committed magi, magical energy inevitably leaks from them.
findings.explanation: Magi practicing magecraft as their vocation becomes “use magecraft as a living.”

contexts.japanese: 魔術を生業とする以上
contexts.english: Since they use magecraft as a living

findings.description: Rin’s categorical current belief that a Servant has only one Noble Phantasm is revised into the qualified claim that Servants “typically” wield one.
findings.sourceReading: Within Rin’s present model, a Servant’s Noble Phantasm is singular and is the other half that remained with the hero in life.
findings.explanation: Rin’s categorical current belief that a Servant has only one Noble Phantasm is revised into the qualified claim that Servants “typically” wield one.

contexts.japanese: サーヴァントが持つ宝具はただ一つであり
contexts.english: Servants typically only wield one Noble Phantasm

findings.description: Repeating the successful Strengthening loses Shirou’s goal of making the sensation securely his own.
findings.sourceReading: Before the sensation fades, he must repeat the exercise until he has reliably internalized it; failing to capitalize on the rare success would be wasteful.
findings.explanation: Repeating the successful Strengthening loses Shirou’s goal of making the sensation securely his own.

contexts.japanese: 繰り返して、確実にモノにしなければ勿体ない
contexts.english: I need to repeat it so that I don't forget the sensation, or else it would be a waste.

findings.description: The Eulyphis Department of Spiritual Evocation is reduced to the ungrammatical label “a Eulyphis mage.”
findings.sourceReading: A mage of the Spiritual Evocation department, Eulyphis, would be unable to work for three days after seeing Rider.
findings.explanation: The Eulyphis Department of Spiritual Evocation is reduced to the ungrammatical label “a Eulyphis mage.”

contexts.japanese: 降霊科の魔術師
contexts.english: If a Eulyphis mage

findings.description: Zelretch’s instruction to select candidates after departmental deliberation becomes a demand to present them after this conference.
findings.sourceReading: Each department must deliberate and then select promising candidates for one of three apprenticeships.
findings.explanation: Zelretch’s instruction to select candidates after departmental deliberation becomes a demand to present them after this conference.

contexts.japanese: 各部門、協議の末見込みのある者を選出せよ
contexts.english: All departments are to present their candidates after this conference.

findings.description: Rider replenishing Rin’s magical energy becomes Rin replenishing it herself at home.
findings.sourceReading: Rider takes Rin to the Tohsaka mansion and supplies the magical energy that lets the Crest preserve her life.
findings.explanation: Rider replenishing Rin’s magical energy becomes Rin replenishing it herself at home.

contexts.japanese: ライダーはわたしを遠坂邸まで連れて行ってくれて、魔力を補充してくれた
contexts.english: Rider took me back to the Tohsaka house, where I replenished my magical energy.

findings.description: Lack of equipment for making a homunculus becomes lack of blueprints for Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: The group lacks facilities capable of creating a homunculus-scale replacement body.
findings.explanation: Lack of equipment for making a homunculus becomes lack of blueprints for Shirou.

contexts.japanese: ホムンクルスを作れるほどの設備もない
contexts.english: nor are there any blueprints for him like a homunculus would have.

findings.description: Magical results returning to the practitioner become guaranteed benefits.
findings.sourceReading: The return includes harmful curses that would destroy both practitioner and victim.
findings.explanation: Magical results returning to the practitioner become guaranteed benefits.

contexts.japanese: 必ず自らの肉体に成果が返る
contexts.english: sure to benefit their physical bodies.

findings.description: An unknown method becomes only an unknown scheme.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei suggests a method of obtaining Master status unknown to them.
findings.explanation: An unknown method becomes only an unknown scheme.

contexts.japanese: 私たちが知らない方法でマスターになる
contexts.english: become a Master without our knowledge.

findings.description: What restores the original bodily form becomes whether restoration is possible.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken asks what agency or record returns the body to its original shape, eliciting the blueprint explanation.
findings.explanation: What restores the original bodily form becomes whether restoration is possible.

contexts.japanese: 肉体を元の形に戻すものはなんだと思う
contexts.english: would he be able to regain his original form?

findings.description: The incantation’s wrong-becomes-right ruby becomes the fault lies here.
findings.sourceReading: The raw Japanese semantic ruby on Weiß ist schwarz reads 非は / 是に, a transformation from wrong/no to right/yes.
findings.explanation: The incantation’s wrong-becomes-right ruby becomes the fault lies here.

contexts.japanese: Weiß ist schwarz.
contexts.english: Weiß ist schwarz. (The fault lies here.)

findings.description: Being taught incorrectly becomes Shirou’s way of thinking being incorrect.
findings.sourceReading: 教え方が間違えられていた assigns the problem to faulty instruction, after questions about his teacher.
findings.explanation: Being taught incorrectly becomes Shirou’s way of thinking being incorrect.

contexts.japanese: 貴方の場合は教え方が間違えられていた
contexts.english: your way of thinking is incorrect.

findings.description: Taking medicine becomes swallowing something.
findings.sourceReading: 薬を飲む identifies medicine as the nonsurgical intervention.
findings.explanation: Taking medicine becomes swallowing something.

contexts.japanese: ちょっと薬を飲んでもらうだけだから
contexts.english: have you swallow something.

findings.description: A conditional mature-body impediment becomes a definite cause of prolonged treatment.
findings.sourceReading: 体が…成長してたら makes the complication conditional until examination.
findings.explanation: A conditional mature-body impediment becomes a definite cause of prolonged treatment.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮くんの体がもういじれないぐらい成長してたら長くかかる
contexts.english: it's going to take a while because you're old enough

findings.description: The near impossibility of entrusting a Servant to another is reduced to a nonmage handling one.
findings.sourceReading: 他人に、しかも魔術師でもない人間に distinguishes delegation to another from the additional difficulty of a nonmage recipient.
findings.explanation: The near impossibility of entrusting a Servant to another is reduced to a nonmage handling one.

contexts.japanese: 他人に、しかも魔術師でもない人間にサーヴァントを預ける事は不可能に近い
contexts.english: It's nearly impossible for a human who isn't a mage to handle a Servant.

findings.description: Similarity to a Magic Crest becomes worthiness of one.
findings.sourceReading: 近い compares the eye-to-circuit transformation technique with a Magic Crest.
findings.explanation: Similarity to a Magic Crest becomes worthiness of one.

contexts.japanese: 魔術刻印と呼ばれるものに近い
contexts.english: are worthy of a Magic Crest.

findings.description: Seeing Rider with physical or mental vision becomes everything she sees, physical or spiritual, being cursed.
findings.sourceReading: 肉眼/心眼 describe the observer’s means of seeing her; 今の私を見る事自体 is the curse.
findings.explanation: Seeing Rider with physical or mental vision becomes everything she sees, physical or spiritual, being cursed.

contexts.japanese: 肉眼であろうが心眼であろうが、今の私を見る事自体が呪い
contexts.english: Everything I see is cursed, whether physical or spiritual.

findings.description: No point using Kischur's agate becomes having to use it.
findings.sourceReading: 使ってもしょうがない dismisses this candidate before Rin searches for sage.
findings.explanation: No point using Kischur's agate becomes having to use it.

contexts.japanese: 瑪瑙なんか使ってもしょうがない
contexts.english: Guess I'll have to use Grandmaster Kischur's agate

findings.description: General feasibility of concealing energy becomes Rin's personal current act of hiding Archer.
findings.sourceReading: 魔力を隠すだけならどうとでもなる concludes that concealment can be arranged either way, after discussing the Matou house.
findings.explanation: General feasibility of concealing energy becomes Rin's personal current act of hiding Archer.

contexts.japanese: 魔力を隠すだけならどうとでもなる
contexts.english: One way or another, I hide his magical energy.

findings.description: The hair-binding accessory itself being a corresponding magical item becomes bindings being suitable tools.
findings.sourceReading: 相応の魔術品 identifies what the actual accessory must be, explaining rarity of replacements.
findings.explanation: The hair-binding accessory itself being a corresponding magical item becomes bindings being suitable tools.

contexts.japanese: 縛り付ける物だって相応の魔術品
contexts.english: Bindings are suitable as tools of magecraft

findings.description: Sakura's comparison to suggestion becomes a named Whisper spell mixed into liquid.
findings.sourceReading: 暗示のようなもの describes something like suggestion; no named spell or mixture composition is identified.
findings.explanation: Sakura's comparison to suggestion becomes a named Whisper spell mixed into liquid.

contexts.japanese: 暗示のようなもの
contexts.english: Mixed in the liquid was a Whisper spell

findings.description: The worms craving a mage's power becomes Sakura wanting power as a mage.
findings.sourceReading: 身体の虫たちが is the subject of 欲しくて and 疼き出す; the next sentence explicitly reiterates the worms' hunger.
findings.explanation: The worms craving a mage's power becomes Sakura wanting power as a mage.

contexts.japanese: 魔術師の力が欲しくて、身体の虫たちが疼き出す
contexts.english: When I want power as a mage, the worms in my body start to twinge.

findings.description: Ordinary existence itself now consuming energy disappears into a generic heavy burden.
findings.sourceReading: 今はそれだけで魔力を消費する changes what daily life costs after her return to Master status.
findings.explanation: Ordinary existence itself now consuming energy disappears into a generic heavy burden.

contexts.japanese: 今はそれだけで魔力を消費するものになっている
contexts.english: it hammers home how heavy the burden is.

findings.description: Tentative recollection of shiniku becomes a definite explanation previously given by Rin.
findings.sourceReading: だったっけか is Shirou checking his own recollection; the source does not attribute this definition to Rin.
findings.explanation: Tentative recollection of shiniku becomes a definite explanation previously given by Rin.

contexts.japanese: 中国に伝わる幾ら食べても減らない肉、だったっけか
contexts.english: she said a shiniku is a lump of meat

findings.description: Bad instruction becomes incorrect thinking.
findings.sourceReading: 教え方が間違えられていた blames the method by which he was taught.
findings.explanation: Bad instruction becomes incorrect thinking.

contexts.japanese: 教え方が間違えられていた
contexts.english: your way of thinking is incorrect.

findings.description: Medicine is reduced to swallowing something.
findings.sourceReading: 薬 identifies the substance as medicine, distinguishing the proposed method from scalpel surgery.
findings.explanation: Medicine is reduced to swallowing something.

contexts.japanese: ちょっと薬を飲んでもらうだけ
contexts.english: have you swallow something.

findings.description: Conditional maturity causing longer treatment becomes definite age-caused delay.
findings.sourceReading: 成長してたら preserves an if-condition that cannot be determined before opening.
findings.explanation: Conditional maturity causing longer treatment becomes definite age-caused delay.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮くんの体がもういじれないぐらい成長してたら長くかかる
contexts.english: it's going to take a while because you're old enough

findings.description: The oath-restraint made beside the heart becomes one binding the heart itself.
findings.sourceReading: 心臓の横に作られた identifies the separate magical formation beside the heart, explicitly distinguishing it from the heart’s motion.
findings.explanation: The oath-restraint made beside the heart becomes one binding the heart itself.

contexts.japanese: 心臓の横に作られた、誓約という名の戒め
contexts.english: an oath binding it.

findings.description: Adoption as an alternative to ordinary upbringing disappears from single-heir exposition.
findings.sourceReading: 普通に育てるか養子に出す supplies the two options for the non-heir immediately before explaining Sakura’s transfer.
findings.explanation: Adoption as an alternative to ordinary upbringing disappears from single-heir exposition.

contexts.japanese: 普通に育てるか養子に出す
contexts.english: the other is raised to live a normal life.

findings.description: Shirou’s known Three Corpses lore is attributed to Kirei explaining it.
findings.sourceReading: Narration states the legend Shirou recalls, then says he has heard of that but not Crest Worms.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s known Three Corpses lore is attributed to Kirei explaining it.

contexts.japanese: 三尸—人間の体に棲み
contexts.english: He explains that the Three Corpses

findings.description: Death by nausea alone loses the specified physical symptom.
findings.sourceReading: 吐き気だけで死に至る intensifies the alien-nerve distress through the nausea it causes.
findings.explanation: Death by nausea alone loses the specified physical symptom.

contexts.japanese: 吐き気だけで死に至る
contexts.english: The distress you would feel every time they moved would be enough to kill you.

findings.description: Assent to the war through delegating Rider becomes assent to delegation alone.
findings.sourceReading: ライダーを預ける事で戦いに賛同 makes the delegation the way she continued to count as consenting to battle.
findings.explanation: Assent to the war through delegating Rider becomes assent to delegation alone.

contexts.japanese: ライダーを預ける事で戦いに賛同していた
contexts.english: she had consented to letting Shinji Matou command Rider.

findings.description: The body failing before complete invasion becomes possible permanent damage.
findings.sourceReading: その前に体の方が保つまい forecasts inability of the body to endure that long, not merely a possible lasting injury.
findings.explanation: The body failing before complete invasion becomes possible permanent damage.

contexts.japanese: その前に体の方が保つまい
contexts.english: they may cause permanent damage before then.

findings.description: A warning that even the original practitioner could not undo the implantation becomes a claim about Kotomine's training and personal limits. This changes the scope and basis of his medical explanation.
findings.sourceReading: Even the practitioner who implanted the Crest could presumably no longer undo it now that the worms are part of Sakura.
findings.explanation: A warning that even the original practitioner could not undo the implantation becomes a claim about Kotomine's training and personal limits. This changes the scope and basis of his medical explanation.

contexts.japanese: 刻印を植え付けた術者本人でさえ
contexts.english: I am trained in Crest transplantation

findings.description: The condition to fight as a Master becomes a condition not to fight.
findings.sourceReading: マスターとして戦え names the coercive command to fight, and says starvation harms her even apart from it.
findings.explanation: The condition to fight as a Master becomes a condition not to fight.

contexts.japanese: マスターとして戦えなんて条件
contexts.english: the condition not to fight as a Master.

findings.description: Temporary ordinary life loses its time limit.
findings.sourceReading: しばらくは limits the restoration through not using Rider to a while, before the separate warning about Zouken.
findings.explanation: Temporary ordinary life loses its time limit.

contexts.japanese: しばらくは今まで通りの生活ができる
contexts.english: she may be able to continue her daily life.

findings.description: Stopped modifies the Crest Worms instead of the heart in the analogy.
findings.sourceReading: 停止した心臓 is the stopped heart being compared with mental restoration; the next clause simply credits the worms with keeping the body alive.
findings.explanation: Stopped modifies the Crest Worms instead of the heart in the analogy.

contexts.japanese: 刻印虫のおかげで肉体はいまだ生きている
contexts.english: the stalled Crest Worms are keeping the body alive.

findings.description: The maximum energy usable at once becomes a general limit on what accumulated energy can do.
findings.sourceReading: 一度に使える魔力の最大量 is the instantaneous throughput ceiling opposed to stockpiled reserves.
findings.explanation: The maximum energy usable at once becomes a general limit on what accumulated energy can do.

contexts.japanese: 一度に使える魔力の最大量
contexts.english: there's only so much they can do with it

findings.description: A peak energy-use ceiling becomes a generic limit on what stored energy can do.
findings.sourceReading: 一度に使える魔力の最大量 contrasts maximum energy usable at once against growing stockpiles.
findings.explanation: A peak energy-use ceiling becomes a generic limit on what stored energy can do.

contexts.japanese: 一度に使える魔力の最大量
contexts.english: there's only so much they can do with it

findings.description: A soul-like thing that formed Caster becomes a soul modeled after Caster.
findings.sourceReading: キャスターを象っていた魂とも言えるもの is the soul-like thing that constituted/shaped the Servant, not a copy patterned on an already separate Caster.
findings.explanation: A soul-like thing that formed Caster becomes a soul modeled after Caster.

contexts.japanese: キャスターを象っていた魂とも言えるもの
contexts.english: The soul modeled after the Servant Caster

findings.description: Rapid loss of heat/color becomes pain as if bleeding.
findings.sourceReading: 急速に熱を失っていく with いろ ruby layers fading heat and color after the attempted recall.
findings.explanation: Rapid loss of heat/color becomes pain as if bleeding.

contexts.japanese: 急速に熱を失っていく
contexts.english: It hurts where the Command Spells are, almost like I'm bleeding there.

findings.description: The pain of an engraved Magic Crest becomes simply the Crest engraved in her arm.
findings.sourceReading: 刻まれた魔術刻印の痛み is one of Rin’s specific remembered hardships.
findings.explanation: The pain of an engraved Magic Crest becomes simply the Crest engraved in her arm.

contexts.japanese: 刻まれた魔術刻印の痛み
contexts.english: the Magic Crest engraved in her arm.

findings.description: Extraction amount predicted to exceed limits in a few more days becomes victim count already exceeding expectations.
findings.sourceReading: あと数日ほどで規定量を超える forecasts future excessive extraction; the preceding row says its amount increases daily.
findings.explanation: Extraction amount predicted to exceed limits in a few more days becomes victim count already exceeding expectations.

contexts.japanese: 二日前から始まったこの異常搾取は、あと数日ほどで規定量を超える
contexts.english: The number of bizarrely drained victims that began to appear two days ago has exceeded expectations in only a manner of days.

findings.description: Applying magical energy becomes clashing their two magical energies.
findings.sourceReading: 魔力をぶつけただけ describes a binding from simply directing magical energy at him.
findings.explanation: Applying magical energy becomes clashing their two magical energies.

contexts.japanese: 魔力をぶつけただけの呪縛
contexts.english: clash our magical energies to bind you in a curse.

findings.description: Even specialists do not use transfer offensively becomes an exception allowing specialists.
findings.sourceReading: わたしや遠坂の魔術師でさえ、攻撃になんて使わない includes Illya and Tohsaka specialists in those avoiding offensive use because success is too low.
findings.explanation: Even specialists do not use transfer offensively becomes an exception allowing specialists.

contexts.japanese: 転移を得意とするわたしや遠坂の魔術師でさえ、攻撃になんて使わない
contexts.english: most mages wouldn't use it offensively, unless they're specialists like me or the Tohsakas.

findings.description: Stimulation while consciousness is transferred becomes stimulation before the transfer is done.
findings.sourceReading: 意識が転移先に移っている最中 covers the period it is at its destination, with bodily stimulus forcing recall.
findings.explanation: Stimulation while consciousness is transferred becomes stimulation before the transfer is done.

contexts.japanese: 意識が転移先に移っている最中
contexts.english: before the transfer is done

findings.description: Being sent out as the highest Master loses that assigned excellence.
findings.sourceReading: 最高のマスターとして specifies the role and quality with which the thousand-year lineage dispatched her.
findings.explanation: Being sent out as the highest Master loses that assigned excellence.

contexts.japanese: 最高のマスターとして送り出された
contexts.english: who they sent to carry out their thousand-year-old obsession.

findings.description: The full-rune defense failing even to delay becomes barely slowing the encroachment.
findings.sourceReading: 足止めにさえならない denies even a delaying effect despite the defense’s Noble Phantasm resistance.
findings.explanation: The full-rune defense failing even to delay becomes barely slowing the encroachment.

contexts.japanese: 足止めにさえならない
contexts.english: they barely even manage to slow the thing down.

findings.description: A fiery whip becomes a red-hot rod.
findings.sourceReading: 背骨に差し込まれた炎の鞭 gives a whip-of-fire bodily circuit image being withdrawn.
findings.explanation: A fiery whip becomes a red-hot rod.

contexts.japanese: 炎の鞭
contexts.english: the red-hot rod

findings.description: Only preparing Strengthened weapons ahead of time becomes only Strengthening something into a weapon.
findings.sourceReading: 武器を用意しておく specifies advance preparation because forming circuits takes a minute and surprise counterattack is impossible.
findings.explanation: Only preparing Strengthened weapons ahead of time becomes only Strengthening something into a weapon.

contexts.japanese: 武器を用意しておく事しかできない
contexts.english: All I can do is Strengthen something into a weapon.

findings.description: Feeding only on other people’s pain becomes only causing pain.
findings.sourceReading: 他人の痛みしか糧にせず specifies parasitic sustenance; lack of teaching to return joy contrasts extraction with beneficence.
findings.explanation: Feeding only on other people’s pain becomes only causing pain.

contexts.japanese: 他人の痛みしか糧にせず、他人の喜びを還元する教えがない
contexts.english: All they do is cause people pain without showing them how to be happy again.

findings.description: Inability to solve the root problem and a plan to consult Rider become no help and Rider’s possible ideas.
findings.sourceReading: 根本的な解決 limits the inability to fundamental resolution; Sakura then undertakes to ask Rider later for an idea.
findings.explanation: Inability to solve the root problem and a plan to consult Rider become no help and Rider’s possible ideas.

contexts.japanese: 間桐の魔術じゃ根本的な解決はできないから、今度、ライダーにいいアイデアがないか聞いてみますね
contexts.english: I can't help you with the Matou magecraft, but Rider might have some good ideas...

findings.description: Replicating viewed armaments for his own use becomes replicating any weapon as swords.
findings.sourceReading: 複製し自らの剣とする concerns using copied armaments as his own weapons;36 explicitly retains replication of any viewed weapon.
findings.explanation: Replicating viewed armaments for his own use becomes replicating any weapon as swords.

contexts.japanese: 視認した“武装”を複製し自らの剣とする
contexts.english: replicates any weapon he sees as swords...

findings.description: Recalling a proper activation incantation becomes instantly recalling his incantations.
findings.sourceReading: キチンとした qualifies the activation spell; deliberate intent allows remembering it, with no speed specification.
findings.explanation: Recalling a proper activation incantation becomes instantly recalling his incantations.

contexts.japanese: キチンとした起動呪文も思い起こせる
contexts.english: you can instantly recall his incantations

findings.description: Belief it had not directly killed people becomes lack of a need to kill.
findings.sourceReading: 直接、人間を殺すなんて事はなかった筈だ concerns prior behavior as Shirou understood it.
findings.explanation: Belief it had not directly killed people becomes lack of a need to kill.

contexts.japanese: 直接、人間を殺すなんて事はなかった筈だ
contexts.english: It didn't need to murder them like this.

findings.description: No time to work leisurely becomes needing to concentrate.
findings.sourceReading: 悠長にやってる余裕なんてない specifies urgency and no slack.
findings.explanation: No time to work leisurely becomes needing to concentrate.

contexts.japanese: 悠長にやってる余裕なんてない
contexts.english: I can't afford to not concentrate on this.

findings.description: The shadow being the greater priority becomes another equal concern.
findings.sourceReading: それ以上に explicitly ranks the shadow above Zouken in urgency.
findings.explanation: The shadow being the greater priority becomes another equal concern.

contexts.japanese: それ以上にあの影は放っておけない
contexts.english: we can't ignore the Shadow, either.

findings.description: Rin canceling her proposed switch installation becomes warning Shirou not to flip a switch.
findings.sourceReading: She had proposed installing a circuit switch and now cancels that plan because making easy on/off possible would endanger him.
findings.explanation: Rin canceling her proposed switch installation becomes warning Shirou not to flip a switch.

contexts.japanese: この前は士郎の体にスイッチをいれようって言ってたけど、アレは止めるわ
contexts.english: You've talked about flipping a switch in your body before, but don't do that this time.

contexts.japanese: ここで簡単に魔術回路の開閉ができるようになったら
contexts.english: You'll be in danger if you open and close your Magic Circuits carelessly.

findings.description: Destined obscure extinction becomes an extinction already met.
findings.sourceReading: 滅びる定め describes a future destiny after ability had declined while knowledge remained.
findings.explanation: Destined obscure extinction becomes an extinction already met.

contexts.japanese: 人知れず滅びる定めとなった
contexts.english: met its obscure end

findings.description: An experiment leading to the next step becomes greater results in the next war.
findings.sourceReading: 次に繋げる does not identify the next war as the target event.
findings.explanation: An experiment leading to the next step becomes greater results in the next war.

contexts.japanese: 次に繋げる実験にすぎぬ
contexts.english: will allow greater results in the next war.

findings.description: Zouken's wretched continued life remains, but his claim to be the only collaborator still living is omitted. This weakens the contrast between the original shared undertaking and his solitary persistence.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken says that he alone among those who joined hands still continues his wretched existence.
findings.explanation: Zouken's wretched continued life remains, but his claim to be the only collaborator still living is omitted. This weakens the contrast between the original shared undertaking and his solitary persistence.

contexts.japanese: ワシだけが今も無様に生き続けておる
contexts.english: why I continue living this wretched life.

findings.description: A Grail expected not to adapt becomes Sakura being poorly suited to being a Grail.
findings.sourceReading: “適応しない聖杯” predicates nonadaptation of the planned entity and contrasts its unexpected growth with the decades experiment.
findings.explanation: A Grail expected not to adapt becomes Sakura being poorly suited to being a Grail.

contexts.japanese: “適応しない聖杯”だったはずの桜
contexts.english: despite being poorly suited to being a Holy Grail.

findings.description: Inability to communicate with the shadow becomes uncertainty whether it thinks independently.
findings.sourceReading: 意思疎通 concerns mutual communication, not the absence of autonomous thought.
findings.explanation: Inability to communicate with the shadow becomes uncertainty whether it thinks independently.

contexts.japanese: アレと意思疎通など出来るものか
contexts.english: I'm not sure it's even capable of thinking on its own.

findings.description: Giving its existence form on this side becomes modeling itself after creatures on this side.
findings.sourceReading: 桜を原型にし assigns Sakura as prototype; こちら側での存在を象った says it shapes existence here.
findings.explanation: Giving its existence form on this side becomes modeling itself after creatures on this side.

contexts.japanese: こちら側での存在を象ったモノにすぎぬ
contexts.english: It has merely modeled itself after the creatures on this side.

findings.description: Immersing himself by the incantation becomes the incantation embedding itself in him.
findings.sourceReading: 呪文で自己に埋没すれば is his conditional inward focusing through reciting the spell, improving Projection.
findings.explanation: Immersing himself by the incantation becomes the incantation embedding itself in him.

contexts.japanese: 呪文で自己に埋没すれば
contexts.english: once it embedded itself in me

findings.description: Projection identical to the original becomes intended reproductions treated the same.
findings.sourceReading: 複製でありながら本物と同一のもの asserts the defining identity despite copying.
findings.explanation: Projection identical to the original becomes intended reproductions treated the same.

contexts.japanese: 本物と同一のもの
contexts.english: are meant to be reproductions that are treated the same as their originals.

findings.description: The firing hammer becomes a firing trigger.
findings.sourceReading: 撃鉄 names the hammer, distinct from 引き金/trigger explicitly in the next line.
findings.explanation: The firing hammer becomes a firing trigger.

contexts.japanese: 撃鉄のイメージ
contexts.english: I imagine a firing trigger.

findings.description: The switch itself going outside with the gun becomes also needing to remove the fuse.
findings.sourceReading: The correction says the activating switch itself would be outside, not that extraction prevents activation.
findings.explanation: The switch itself going outside with the gun becomes also needing to remove the fuse.

contexts.japanese: 入ってしまうスイッチそのものが外に出る
contexts.english: I need to get the fuse itself out of my head, too.

findings.description: Then wouldn’t she have enough stamina becomes she has plenty.
findings.sourceReading: なら...充分にあるんじゃないのか is a puzzled conditional question inferred from expected sufficient magical energy.
findings.explanation: Then wouldn’t she have enough stamina becomes she has plenty.

contexts.japanese: なら、体力だって充分にあるんじゃないのか
contexts.english: She's also got plenty of stamina.

findings.description: Other than those just named becomes other than those she was given.
findings.sourceReading: いまあげられた refers to the listed Saber/Lancer/Caster/Berserker in speech.
findings.explanation: Other than those just named becomes other than those she was given.

contexts.japanese: いまあげられた以外のサーヴァント
contexts.english: Servants other than the ones she was given

findings.description: Made as that kind of Grail becomes made to look human.
findings.sourceReading: そういう風に作られた explains her being a Grail homunculus rather than originally human.
findings.explanation: Made as that kind of Grail becomes made to look human.

contexts.japanese: そういう風に作られたホムンクルス
contexts.english: I'm just a homunculus made to look human.

findings.description: Unconventional birth becomes disreputable methods.
findings.sourceReading: まっとうな手段 contrasts normal birth with artificial magical creation.
findings.explanation: Unconventional birth becomes disreputable methods.

contexts.japanese: まっとうな手段によって生まれ得なかった
contexts.english: Born from less than respectable methods

findings.description: Already taken souls and subsequently greater attraction become stronger force pulling them away.
findings.sourceReading: By the time she noticed Caster/Lancer were taken and the other attraction had become greater, explaining subsequent majority capture.
findings.explanation: Already taken souls and subsequently greater attraction become stronger force pulling them away.

contexts.japanese: 引き寄せる力はそっちの方が強くなってた
contexts.english: Some other force stronger than me pulled them away.

findings.description: No room for the Grail’s own soul becomes inability to hold all Servant souls.
findings.sourceReading: 聖杯自体の魂 is the vessel’s own personality/soul, excluded by containing seven; next20 explains personality erasure.
findings.explanation: No room for the Grail’s own soul becomes inability to hold all Servant souls.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯”自体の魂の入る余地なんてない
contexts.english: The container can't hold all of them.

findings.description: Conceptual/spiritual weight becomes crushing the very soul.
findings.sourceReading: 概念—魂魄としての重み states the nonphysical mechanism, with 魂砕き/アウトブレイカー as layered name.
