findings.explanation: Conceptual/spiritual weight becomes crushing the very soul.

contexts.japanese: 魂魄としての重みで相手を打倒する
contexts.english: by crushing the very soul.

findings.description: Parallel hypothetical effects become shadow destruction causing their inability to defend.
findings.sourceReading: し/わたしたちだって says shadow would be destroyed AND they too cannot block or dodge if targeted.
findings.explanation: Parallel hypothetical effects become shadow destruction causing their inability to defend.

contexts.japanese: わたしたちだってあんなものを振るわれたら防ぐ事も躱す事もできない
contexts.english: so we can't expect to block or dodge it.

findings.description: His Projection exceeds ordinary level becomes his problem being more basic.
findings.sourceReading: そういうレベルの話じゃない distinguishes his Projection’s special status from ordinary-mage Projection, leading to correction of methods.
findings.explanation: His Projection exceeds ordinary level becomes his problem being more basic.

contexts.japanese: 貴方の投影はそういうレベルの話じゃない
contexts.english: your problem is more basic than that.

findings.description: Materials matching original as closely as possible becomes as many ingredients as possible.
findings.sourceReading: 出来るだけ本物にそうよう is fidelity criterion, not number of components.
findings.explanation: Materials matching original as closely as possible becomes as many ingredients as possible.

contexts.japanese: 出来るだけ本物にそうように用意
contexts.english: gathering as many ingredients as we can

findings.description: Arm Projection needing neither materials nor blueprint loses materials.
findings.sourceReading: 材料や元になる設計図も要らない denies both physical and informational support requirements for arm-powered Projection.
findings.explanation: Arm Projection needing neither materials nor blueprint loses materials.

contexts.japanese: 材料や元になる設計図も要らない
contexts.english: you wouldn't need any blueprints

findings.description: Strengthening an existing object by Projection becomes Strengthening a Projection.
findings.sourceReading: 元からあるものを is the object; 投影で is the means; 強化する the operation.
findings.explanation: Strengthening an existing object by Projection becomes Strengthening a Projection.

contexts.japanese: 元からあるものを“投影”で“強化”する
contexts.english: 'strengthen' a Projection of something that already exists.

findings.description: Transplanted crest becomes an applied ward.
findings.sourceReading: 刻印 is yesterday’s Magic Crest graft in00:5; its adaptation improves resistance.
findings.explanation: Transplanted crest becomes an applied ward.

contexts.japanese: 昨日の刻印はうまく馴染んでいる
contexts.english: the ward I applied yesterday

findings.description: An existing lookalike object reinforced through Projection becomes a Projection supplemented by more magecraft. This changes the method being contrasted with Shirou's complete mental construction.
findings.sourceReading: Ordinary Projection can be layered onto an object resembling the original to reinforce it. Shirou instead must construct everything through his own mental image.
findings.explanation: An existing lookalike object reinforced through Projection becomes a Projection supplemented by more magecraft. This changes the method being contrasted with Shirou's complete mental construction.

contexts.japanese: オリジナルに似せた物に“投影”を重ねて“補強”する事はできる。
contexts.english: Projection magecraft, can supplement a Projection that resembles the original to a degree.

findings.description: An intended three-day lesson becomes regret that it should have been three days.
findings.sourceReading: 筈だった describes the original plan to divide acquisition over3 days, exceeded by today’s achievement.
findings.explanation: An intended three-day lesson becomes regret that it should have been three days.

contexts.japanese: 三日に分けて習得してもらう筈だった
contexts.english: I should have had you learn today's Projection over three days.

findings.description: Current effect compared to amplified school barrier becomes school barrier already instantaneous and powerful.
findings.sourceReading: Current dissolution resembles a version of Rider’s school field made instantaneous and stronger.
findings.explanation: Current effect compared to amplified school barrier becomes school barrier already instantaneous and powerful.

contexts.japanese: あの結界を、瞬間的かつ強力にした魔術みたいなもの
contexts.english: the Bounded Field Rider deployed at the school was like magecraft with an instantaneous and powerful effect.

findings.description: A warning about becoming adapted or integrated turns into a warning that something will take a liking to Sakura. The Japanese leaves the precise direction of that adaptation unstated.
findings.sourceReading: Gilgamesh warns that once adaptation or integration has occurred, Sakura will no longer be able even to die. The sentence leaves the subject of 馴染む unstated.
findings.explanation: A warning about becoming adapted or integrated turns into a warning that something will take a liking to Sakura. The Japanese leaves the precise direction of that adaptation unstated.

contexts.japanese: 馴染んでしまえば死ぬ事もできなくなる
contexts.english: Once it takes a liking to you, you won't even be able to do that.

findings.description: Completed enough to reach that becomes merely more complete than anticipated.
findings.sourceReading: アレに届くほど identifies a specific unnamed threshold beyond expectation.
findings.explanation: Completed enough to reach that becomes merely more complete than anticipated.

contexts.japanese: まさかアレに届くほど完成するとはな。
contexts.english: you've become far more complete than I anticipated.

findings.description: Saint’s burial with shield reading becomes mourning saint.
findings.sourceReading: 埋葬 withたて ruby presents the protective burial/shield image immediately before inevitable graft erosion; no act of mourning a saint.
findings.explanation: Saint’s burial with shield reading becomes mourning saint.

contexts.japanese: 聖者の埋葬など無駄なこと。
contexts.english: It's pointless to mourn a saint.

findings.description: Right arm becomes left arm.

contexts.english: A giant red eyeball appears in front of her.

findings.description: Broken shield petals become black-light-scattering petals in other branch.
findings.sourceReading: Four petals broken by black aurora scatter before white light wins.
findings.explanation: Broken shield petals become black-light-scattering petals in other branch.

contexts.japanese: 黒い極光に打ち砕かれた四枚羽を撒き散らしながら、
contexts.english: Four petals scatter the black light,

findings.description: Ninety-percent cancellation line absent from chain-opening English.
findings.sourceReading: Japanese says Saber's holy sword cancels nine tenths of Bellerophon's light.
findings.explanation: Ninety-percent cancellation line absent from chain-opening English.

contexts.japanese: ベルレフォーンの光はその九割を、セイバーの聖剣によって相殺された。

findings.description: Not taking a life becomes not endangering it.
findings.sourceReading: The dagger broke only the contract without taking Sakura's life.
findings.explanation: Not taking a life becomes not endangering it.

contexts.japanese: それは桜の命を奪わず、彼女を縛り付けていた契約だけを破戒した。
contexts.english: It doesn't endanger Sakura's life. It only breaks the contract she was bound to.

findings.description: Interruption before sword creation becomes before sword use.
findings.sourceReading: He would have his skull smashed before creating Saber's sword if he exposed the Projection opening.
findings.explanation: Interruption before sword creation becomes before sword use.

contexts.japanese: そんな隙を見せれば、セイバーの剣を作る前に頭蓋を砕かれている。
contexts.english: If I give him an opening, he'll pulverize my brain before I can use Saber's sword.

contexts.japanese: 投影には時間を要する。
contexts.english: I need time to do it.

findings.description: New miracle's application of earlier far-seeing magecraft omitted.
findings.sourceReading: She says the new act is an application of magecraft/far-seeing shown before, though this time impressive.
findings.explanation: New miracle's application of earlier far-seeing magecraft omitted.

contexts.japanese: 前に見せた魔術の応用だけど、今度のはすごいんだよ。
contexts.english: Last time, I showed you how to see far away with magecraft, but this time, it'll be really amazing!

findings.description: Pendant enabling hand extension becomes guarantee of external rescue conditional on reach.
findings.sourceReading: Tiny pendant has just one breath of mana; insufficient for much, but helps him extend his hand.
findings.explanation: Pendant enabling hand extension becomes guarantee of external rescue conditional on reach.

contexts.japanese: 何の役にも立たない、けれど、手を伸ばすぐらいは助けてくれる、小さな小さなペンダント。
contexts.english: It's completely useless, but the small, small pendant will make sure that someone saves me if I reach out with my hand.

contexts.japanese: ほんの一呼吸分の魔力。
contexts.english: One breath of magical energy.

findings.description: Surface Master gate and underground Greater Grail distinction disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Rin explains surface site is a gate for Masters who merely want Grail, while to reach the Greater Grail, source of the war, they must go down rather than up.
findings.explanation: Surface Master gate and underground Greater Grail distinction disappears.

contexts.japanese: 「いえ、柳洞寺に用はないわ。上で作られてる場は表向きの、ただ聖杯を欲しがるマスター用の門よ。……聖杯戦争の大聖杯に行こうっていうんなら、上じゃなくて下に行かないとね」
contexts.english: "No, we're not going to the temple. The compound up top was built just for show, for the benefit of Masters seeking the Holy Grail."

findings.description: Hypothetical worldwide mage drain becomes actual gathering to use reserve.
findings.sourceReading: Even all mages worldwide gathering and drawing freely would not exhaust store.
findings.explanation: Hypothetical worldwide mage drain becomes actual gathering to use reserve.

contexts.japanese: 世界中の魔術師がここに集まって、好き勝手魔力をくみ上げようと尽きない貯蔵量。
contexts.english: an inexhaustible resource that mages from around the world gather here to use.

findings.description: Cup-of-Heaven threat loses this-me self-identification.
findings.sourceReading: 天の杯 bears このわたし ruby: she tells Rin to drown in this me, identifying engulfing vessel with herself.
findings.explanation: Cup-of-Heaven threat loses this-me self-identification.

contexts.japanese: 今度は誰も助けに来ない。湖に落ちた虫みたいに、天の杯に溺れなさい」
contexts.english: No one's coming to save you this time. Drown in the Cup of Heaven, like a bug fallen into a lake."

findings.description: Feet covering green becomes feet wreathed in green.
findings.sourceReading: Semantic ruby says 私の足は緑を覆う: feet are subject of covering green.
findings.explanation: Feet covering green becomes feet wreathed in green.

contexts.japanese: Es erzählt—Mein Schatten nimmt Sie！」
contexts.english: Es erzählt... (Let my voice carry far....) Mein Schatten nimmt sie...! (Let my feet be wreathed in green...!)"

findings.description: Volley becomes maximum firepower.
findings.sourceReading: 一斉射撃 is simultaneous shooting/a volley.
findings.explanation: Volley becomes maximum firepower.

contexts.japanese: 「Es läßt frei.Eilesalve—！」
contexts.english: "Es lässt frei. Eilesalve! (Release, maximum firepower!)"

findings.description: Grinding teeth at resemblance becomes suppressing the words.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura grinds her teeth thinking it is like Excalibur's very light.
findings.explanation: Grinding teeth at resemblance becomes suppressing the words.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの宝具、エクスカリバーの光そのものではないか、と少女は歯を軋ませる。
contexts.english: She stops herself from saying that it's almost exactly like Saber's Excalibur.

findings.description: Reserve reaching trillions becomes billions or perhaps trillions.
findings.sourceReading: Not merely several hundred million: reserve reaches trillions.
findings.explanation: Reserve reaching trillions becomes billions or perhaps trillions.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜の魔力貯蔵量は数億どころか兆に届く。
contexts.english: Sakura's magical energy capacity is in the billions or even trillions.

findings.description: Sakura's attrition attack assigned to Rin.
findings.sourceReading: Even if Sakura continues attacking until Rin's stamina ends, cave collapse afterward means Sakura loses.
findings.explanation: Sakura's attrition attack assigned to Rin.

contexts.japanese: 仮に、遠坂凛の体力が尽きるまで攻め続けたとしても、その後に待つものは洞窟の崩壊なのだ。
contexts.english: Even if Rin were to attack until her physical strength failed her, the cave would collapse after.

contexts.japanese: このまま徒に戦いを続けては間桐桜の敗北となる。
contexts.english: Continuing this vain battle would mean failure for Sakura.

findings.description: Fetus's glaring motion becomes boy looking around.
findings.sourceReading: ぎょろり introduces eyeless distorted fetus looking at him in next clause.
findings.explanation: Fetus's glaring motion becomes boy looking around.

contexts.japanese: ぎょろり、と。
contexts.english: I look around.

contexts.japanese: 目玉もないクセに、歪な胎児が俺を見る。
contexts.english: The eyeless, twisted fetus is looking at me.

findings.description: Unfulfilled historical project becomes world without evolution.
findings.sourceReading: 成らぬまま follows the thousand-/five-hundred-year pursuits: the continued world/project has remained unfulfilled/unrealized.
findings.explanation: Unfulfilled historical project becomes world without evolution.

contexts.japanese: 果てず、翻らず、成らぬまま、連綿と続けられた一つの世界が、ここに終わろうとしている。
contexts.english: A world that has continued without ending, changing, or evolving is finally coming to an end.

findings.description: Lineage dropping out becomes losing its way.
findings.sourceReading: The family simply fell out of the running; next page states its lifespan as a mage lineage had reached its limit and was declining in Zouken's generation.
findings.explanation: Lineage dropping out becomes losing its way.

contexts.japanese: 単に、彼らは脱落したのだ。
contexts.english: They simply lost their way.

contexts.japanese: その三百年が魔術師の家系として限界だった。
contexts.english: In those three hundred years, they reached the limits of their lineage.

findings.description: Golden saint reduced to golden woman.
findings.sourceReading: The remembered Einzbern woman is explicitly 黄金の聖女, a golden holy woman/saint.
findings.explanation: Golden saint reduced to golden woman.

contexts.japanese: いつの時も色褪せずに心にいた、アインツベルンの黄金の聖女。
contexts.english: The golden Einzbern woman who has never faded from his mind to this day.

findings.description: No reward in his life/future becomes an ideal lying beyond this life.
findings.sourceReading: Base 生 and ruby さき place no reward in that life/future: even if there were no recompense for him.
findings.explanation: No reward in his life/future becomes an ideal lying beyond this life.

contexts.japanese: たとえその生に。何の報いが、なかったとしても。
contexts.english: Even if it lies beyond this life. Even if he isn't rewarded...

findings.description: Too little time to reach the goal becomes too little to accomplish anything.
findings.sourceReading: How could they reach the desired destination with merely that span of years? Following lines specify distant maturation of humanity.
findings.explanation: Too little time to reach the goal becomes too little to accomplish anything.

contexts.japanese: たったそれだけの年月でどうして届こうか。
contexts.english: Far too short a time to accomplish anything.

contexts.japanese: これより幾星霜の時間を超え、千の年月、万の年月の末に手に入れる、人間という種の成長だ。
contexts.english: the maturation of humanity, whether it takes thousands or tens of thousands of years.

findings.description: Inclusive affection cutoff becomes exclusive.
findings.sourceReading: Illya affection 4 or lower blocks True; source also says even one extra Projection is too much.
findings.explanation: Inclusive affection cutoff becomes exclusive.

contexts.japanese: ぶっちゃけ、わたしの好感度が４以下だったり、投影を一回でも多く使ってるとトゥルーには行けないのでしたー！
contexts.english: To be blunt, if my affection level is below 4 or you use too many Projections, you can't reach the True ending!

findings.description: Frame ready sometime today becomes whole-day work.
findings.sourceReading: Somehow frame will be ready within today, then Projection tonight.
findings.explanation: Frame ready sometime today becomes whole-day work.

contexts.japanese: 「だから、例の切り札の作成。なんとか今日中に骨組みが出来るから、今夜“投影”を実行するわ。
contexts.english: "Because you're going to make our secret weapon. We'll spend the entire day making the frame, and then Project it tonight.

findings.description: Confrontation upon successful Projection becomes weapon deciding whether they win.
findings.sourceReading: 成功次第臓硯と決着をつける: as soon as Projection succeeds, move to settling conflict with Zouken.
findings.explanation: Confrontation upon successful Projection becomes weapon deciding whether they win.

contexts.japanese: で、成功次第臓硯と決着をつける。これ以上犠牲者は増やせない。あの影がなんであれ、臓硯を倒せば聖杯戦争は終わる。得体の知れないあの影も、そうなったら消えるでしょ」
contexts.english: It's going to decide whether we win against Zouken. I'm not going to let any more innocent people get hurt. I have no idea what the Shadow is, but the Holy Grail War will end once we take out Zouken. That should cause the Shadow to disappear too."

findings.description: Power-providing main source becomes projector Sakura.
findings.sourceReading: Repeats 本体 from preceding alternative: main entity supplying mana/electricity to projector, distinct from Sakura projector.
findings.explanation: Power-providing main source becomes projector Sakura.

contexts.english: "The person projecting it..."

contexts.japanese: もしアレを消せるとしたら、それは投影機である桜本人を消すか、投影機に魔力を送っている本体を消すしかないのではないか。
contexts.english: Even if I could erase it somehow, would that mean erasing the person projecting it—Sakura—or erasing whoever's providing power to the projector?

findings.description: Disbelief in existence becomes hope no such person exists.
findings.sourceReading: そんなものがいるとは思えない says he cannot think such main source exists.
findings.explanation: Disbelief in existence becomes hope no such person exists.

contexts.japanese: ……そんなものがいるとは思えない。
contexts.english: ...I hope nobody like that exists.

findings.description: Settling her own Grail existence becomes settling unspecified things in Grail capacity.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura went to settle 自分自身, herself as Holy Grail, despite fear of death, protecting Shirou.
findings.explanation: Settling her own Grail existence becomes settling unspecified things in Grail capacity.

contexts.japanese: 「そう。けどシロウ。サクラが一人で外に出たのは、シロウに見られたくなかったからだよ。サクラはシロウを守る為に、怖いけど、死にたくないけど、聖杯である自分自身に決着をつけにいったの。
contexts.english: "Okay. But Shirou, Sakura left on her own because she didn't want you to see her. She did it to protect you. She's scared and she doesn't want to die, but she wants to settle things on her own, as a Holy Grail.

findings.description: Acquiring the key becomes unlocking the gate. This concerns the ritual's predicted progression and belongs outside this character dossier.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken predicts taking Archer's soul from the girl and seizing the key that leads to the gate.
findings.explanation: Acquiring the key becomes unlocking the gate. This concerns the ritual's predicted progression and belongs outside this character dossier.

contexts.japanese: アインツベルンの聖杯。あの小娘が取り込んだアーチャーの魂を取り込み、門に至る鍵を奪う。
contexts.english: The Einzbern Grail. Once she absorbs that little girl and the Archer she took, Sakura will unlock the gate.

findings.description: All interpretations directing killing become for whatever reason.
findings.sourceReading: Corrupted vortex has human-killing direction through every interpretation.
findings.explanation: All interpretations directing killing become for whatever reason.

contexts.japanese: その時点で、聖杯の中身は“何か”に汚染されていた。無色の筈の力は、あらゆる解釈をもって人間を殺す方向性を持った『渦』になっていたのだ」
contexts.english: At the time, the Holy Grail's contents had been contaminated by something. Its power, which should have been colorless, had for whatever reason transformed into a vortex bent on killing humans."

findings.description: Way of attaining happiness becomes fortunate existence.
findings.sourceReading: Problem is mode of happiness: using evil to throw good into relief.
findings.explanation: Way of attaining happiness becomes fortunate existence.

contexts.japanese: 問題があるとすれば、それは悪を以って善を浮き彫りにする、という幸福の有り方だろう。
contexts.english: The only problem was its fortunate existence, as something which used evil to highlight good.

findings.description: One colored person becomes generic foreign element.
findings.sourceReading: Power couldn't withstand even one color-bearing alien individual, explicitly counted 一人.
findings.explanation: One colored person becomes generic foreign element.

contexts.japanese: そこに一粒の毒が混ざった程度で、穢れなきモノは全て変色した。なにしろ無色だからな。どれほど深遠で広大だろうと、たった一人の、色のついた異分子には敵わなかったという訳だ」
contexts.english: All it took was a single drop of poison to taint that pure vessel. It was colorless, as you know. No matter how vast or unfathomable it was, it was unable to tolerate a single foreign element."

findings.description: Fourth Grail's narrowness becomes fourth war's abruptness.
findings.sourceReading: Fourth Grail too narrow, incomplete with two Servants remaining and gate promptly destroyed.
findings.explanation: Fourth Grail's narrowness becomes fourth war's abruptness.

contexts.japanese: 「四度目の聖杯は狭すぎたのだ。
contexts.english: "The fourth war was too abrupt.

findings.description: Unmixed evil becomes refusal to mix.
findings.sourceReading: Pure/unadulterated evil embodies only human malice.
findings.explanation: Unmixed evil becomes refusal to mix.

contexts.japanese: 『人を殺す』という方向性をもった、それだけに特化した呪いの渦。人間の悪性のみを具現した混ざり気のない魔」
contexts.english: It is a great vortex of curses utterly specialized in killing humans. An evil manifestation of human malice which has no desire to mix with anything else."

findings.description: Sakura is called a host with the reading 'Master' in Japanese; English retains only 'host.' The local pairing of receptacle and contractual role is lost, although a contract is mentioned shortly afterward.
findings.sourceReading: The written 'host' is paired with the reading 'Master,' placing Sakura's receptacle role alongside a contractual designation as power passes to her.
findings.explanation: Sakura is called a host with the reading 'Master' in Japanese; English retains only 'host.' The local pairing of receptacle and contractual role is lost, although a contract is mentioned shortly afterward.

contexts.japanese: 寄り代への侵食……間桐桜に力の継承が済んでしまえば、彼女自身があの影に変貌する」
contexts.english: Once it consumes its host, once Sakura Matou inherits its power, she will transform into the Shadow."

findings.description: Previous-war corruption attached to later Grail use becomes use in previous war.
findings.sourceReading: Her connection formed when using the Grail that had been contaminated in previous war; 前回の戦いで modifies 汚染された within object noun phrase.
findings.explanation: Previous-war corruption attached to later Grail use becomes use in previous war.

contexts.japanese: ……いや、前回の戦いで汚染された聖杯を使用した時点で、彼女はとうに契約していたのだ。
contexts.english: ...No, the moment someone used the corrupted Holy Grail in the previous war, her contract was signed.

contexts.japanese: なにしろ前回の戦いでこの世に漏れた“触覚”を体に埋め込まれ、魔術回路として育てられた人間だ。間桐桜が聖杯として門を開けば開くほど、中にいるモノと一体化していくだろう。
contexts.english: In the last war, its sense of touch, which leaked into this world, was embedded into her body, and she was raised to have it serve as her Magic Circuits. The more Sakura Matou opens the gate as a Holy Grail, the more she will merge with the thing within her.

findings.description: The English dates implantation to the last war. The Japanese dates the leakage to that war and leaves the implantation date unstated.
findings.sourceReading: The previous war dates the leakage of what was subsequently implanted in Sakura. The sentence does not independently date implantation.
findings.explanation: The English dates implantation to the last war. The Japanese dates the leakage to that war and leaves the implantation date unstated.

contexts.japanese: なにしろ前回の戦いでこの世に漏れた“触覚”を体に埋め込まれ、魔術回路として育てられた人間だ。間桐桜が聖杯として門を開けば開くほど、中にいるモノと一体化していくだろう。
contexts.english: In the last war, its sense of touch, which leaked into this world, was embedded into her body, and she was raised to have it serve as her Magic Circuits. The more Sakura Matou opens the gate as a Holy Grail, the more she will merge with the thing within her.

findings.description: Even ending war cannot reset becomes nearing war-end prevents reset.
findings.sourceReading: Even if Grail War ends now, she cannot be restored because already the shadow.
findings.explanation: Even ending war cannot reset becomes nearing war-end prevents reset.

contexts.japanese: 彼女は既にあの影そのものだ。もはや聖杯戦争が終わったところで、彼女を元に戻す事はできん」
contexts.english: She is already the Shadow itself. Now that the Holy Grail War is in its final days, she will be unable to return to her former self."

findings.description: Control within seconds becomes holding control for seconds, impossibility becomes miracle.
findings.sourceReading: Gaining Grail control within merely seconds is madness; alone boy cannot accomplish it under any circumstances.
findings.explanation: Control within seconds becomes holding control for seconds, impossibility becomes miracle.

contexts.japanese: それだけではない。わずか数秒で聖杯を制御するなど狂気の沙汰だ。おまえ一人では、どうあっても成しえない奇跡だぞ」
contexts.english: That's not all. It would be a mind-shattering task to control the Holy Grail for even a few seconds. Such a feat would be a miracle for you alone."

findings.description: Palm-sized true body and brain-worm designation omitted.
findings.sourceReading: Soul-container brain worm's hiding location unknown; palm-sized main body anchors soul and must be found or soul purified.
findings.explanation: Palm-sized true body and brain-worm designation omitted.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだ。アレの本体は人体に寄生する蟲だからな。魂の容器にあたる脳虫が何処に潜んでいるかは知れんが、ソレが生きている限り人体の乗っ取りは易い。
contexts.english: "Yes. He is an insect which parasitizes human bodies. I do not know which insect contains his mind and soul, but it is easy for him to transfer himself to a new body as long as it is intact.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯はある意味不老不死だ。魂を世に留めている手のひらほどの本体を探し出すか、魂そのものを浄化させなければ完全には滅ぼせん」
contexts.english: He is immortal, in a way. He will never completely disappear unless you find the main body which anchors his soul, or cleanse his soul itself."

findings.description: Fetching ceremonial clothing is replaced by escorting Illya.
findings.sourceReading: Ceremonial/formal dress isn't here; if Sakura wants to open the gate as successor, they must go to Illya's castle to fetch it.
findings.explanation: Fetching ceremonial clothing is replaced by escorting Illya.

contexts.japanese: けど正装はここにはないの。サクラが後継者として門を開きたいんなら、わたしの城まで取りに行かないと」
contexts.english: But my dress isn't here. If you want to open the gate as a successor, you'll need to take me to my castle."

contexts.japanese: 「……いいでしょう。自分で探す手間が省けますから。
contexts.english: "...Fine. It saves me the trouble of looking for it myself.

findings.description: Best healing method becomes the only healing method.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou thinks Sakura should know obtaining Grail is best way of healing body.
findings.explanation: Best healing method becomes the only healing method.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯を得る事が体を治す一番の方法だと判っているだろうに、それを考えようとしていない。
contexts.english: She should know that the Holy Grail is the only way to heal herself, but she doesn't even consider it as an option.

findings.description: Sakura's warning about accidental exposure becomes a warning that Rider might attack on impulse. Rider's next lines still explain that she cannot reliably prevent her eyes from affecting Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura warns that Shirou might inadvertently fall under the eyes' effect. Rider explains that even limiting her magical energy would not reliably exclude him.
findings.explanation: Sakura's warning about accidental exposure becomes a warning that Rider might attack on impulse. Rider's next lines still explain that she cannot reliably prevent her eyes from affecting Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「こ、困りませんっ！　だいたいですね、ライダーの目は魔眼なんですよ？　ちょっとした弾みで魔術にかかっちゃったらどうするんですか！」
contexts.english: "I-it doesn't bother me at all! Besides, Rider's eyes are Mystic Eyes. What if she hits you with her magecraft on impulse!?"

contexts.japanese: 私本人が魔力をセーブしたところで、貴方を対象外にするのは難しい」
contexts.english: Even if I conserve my magical energy, it would be difficult to stop them from affecting you."

findings.description: The Grail being filled becomes an ungrammatical purpose to fill it.
findings.sourceReading: The Grail is merely a receptacle into which material is poured/which is filled.
findings.explanation: The Grail being filled becomes an ungrammatical purpose to fill it.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯はただ注がれるだけのもの。
contexts.english: It is merely to fill the Grail.

findings.description: A party to the ritual becomes a founder.
findings.sourceReading: Illya mocks Zouken as 当事者, one directly involved/concerned with the arrangement, for forgetting it.
findings.explanation: A party to the ritual becomes a founder.

contexts.japanese: —ま、当事者である貴方がソレを忘れるぐらいだから、マキリの血は衰退したんでしょうけど」
contexts.english: ...The Makiri bloodline really must have fallen into ruin, if even a founder has forgotten that."

findings.description: Understanding the mechanism of pain becomes getting used to it.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou thinks he has more or less grasped how the pain works, then explains his cooling/heat-transfer model.
findings.explanation: Understanding the mechanism of pain becomes getting used to it.

contexts.japanese: ……痛みの仕組みがどんなモノなのかはだいたい呑み込めた。
contexts.english: ...I've more or less gotten used to how the pain works.

findings.description: Archer creating projected weapons becomes him forging the original paired swords too.
findings.sourceReading: Because Archer is a forging-associated Heroic Spirit, he creates; anything seen and understood can be reproduced through Projection.
findings.explanation: Archer creating projected weapons becomes him forging the original paired swords too.

contexts.japanese: だから作る。
contexts.english: So he forged them, too.

findings.description: The English preserves the ruby's name but loses the treasure chest and Illya's expectation that it will be beautiful. 'Sounds pretty nice' need not mean she likes the sound of the name.
findings.sourceReading: Illya expresses interest in the apparent beauty of a treasure chest used by a magician, with a proper name supplied through ruby.
findings.explanation: The English preserves the ruby's name but loses the treasure chest and Illya's expectation that it will be beautiful. 'Sounds pretty nice' need not mean she likes the sound of the name.

contexts.japanese: 「じゃ、わたしも行くね。遠坂の師の遺産になんて興味はないけど、魔法使いの使ってた宝箱はキレイそうだし」
contexts.english: "Then I should come, too. I'm not interested in Kischur's relics, but Zel Schweinorg sounds pretty nice."

findings.description: The defining examples of human pillars and sacrifices disappear.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says, succinctly, that human pillars and sacrificial victims are examples of the Heroic Spirits called Anti-Heroes.
findings.explanation: The defining examples of human pillars and sacrifices disappear.

contexts.japanese: 「そういったものが反英雄と呼ばれる英霊だ。端的に言えば人柱や生贄がこれにあたる」
contexts.english: "Such Heroic Spirits tend to be labeled as Anti-Heroes."

findings.description: Growth untouched by human hands becomes growth thanks only to human involvement.
findings.sourceReading: The paradoxical being is created by humans yet grows without any human hand entering or shaping the process.
findings.explanation: Growth untouched by human hands becomes growth thanks only to human involvement.

contexts.japanese: ……人が生み出したモノでありながら、決して人の手が混ざらず成長するモノ。その矛盾こそがあらゆる抑止の圧力を免除される“世界の敵”である」
contexts.english: ...They are something created by humans, and grow only thanks to human involvement. That contradiction is what exempts these enemies of the world from the corrective forces that would otherwise eliminate them."

findings.description: Kirei's dismissal of racial classification becomes praise for excellence surviving mixed ancestry, adding an ancestry claim and reversing the force of his qualification.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says racial classification would be ridiculous if the Tohsakas' grandmaster is as reported. The passage identifies a grandmaster relationship, not biological descent from him.
findings.explanation: Kirei's dismissal of racial classification becomes praise for excellence surviving mixed ancestry, adding an ancestry claim and reversing the force of his qualification.

contexts.japanese: 始まりの御三家、私やおまえでは太刀打ちできぬ歴史と血筋を誇る者たちがそれだ。この中で土着の者は遠坂だけだが、遠坂とて大師父はかの時の翁だ。尤も、遠坂の大師父が伝え聞く通りの人物ならば、人種分けなど滑稽だが」
contexts.english: The three founding families boast history and bloodlines the likes of which you and I can only dream of. Of them only the Tohsakas are natives of this land, but their grandmaster is the famed Schweinorg. If he is truly as capable as the stories say, then it is little wonder that their excellence has persisted in spite of mixed ancestry."

findings.description: A millennium without branches or intermarriage becomes only an unfragmented bloodline.
findings.sourceReading: Few lineages last a thousand years without creating branch houses and without mixing with outsiders.
findings.explanation: A millennium without branches or intermarriage becomes only an unfragmented bloodline.

contexts.japanese: 「……といっても、もともとこの聖杯はアインツベルンが考案したものだ。彼の一族の歴史は一千年。分家も持たず、他と交わらずに一千の年月を重ねた家系は少ない」
contexts.english: "...That said, the Einzberns originally conceived this Holy Grail. They have a thousand years of history. Few mage lineages have persisted for a millennium without fragmenting their bloodlines."

findings.description: A possible punishment becomes an asserted punishment.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou wonders whether the blue-white charge tormenting Rider is punishment for being unable to obey Shinji.
findings.explanation: A possible punishment becomes an asserted punishment.

contexts.japanese: 慎二の命令を守れない罰なのか、ライダーは青白い電荷に苛まれる。
contexts.english: Rider writhes with pain as blue-white lightning wrecks her body, punishing her for failing to comply with Shinji's command.

findings.description: Zouken's account of sending Sakura to another family becomes an account of the Matous adopting someone. The stated obstacle also changes from the prospective adoptee's lack of circuits to the family's lack of circuits to pass on.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken says the unselected sibling could have been sent out for adoption, but no receiving family would want someone without circuits. The surrounding questions identify Sakura as the person under discussion.
findings.explanation: Zouken's account of sending Sakura to another family becomes an account of the Matous adopting someone. The stated obstacle also changes from the prospective adoptee's lack of circuits to the family's lack of circuits to pass on.

contexts.japanese: 兄妹など最たるものだ。後継ぎは二人もいらぬ。間桐の名が廃れていなければ養子にでも出したのだが、魔術回路がないのでは貰い手などおるまい」
contexts.english: That's doubly so for siblings. There is no need for two heirs. If the Matou name hadn't declined, then we might have been able to adopt someone, but we don't have any Magic Circuits to pass on to begin with."

findings.description: Not knowing that Matou practices magecraft becomes merely not being taught its arts.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken claims the sibling not chosen as heir does not even know that the Matou household belongs to the magical path.
findings.explanation: Not knowing that Matou practices magecraft becomes merely not being taught its arts.

contexts.japanese: 「慎二はマスターである以上、答えは明白であろう。後継者に選ばれなかった片割れは、間桐の家が魔道である事も知らぬわ。
contexts.english: "Shinji is the Master, so the conclusion is obvious. A sibling not even chosen as the heir would not be inducted into our arts.

findings.description: No mana supply becomes no extra mana.
findings.sourceReading: Saber receives no magical energy from Shirou and must spend her own reserves merely maintaining existence.
findings.explanation: No mana supply becomes no extra mana.

contexts.japanese: 俺からの魔力提供がないセイバーは、それこそ日々『ここにいる』だけで精一杯なのだ。
contexts.english: Without any extra magical energy from me, it takes all of Saber's power just to exist.

findings.description: The Grail eliminating futile labor becomes shortening necessary effort.
findings.sourceReading: The Grail simply removes the accumulated futile labor that people call life.
findings.explanation: The Grail eliminating futile labor becomes shortening necessary effort.

contexts.japanese: —聖杯とは、単にその徒労を無くすだけのもの。
contexts.english: The Holy Grail simply abridges that necessary effort.

findings.description: Shirou's inability to make Saber dematerialize becomes his failure to learn to become a ghost.
findings.sourceReading: He understands that Servants can become spirit bodies, but unfortunately he cannot make or allow Saber to perform that feat.
findings.explanation: Shirou's inability to make Saber dematerialize becomes his failure to learn to become a ghost.

contexts.japanese: サーヴァントは霊体になれるらしいが、生憎俺にはそんな芸当はさせられない。
contexts.english: Apparently, Servants can turn into invisible ghosts, but alas, I never learned how do to that trick.

findings.description: Alternative routes to Heroic Spirit status become universal combined requirements.
findings.sourceReading: Servants either won fame in their own era or achieved a deed beyond what a human body can accomplish.
findings.explanation: Alternative routes to Heroic Spirit status become universal combined requirements.

contexts.japanese: それぞれが“自分の生きた時代”で名を馳せたか、或いは人の身に余る偉業を成し遂げた者たち。
contexts.english: Each of us made a name for ourselves in our respective time periods; we accomplished some great deed beyond human capabilities.

findings.description: Reaching the divine domain by an individual's power alone loses the individual-power condition.
findings.sourceReading: Whatever the means, each rose as far as the divine realm solely by one person's power.
findings.explanation: Reaching the divine domain by an individual's power alone loses the individual-power condition.

contexts.japanese: どのような手段であれ、一個人の力だけで神域まで上り詰めた存在です」
contexts.english: Whatever the means, we are beings who have sublimated to deity-esque status."

findings.description: Exceptional living ability becomes supernatural ability.
findings.sourceReading: A hero possessed outstanding abilities while alive, was exalted after death, and rose from ghost to spirit.
findings.explanation: Exceptional living ability becomes supernatural ability.

contexts.japanese: 英霊とは、生前に卓越した能力を持った英雄が死後に祭り上げられ、幽霊ではなく精霊の域に昇格したモノを言う。
contexts.english: Heroic Spirits had supernatural abilities while they were alive, were celebrated after their deaths, and promoted to a higher spiritual rank than a ghost or such.

findings.description: Generic suggestion becomes an invented Whisper-type spell.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou lists hypnosis, suggestion and the possibility of another Master's Mystic Eyes as ways his thoughts could be compromised.
findings.explanation: Generic suggestion becomes an invented Whisper-type spell.

contexts.japanese: 「ああ、名前は明かせないって事か。……そうだな、たしかにその通りだ。催眠とか暗示とか、いないとは思うけど他のマスターに魔眼持ちがいたらベラベラ秘密を喋りかねないし。
contexts.english: "Ah, so you can't reveal your name, huh? Yeah, you're right. Like hypnosis or being hit with a Whisper-type spell, or... Well, I doubt it, but if other Masters have Mystic Eyes, then I might start babbling about it.

findings.description: The explanation of personal measurement standards is grammatically malformed.
findings.sourceReading: How a Master represents a Servant's ability depends on that Master's own perceptual standard.
findings.explanation: The explanation of personal measurement standards is grammatically malformed.

contexts.japanese: 「どのようなカタチで把握したのかは知りません。サーヴァントの能力を測るのは、あくまでシロウが見る基準です。単純に色で識別するマスターもいれば、獣に喩えて見分けるマスターもいます」
contexts.english: "I do not know how you saw it. Your standards are what sets how you measure a Servant's ability. There are some Masters who distinguish simply through colors, and there are other Masters who understand by comparing them to beasts."

findings.description: An inherently impossible summoning becomes merely unreasonable.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says Servants answer a summoning which by nature should not be possible because they each have a desire.
findings.explanation: An inherently impossible summoning becomes merely unreasonable.

contexts.japanese: サーヴァントたちにもね、それぞれ何らかの欲望があるのよ。だからこそ彼等は本来有り得ない召喚に応じている」
contexts.english: The Servants have wishes of their own. That's why they respond to summons that would otherwise be, at best, unreasonable."

findings.description: The firearm analogy drops machine guns.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou distinguishes pistols, rifles, machine guns and shotguns as different mage performance types.
findings.explanation: The firearm analogy drops machine guns.

contexts.japanese: 銃の種類は短銃、ライフル銃、マシンガン、ショットガンと、魔術師ごとに性能が異なる。
contexts.english: Like how there are different guns—pistols, rifles, shotguns— mages all have a variety of abilities.

findings.description: Weak Masters choosing to feed people to Servants becomes a necessity.
findings.sourceReading: Rin bluntly says unskilled Masters feed people to their Servants.
findings.explanation: Weak Masters choosing to feed people to Servants becomes a necessity.

contexts.japanese: はっきり言ってしまえばね、実力のないマスターは、サーヴァントに人を食わせるのよ」
contexts.english: Bluntly speaking, inferior Masters have to feed other people to their Servants."

findings.description: Knowing another Master's identity as an offensive advantage becomes one's own exposure.
findings.sourceReading: Conversely, if a Master knows who another Master is, that Master can certainly launch a surprise attack.
findings.explanation: Knowing another Master's identity as an offensive advantage becomes one's own exposure.

contexts.japanese: 逆に誰がマスターかを知っていれば、確実に奇襲ができる。
contexts.english: Conversely, if the other Masters know who you are, you're just asking to be ambushed.

findings.description: Berserker's standing among summoned Servants becomes standing among every legendary hero.
findings.sourceReading: Rin thinks no one in the history of Servants likely equals Berserker in close combat.
findings.explanation: Berserker's standing among summoned Servants becomes standing among every legendary hero.

contexts.japanese: 「正面からじゃ勝てないでしょうね。白兵戦ならアレは最強のサーヴァントよ。きっと歴代のサーヴァントの中でも、アレと並ぶヤツはいないと思う。わたしもバーサーカーに襲われたら逃げ延びる手段はないわ」
contexts.english: "Not in a straight-up fight. That's the ultimate close-quarters Servant. There probably isn't anyone who can match it even among all the heroes of myth and legend. If Berserker attacks me, there's no escape."

findings.description: Believing an ambiguous claim becomes a contradictory fact statement.
findings.sourceReading: Young Shirou naturally believes words that could be taken either as a joke or as serious truth.
findings.explanation: Believing an ambiguous claim becomes a contradictory fact statement.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-00:page24:1
contexts.japanese: 俺はその、冗談とも本気ともとれない言葉を当たり前のように信じて、
contexts.english: I just accepted his words as fact...I took it neither as a joke or genuine statement.

findings.description: Shirou's envious admiration becomes gullibly buying into Kiritsugu's claim.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou judges himself equally absurd because the magic claim made him envious and lit up his eyes.
findings.explanation: Shirou's envious admiration becomes gullibly buying into Kiritsugu's claim.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-00:page26:1
contexts.japanese: それが羨ましくって目を輝かせた俺も俺だと思う。
contexts.english: But I was no better, the way I so eagerly bought into it.

findings.description: Heating elements or tubes become electrical pipes.
findings.sourceReading: Two heating wires are close to breaking, the heating tube or element still has life, and the power cord can be handled with insulation tape.
findings.explanation: Heating elements or tubes become electrical pipes.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-03:page15:1
contexts.japanese: 「……電熱線が断線しかかってるのが二つと……電熱管はまだ保つな……電源コードの方は絶縁テープでなんとかなる……」
contexts.english: "...There are two places where the wire's about to break... The electrical pipes should last a bit longer... The power cord should be fine with just insulation tape..."

findings.description: Diagnosing by internal sight becomes repairing by sight.
findings.sourceReading: If the heating element were broken Shirou would need non-amateur Strengthening, but in this case merely seeing the interior is sufficient to diagnose before ordinary repair.
findings.explanation: Diagnosing by internal sight becomes repairing by sight.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-03:page16:1
contexts.japanese: その時は素人じゃない方法で“強化”しなくてはいけなかったが、これなら内部を視るだけで十分だ。
contexts.english: Had that been the case, a certain "Strengthening" would have to be done, which no amateur could manage, but I should be able to fix this one by sight.

findings.description: An excessively roundabout perceptual method becomes an unhelpful ability.
findings.sourceReading: Kiritsugu says that apprehending an object's structure visually already involves too much waste or unnecessary process.
findings.explanation: An excessively roundabout perceptual method becomes an unhelpful ability.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-03:page19:1
contexts.japanese: 親父曰く、物の構造を視覚で捉えている時点で無駄が多い。
contexts.english: According to my old man, the fact that I can visualize objects' structures isn't really helpful.

findings.description: Recognizing mana-permeable locations becomes seeking places for mana to pass.
findings.sourceReading: Even after reading the blueprint, the main gain is knowing which parts readily conduct magical energy.
findings.explanation: Recognizing mana-permeable locations becomes seeking places for mana to pass.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-03:page20:1
contexts.japanese: だから設計図なんてものを読みとるのは無駄な手間だし、読みとったところで出来る事といったら魔力の通りやすい箇所が判る程度の話。
contexts.english: That's why reading blueprints is a waste of time, and even that only helps seek out areas for magical energy to pass through.

findings.description: Seeing a human silhouette becomes sensing a presence.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou doubts his eyes because a visible human figure stands on the slope he had just called deserted.
findings.explanation: Seeing a human silhouette becomes sensing a presence.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-07:page4:1
contexts.japanese: 一瞬、我が目を疑った。
contexts.english: I can't quite believe what I'm seeing. I must be wrong.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-07:page4:1
contexts.japanese: 人気がない、と言ったばかりの坂道に人影がある。
contexts.english: I sense a presence on the uphill path I was sure was empty.

findings.description: A childhood belief that the hill was forbidden becomes a repeated act of avoiding it, followed by duplicated certainty about Sakura's seriousness.
findings.sourceReading: As a child Sakura believed the scary-magician story and always thought she must not go to the top of the hill; Shirou notes that she answers his half-joking question with a serious face.
findings.explanation: A childhood belief that the hill was forbidden becomes a repeated act of avoiding it, followed by duplicated certainty about Sakura's seriousness.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-14:page27:1
contexts.japanese: 「信じました。だって子供だったんです。だから、坂の上には行っちゃいけないって、いつも思ってました」
contexts.english: "I did. I was a child, after all. That's why I always avoided going all the way up the hill."

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-14:page27:1
contexts.japanese: と。
contexts.english: Sakura's response is entirely serious.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-14:page27:1
contexts.japanese: 面白半分で聞いたコトに、桜は真剣な顔で答えていた。
contexts.english: I was only asking half-jokingly, but her response seems to have been in earnest.

findings.description: Self-suggestion is expressed with malformed spell idiom.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou mutters the familiar incantation as though applying autosuggestion to himself, then corrects that it truly is nothing more than autosuggestion.
findings.explanation: Self-suggestion is expressed with malformed spell idiom.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page2:1
contexts.japanese: 自己に暗示をかけるよう、言い慣れた呪文を呟く。
contexts.english: I mutter the familiar incantation, as if putting myself in a spell.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page2:1
contexts.japanese: 否、それは本当に自己暗示にすぎない。
contexts.english: No, this is a kind of hypnosis.

findings.description: The first occurrence of 'user of magecraft' becomes 'mage,' weakening its connection to Kiritsugu's later distinction. The English does preserve that distinction when Kiritsugu explains it explicitly.
findings.sourceReading: Connecting the circuit makes Shirou a practitioner of magecraft. Later, Kiritsugu expressly distinguishes that status from being a mage through the purpose for which he uses it.
findings.explanation: The first occurrence of 'user of magecraft' becomes 'mage,' weakening its connection to Kiritsugu's later distinction. The English does preserve that distinction when Kiritsugu explains it explicitly.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page4:1
contexts.japanese: これを体の奥まで通し、他の神経と繋げられた時、ようやく自分は魔術使いとなる。
contexts.english: By passing this deep within my body and connecting it to my other nerves, I can finally be a mage.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page22:1
contexts.japanese: 一番大事な事はね、魔術は自分の為じゃなくて他人の為だけに使う、という事だよ。そうすれば士郎は魔術使いではあるけど、魔術師ではなくなるからね—
contexts.english: The most important thing is that you always remember that magecraft is to be used for others, and not for yourself. And that would make you simply a user of magecraft, rather than a mage.

findings.description: The single circuit's poker-like, intangible form becomes a series of metal rods. The English retains qualified invisibility, so the problem is added multiplicity and concreteness rather than straightforward visibility.
findings.sourceReading: The preceding single circuit is described as an invisible, untouchable thing resembling a fire poker or tongs. Its insertion is expressly not merely metaphorical.
findings.explanation: The single circuit's poker-like, intangible form becomes a series of metal rods. The English retains qualified invisibility, so the problem is added multiplicity and concreteness rather than straightforward visibility.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page4:1
contexts.japanese: その鉄の棒こそ、たった一本だけ用意できる自分の“魔術回路”だ。
contexts.english: The steel rod itself is the one and only Magic Circuit I can prepare for myself.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page5:1
contexts.japanese: それは比喩ではない。
contexts.english: This is not a metaphor.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page5:1
contexts.japanese: 実際、衛宮士郎の背骨には、目に見えず手に触れられない“火箸に似たモノ”が、ズブズブと差し込まれている。
contexts.english: And if you look closely, a series of metal rods, which cannot normally be seen or touched, pierce my backbone.

findings.description: Required magical knowledge becomes a tremendous inherited body of knowledge.
findings.sourceReading: One cannot simply decide to become a mage: inborn talent and knowledge appropriate to the discipline are necessary.
findings.explanation: Required magical knowledge becomes a tremendous inherited body of knowledge.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page7:1
contexts.japanese: だが、魔術師というのはなろうとしてなれる物ではない。持って生まれた才能が必要だし、相応の知識も必要になってくる。
contexts.english: But you can't just become a mage; you have to be born with talent, and inherit a tremendous amount of knowledge.

findings.description: The neither-nor account of Shirou's disadvantages is grammatically malformed.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou had neither an abundance of inborn Magic Circuits nor the accumulated magical craft of generations.
findings.explanation: The neither-nor account of Shirou's disadvantages is grammatically malformed.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page9:1
contexts.japanese: しかし、持って生まれた才能—魔術回路とやらの多さも、代々積み重ねてきた魔術の業も俺にはなかった。
contexts.english: I was blessed neither with talent—that is, an abundance of Magic Circuits within me—nor was generations of magecraft knowledge handed down to me.

findings.description: Taking a chance with one's remaining aptitude becomes simply acquiring ability.
findings.sourceReading: Without crest or inherited craft, Shirou is left to make do, play it by ear or take his chances with his own traits.
findings.explanation: Taking a chance with one's remaining aptitude becomes simply acquiring ability.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page12:1
contexts.japanese: で、そうなるとあとはもう出たトコ勝負。
contexts.english: It's just a matter of gaining the ability.

findings.description: Training the one usable discipline disappears from Shirou's route to becoming like Kiritsugu.
findings.sourceReading: Even someone like Shirou has about one form of magecraft he can use, and by training that discipline he might someday become like Kiritsugu.
findings.explanation: Training the one usable discipline disappears from Shirou's route to becoming like Kiritsugu.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page18:1
contexts.japanese: 確かな事は、俺みたいなヤツでも一つぐらいは使える魔術があって、それを鍛えていけば、いつか切嗣のようになれるかもしれない、という事だけだった。
contexts.english: What I do understand is that even someone like me can use at least one form of magecraft. If I can do that, then maybe I can be like Kiritsugu.

findings.description: Just under an hour becomes a little over an hour.
findings.sourceReading: Reestablishing the connection and making one pseudo-nerve takes slightly less than one hour.
findings.explanation: Just under an hour becomes a little over an hour.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page25:1
contexts.japanese: ……ここまでで、一時間弱。
contexts.english: I've been working on this for a little over an hour.

findings.description: Strengthening hardness becomes strengthening durability.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou attempts the simplest form of Strengthening: increasing the broken iron pipe's hardness.
findings.explanation: Strengthening hardness becomes strengthening durability.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page29:1
contexts.japanese: これに魔力を通し、もっとも単純な硬度強化の魔術を成し得る。
contexts.english: I pass magical energy through it to execute the most basic magecraft, to enhance its durability.

findings.description: A dozens-fold archery comparison becomes exactly tenfold.
findings.sourceReading: Ordinary kyudo distance is twenty-eight meters, while Shirou likens the task to hitting a target hundreds of meters away—many tens of times the difficulty.
findings.explanation: A dozens-fold archery comparison becomes exactly tenfold.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page31:1
contexts.japanese: ……熟練した魔術師ならば容易いのだろうが、魔力の生成さえ満足にいかない自分にとって、それは何百メートル先の標的を射抜くぐらいの難易度だ。
contexts.english: This may be easy for a skilled mage, but since I have a hard time generating magical energy in the first place, even a task like this is as difficult as shooting an arrow and hitting a target several hundred meters from you.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page31:1
contexts.japanese: ちなみに、弓道における一射は二十八メートル。
contexts.english: A typical archery target is twenty-eight meters away.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page31:1
contexts.japanese: その何十倍という難易度と言えば、それがどのくらい困難であるかは言うまでもない—
contexts.english: So it goes without saying how hard it would be to hit a target at ten times that distance.

findings.description: The artwork analogy becomes malformed and assigns intention to a paintbrush.
