counterexamples.description: Rin adjusts to Shirou's steady rhythm.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She performs the matching while he maintains constancy.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin adjusts to Shirou's steady rhythm.

contexts.japanese: 合わせるのは遠坂の方で、こちらは一定のリズムを保ち続ける
contexts.english: She's adjusting her pulse to match mine, while I maintain a steady rhythm.

counterexamples.description: The path remains one-way from Rin.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin can send mana; Shirou cannot return it.
counterexamples.explanation: The path remains one-way from Rin.

contexts.japanese: 基本的にはわたしから士郎への一方通行
contexts.english: It's basically a one-way path from me to you

counterexamples.description: The overheating limit survives the mana increase.
counterexamples.sourceReading: More fuel does not remove the cheap vehicle's load limit.
counterexamples.explanation: The overheating limit survives the mana increase.

contexts.japanese: いくら燃料があっても乗り物が安物ならオーバーヒートする
contexts.english: a cheap vehicle will overheat no matter how much fuel there is

counterexamples.description: Mana depletion remains paradoxically protective.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The tentacles pause because prey is docile, and Rin has no mana left to mark her as food; detecting poison would trigger them.
counterexamples.explanation: Mana depletion remains paradoxically protective.

contexts.japanese: 獲物が大人しいからこそ停止している
contexts.english: have stopped because their prey is docile.

counterexamples.description: The third Projection's safety remains uncertain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The first caused paralysis, the second caused no impairment, and the third has no guarantee.
counterexamples.explanation: The third Projection's safety remains uncertain.

contexts.japanese: 三度目も同じという保証はない
contexts.english: There's no guarantee that the third time will be the same

counterexamples.description: Mind's Eye remains acquired through training and distinct from Saber's instinct.
counterexamples.sourceReading: It is an experienced ordinary person's weapon, not an innate extraordinary faculty like Saber's Intuition.
counterexamples.explanation: Mind's Eye remains acquired through training and distinct from Saber's instinct.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの持つ『直感』のような先天的な物ではなく
contexts.english: It is not innate like Saber's instinct

counterexamples.description: Aias's no-known-spear limit remains bounded by Archer's knowledge.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The claim is only that Archer knows of no spear able to break through this shield.
counterexamples.explanation: Aias's no-known-spear limit remains bounded by Archer's knowledge.

contexts.japanese: 少なくとも使用者であるアーチャーが知る限り
contexts.english: At the very least, Archer does not know of any spear

counterexamples.description: The shield's destruction and magical cost survive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Aias is completely destroyed after Archer spends most of his magical energy; it was his strongest defense.
counterexamples.explanation: The shield's destruction and magical cost survive.

contexts.japanese: 魔力の大部分を消費したというのに腕をやられ、アイアスも完全に破壊された。
contexts.english: I used up most of my magical energy, one of my arms is destroyed, and Aias is completely shattered.

counterexamples.description: Circuit-like bodily erosion remains distinct from magical-energy consumption.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Each new sword feels as though one of Shirou's scarce circuits disappears, and the narration explicitly denies that this is ordinary magical-energy use.
counterexamples.explanation: Circuit-like bodily erosion remains distinct from magical-energy consumption.

contexts.japanese: 魔力を消費しているのとは違う。
contexts.english: It's different from using up magical energy.

counterexamples.description: Rin's limit violation and conditional church destruction survive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She exceeds her own capacity despite having forbidden Shirou to do so, and the attack would destroy the church if Caster did not defend.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's limit violation and conditional church destruction survive.

contexts.japanese: キャスターが守りに入らなければ聖堂はおろか教会ごと崩壊するであろう
contexts.english: would destroy not only the sanctuary but the entire church had Caster not defended against it

counterexamples.description: Caster swallowing all of Rin's magic survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She does more than cancel the attack: she absorbs all its magical energy into her robe.
counterexamples.explanation: Caster swallowing all of Rin's magic survives.

contexts.japanese: その全てを衣の中に呑み込んだのだ。
contexts.english: Caster had swallowed all of her magical energy into her robe.

counterexamples.description: The bidirectional relation between summoning age and origin age survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Guardians can be summoned into every age and can be summoned from present, past, or unseen future.
counterexamples.explanation: The bidirectional relation between summoning age and origin age survives.

contexts.japanese: まだ見ぬ未来からですら、英霊となるモノなら呼び出せる
contexts.english: Heroic Spirits can even be summoned from the future we have not yet seen.

counterexamples.description: Rin’s physical and magical restraints remain distinct.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Hands and ankles are bound behind/to the chair, while anti-magecraft disrupts circuits and blocks energy production.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin’s physical and magical restraints remain distinct.

contexts.japanese: 魔術回路の働きがメチャクチャで魔力も生成できない
contexts.english: my Magic Circuit is so messed up that I can't even create magical energy.

counterexamples.description: The all-books-at-once and future-record model survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Past and future do not order the records; all books are present from the start, including future cleanup knowledge.
counterexamples.explanation: The all-books-at-once and future-record model survives.

contexts.japanese: 彼の部屋には初めから全ての『本』がある。
contexts.english: All the "books" are already in his room.

counterexamples.description: The English preserves the single-pendant deduction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou realizes there cannot be two pendants.
counterexamples.explanation: The English preserves the single-pendant deduction.

contexts.japanese: あのペンダントが二つある筈がない。
contexts.english: there can't be two pendants.

counterexamples.description: The reverse-catalyst mechanism remains explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: A summon can occur when the Heroic Spirit possesses an object connected to the summoner.
counterexamples.explanation: The reverse-catalyst mechanism remains explicit.

contexts.japanese: 呼び出された英霊そのものが、召喚者に縁のある触媒を持っていた場合のみだ
contexts.english: This only happened because the Heroic Spirit had a catalyst connecting itself to the summoner.

counterexamples.description: The duel as a contest in making swords is preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Archer says fighting him means competing in 剣製, the production of swords.
counterexamples.explanation: The duel as a contest in making swords is preserved.

contexts.japanese: オレと戦うという事は、剣製を競い合うという事だと
contexts.english: A battle with me means a sword-making competition.

counterexamples.description: Archer's technique remains optimized for Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The method was developed over years into the combat form best suited to Emiya Shirou.
counterexamples.explanation: Archer's technique remains optimized for Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎にとって最適の戦闘方法
contexts.english: the most optimal combat techniques for Shirou Emiya

counterexamples.description: The five-used and three-remaining estimate is preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Archer counts the fifth projected copy and estimates three remain at Shirou's current capacity.
counterexamples.explanation: The five-used and three-remaining estimate is preserved.

contexts.japanese: その様では残り三本。
contexts.english: You look like you have three left

counterexamples.description: The previous-life possession magic remains an analogy, not a ritual being performed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Archer says he has heard of such Evocation and compares it to Shirou gaining skill through exchanges.
counterexamples.explanation: The previous-life possession magic remains an analogy, not a ritual being performed.

contexts.japanese: 前世の自分を降霊、憑依させる事で、かつての技術を修得する魔術があると聞く
contexts.english: I've heard of Evocations where the user is possessed by a previous life to learn their past skills

counterexamples.description: Avalon's protection continuing after contract severance is preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Archer identifies Saber's sheath as still protecting Shirou after their contract ended.
counterexamples.explanation: Avalon's protection continuing after contract severance is preserved.

contexts.japanese: 契約が切れたところで、その守護は続いている
contexts.english: It still protects you, even when your contract is cut

counterexamples.description: Avalon's healing remains limited rather than a full recovery.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Cuts are beginning to heal while broken bones remain and Shirou questions the priority rule.
counterexamples.explanation: Avalon's healing remains limited rather than a full recovery.

contexts.japanese: 折れた骨は後回しらしい。
contexts.english: broken bones seem to be a lower priority.

counterexamples.description: The Grail-as-path and Master-as-anchor distinction is preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The Grail opens the route, while a mage anchor and continued energy can sustain manifestation afterward.
counterexamples.explanation: The Grail-as-path and Master-as-anchor distinction is preserved.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯はあくまで道を通したにすぎん。
contexts.english: The Grail is no more than the path we take to get here.

counterexamples.description: Gilgamesh's incarnation and lack of need for maintenance theft are preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He admits the extraction method but reveals that bathing in the Grail incarnated him ten years ago, making it unnecessary.
counterexamples.explanation: Gilgamesh's incarnation and lack of need for maintenance theft are preserved.

contexts.japanese: 実を言えばそのような手間も要らなかった
contexts.english: as it turned out, I didn't even need to bother.

counterexamples.description: The five, six, and seven Servant thresholds remain distinct.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Five have been absorbed; one more makes six and an omnipotent-scale reservoir, while seven reaches the origin.
counterexamples.explanation: The five, six, and seven Servant thresholds remain distinct.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯が汲み取ったサーヴァントは五人。
contexts.english: The Holy Grail has absorbed five Servants.

counterexamples.description: The prior Grail spill causing the city fire is preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber split the Grail and what spilled from it became flame that burned the city.
counterexamples.explanation: The prior Grail spill causing the city fire is preserved.

contexts.japanese: こぼれおちたモノは炎となって街を焼き払った。
contexts.english: what spilled out set fire to the town.

counterexamples.description: Shinji states the heart/circuit vessel requirement accurately.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The child's heart alone is insufficient and must connect to superior Magic Circuits.
counterexamples.explanation: Shinji states the heart/circuit vessel requirement accurately.

contexts.japanese: 優れた魔術回路に繋げないと聖杯にならない
contexts.english: It won't turn into a Holy Grail unless we connect it to quality Magic Circuits

counterexamples.description: Avoiding deformation remains conditional on a powerful mage host.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Gilgamesh speculates that a strong magus probably would not transform this way.
counterexamples.explanation: Avoiding deformation remains conditional on a powerful mage host.

contexts.japanese: 力ある魔術師ならば変貌する事もないだろう
contexts.english: A powerful mage wouldn't have morphed like this

counterexamples.description: The defective Grail remains incomplete and predicted to finish later.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Growth and decay currently balance; adaptation should let growth win, completing the Grail soon.
counterexamples.explanation: The defective Grail remains incomplete and predicted to finish later.

contexts.japanese: そう時を待たずして、彼の聖杯は完成するだろう。
contexts.english: his Holy Grail will soon be complete.

counterexamples.description: Abundant supply and bodily instability both remain explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Ten or twenty Projections are easy in energy terms, but Shirou's worn body may leak or explode under the excess.
counterexamples.explanation: Abundant supply and bodily instability both remain explicit.

contexts.japanese: 気を抜くと燃料が漏れて爆発しかねない。
contexts.english: I'll spring a fuel leak and explode if I lose focus.

counterexamples.description: Assassin clearly distinguishes Caster from his current-era gate anchor.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Caster summoned him, but the gate is the host equivalent that binds him to the land.
counterexamples.explanation: Assassin clearly distinguishes Caster from his current-era gate anchor.

contexts.japanese: 私にとっては、それがこの山門という事になる
contexts.english: For me, this mountain gate is equivalent to the hosts you call Masters.

counterexamples.description: Assassin's summoning basis remains his demonstrated secret technique.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He was summoned solely because he could perform the secret sword attributed to Kojirou.
counterexamples.explanation: Assassin's summoning basis remains his demonstrated secret technique.

contexts.japanese: 秘剣を披露出来る、という一点で呼び出された亡霊
contexts.english: a wraith summoned here for my ability to demonstrate the secret technique

counterexamples.description: The host must ordinarily remain alive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Although Shinji is unsuitable, the Grail fundamentally operates through a living human host.
counterexamples.explanation: The host must ordinarily remain alive.

contexts.japanese: 宿主に生きていてもらわないと作動しない
contexts.english: needs a living host to function.

counterexamples.description: A broken vessel is distinguished from a wish-granting Grail.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If the host fails, there is no Grail function—only unknown contents flowing from the opened hole.
counterexamples.explanation: A broken vessel is distinguished from a wish-granting Grail.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯も何もない。
contexts.english: there won't be any Holy Grail.

counterexamples.description: Freezing formed curse-magecraft remains difficult for specialists rather than universally impossible.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even a freezing specialist would struggle to freeze magical energy already processed into embodied curse-magecraft.
counterexamples.explanation: Freezing formed curse-magecraft remains difficult for specialists rather than universally impossible.

contexts.japanese: 氷結専門の術者でも難しい
contexts.english: Even a freezing specialist would have a hard time

counterexamples.description: Saber releases the bounded concealment and reveals her sword without firing its great attack.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She creates distance, dispels the barrier, and openly readies full strength if necessary.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber releases the bounded concealment and reveals her sword without firing its great attack.

contexts.japanese: 自らの剣を露わにして
contexts.english: Her sword is revealed

counterexamples.description: Rin postpones interpreting the incarnated matter's resemblance to Servants.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She observes the similarity, starts to consider its meaning, and stops because rescue takes priority.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin postpones interpreting the incarnated matter's resemblance to Servants.

contexts.japanese: 考えようとして凛は思考を止めた。
contexts.english: She tries to make sense of it, but stops.

counterexamples.description: Energy supply and circuit failure remain distinct.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin supplies ample magical energy, but Shirou's circuits and body cannot carry the load.
counterexamples.explanation: Energy supply and circuit failure remain distinct.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂からの供給は半端じゃない。
contexts.english: Tohsaka's supply has been more than enough.

counterexamples.description: Seventeen designs and one-at-a-time materialization remain distinct.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou prepares seventeen, but can give them form only sequentially against a simultaneous volley.
counterexamples.explanation: Seventeen designs and one-at-a-time materialization remain distinct.

contexts.japanese: 自分に出来るのは一本ずつカタチにするだけ。
contexts.english: I can only give form to them one at a time.

counterexamples.description: The reason Saber cannot deploy her Noble Phantasm remains attack timing at this range.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Once inside the interval, Swallow Reversal will take her head before she can charge the sacred sword with magical energy.
counterexamples.explanation: The reason Saber cannot deploy her Noble Phantasm remains attack timing at this range.

contexts.japanese: 聖剣に魔力を籠めた時点で彼女の首は跳んでいる。
contexts.english: Her head will surely fly while she tries to put magical energy in her sword.

counterexamples.description: Ea still destroys exactly six Noble Phantasms and severs Shirou's body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The blow breaks the six defensive copies and cuts through Shirou, followed by his surprise that his limbs remain attached.
counterexamples.explanation: Ea still destroys exactly six Noble Phantasms and severs Shirou's body.

contexts.japanese: 都合六つの宝具を粉砕して、俺の体を切断した。
contexts.english: annihilates six Noble Phantasms, and severs my body.

counterexamples.description: Shirou limits his rescue horizon to the world visible to him before recognizing that small world as his magic.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He resolves to fight if he can save even the world he can see, then identifies the small world he alone can produce.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou limits his rescue horizon to the world visible to him before recognizing that small world as his magic.

contexts.japanese: 自分に見える世界だけでも救えるのなら、その為に戦おうと。
contexts.english: If I could save just the world that I can see, I'll fight for it.

counterexamples.description: Shirou remains uncertain about how quickly the memorized incantation will affect him.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin's supply makes the method feasible, but actual activation speed is unknown until he attempts it.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou remains uncertain about how quickly the memorized incantation will affect him.

contexts.japanese: どれだけ速く自身に働きかけられるかは、やってみないと判らない
contexts.english: I don't know how fast I can get it to work for me unless I try.

counterexamples.description: Gilgamesh's ordinary weapons remain overwhelmingly lethal despite looking third-rate beside Ea.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The ranking is relative to Ea; surviving it does not make Shirou's normal Projection sufficient against Gilgamesh.
counterexamples.explanation: Gilgamesh's ordinary weapons remain overwhelmingly lethal despite looking third-rate beside Ea.

contexts.japanese: 投影魔術を武器にする衛宮士郎では、あのサーヴァントに敵うべくもない。
contexts.english: I'm no match against that Servant with just my Projection.

counterexamples.description: Strengthening and Projection remain by-products of Shirou's one actual magic.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin's explanation returns: those familiar operations arise along the way toward materializing his inner world.
counterexamples.explanation: Strengthening and Projection remain by-products of Shirou's one actual magic.

contexts.japanese: 強化も投影も、その途中で出来ている副産物にすぎないと。
contexts.english: Strengthening and Projection are just by-products of what I actually do.

counterexamples.description: Damage to the seven-petal shield still feeds back into Shirou's body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The shield is Shirou himself; every cracked or broken layer removes part of his body.
counterexamples.explanation: Damage to the seven-petal shield still feeds back into Shirou's body.

contexts.japanese: 七枚羽の盾がひび割れ、砕かれるたびに体が欠けていく。
contexts.english: The seven petal shield cracks, and my body chips away with every fracture.

counterexamples.description: The scene distinguishes the absent circuit limit from a bodily limit beyond the unseen darkness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou revises his model of the blockage and advances toward the larger circuit structure; the prose still names a limit of this body beyond it.
counterexamples.explanation: The scene distinguishes the absent circuit limit from a bodily limit beyond the unseen darkness.

contexts.japanese: その闇の先に、この身体の限度がある—
contexts.english: Then the limit is somewhere beyond the darkness.

counterexamples.description: Unlimited Blade Works remains the creation of a world containing infinite swords.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou does not merely manufacture individual blades; his only permitted magecraft gives form to the inner world that contains them without limit.
counterexamples.explanation: Unlimited Blade Works remains the creation of a world containing infinite swords.

contexts.japanese: 俺は、無限に剣を内包した世界を作る。
contexts.english: I create a world that contains infinite swords.

counterexamples.description: Shirou's opening claim that a fake can surpass the real thing remains intact.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He accepts the counterfeit label and turns it into the tactical and thematic premise for defeating the original owner.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou's opening claim that a fake can surpass the real thing remains intact.

contexts.japanese: 偽物が本物に敵わない、なんて道理はない。
contexts.english: There's no rule or reason a fake can't best the real thing.

counterexamples.description: The shed’s copies remain explicitly hollow replicas.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin diagnoses objects that persist but lack the contents a proper Projection should have.
counterexamples.explanation: The shed’s copies remain explicitly hollow replicas.

contexts.japanese: 中身のない複製品
contexts.english: replicas without anything inside

counterexamples.description: Rin’s specimen-box warning remains literal and completely serious.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Other magi would pin Shirou under glass as a specimen; narration confirms she is not joking.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin’s specimen-box warning remains literal and completely serious.

contexts.japanese: 冗談にしか聞こえない遠坂の言葉は、その実、本気以外の何物でもなかった。
contexts.english: Tohsaka's words sound like a joke, but she's completely serious.

counterexamples.description: Shirou continues mistaking Rin’s Projection discussion for Strengthening.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Their crossed understanding persists until she shouts the correction.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou continues mistaking Rin’s Projection discussion for Strengthening.

contexts.japanese: 強化じゃなくて投影の方に決まってるでしょ！？
contexts.english: It's obvious I'm talking about Projection, not Strengthening!

counterexamples.description: Rin’s external-world versus inner-world reproduction diagnosis remains her argument.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She contrasts magi like herself, whose external operations may be irreproducible, with Shirou supplying all material from within.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin’s external-world versus inner-world reproduction diagnosis remains her argument.

contexts.japanese: アンタは材料を全部内界から出してきてるんだから
contexts.english: you're getting all the required materials from your inner world

counterexamples.description: Shirou’s misunderstanding of “inner world” remains visible.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He reduces Rin’s claim about material origin to the ordinary fact that circuits generate magical energy within the body.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou’s misunderstanding of “inner world” remains visible.

contexts.japanese: そんなの当たり前じゃないか。
contexts.english: But isn't that obvious?

counterexamples.description: The porch remains specially warm enough for winter moon viewing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Despite opening the shutters, only this porch retains relative warmth associated with the old night.
counterexamples.explanation: The porch remains specially warm enough for winter moon viewing.

contexts.japanese: この縁側だけは、冬でも月見ができるぐらい温かい。
contexts.english: This porch is the only place warm enough to be able to watch the moon even during the winter.

counterexamples.description: Rin keeps mage and magecraft-user as distinct intended paths.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She infers that Kiritsugu wanted Shirou to use magecraft without becoming a lineage-bound magus.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin keeps mage and magecraft-user as distinct intended paths.

contexts.japanese: 魔術師じゃなくて魔術使いになれ
contexts.english: uses magecraft rather than to be a mage

counterexamples.description: The silent warning field remains Shirou’s basis for ruling out an openly hostile visitor.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His visitor guess is explicitly filtered through the field’s lack of alarm.
counterexamples.explanation: The silent warning field remains Shirou’s basis for ruling out an openly hostile visitor.

contexts.japanese: 結界が警告音を出さない
contexts.english: the alarm of my old man's Bounded Field isn't going off

counterexamples.description: Archer’s class-based independent movement remains a qualified exception.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Independent Action may let him force entry somewhat, not bypass all constraints freely.
counterexamples.explanation: Archer’s class-based independent movement remains a qualified exception.

contexts.japanese: 多少の無理は利くでしょうが
contexts.english: may be able to manage to get in by force.

counterexamples.description: The former single-digit Strengthening success rate and Shirou’s initial Master hypothesis survive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He first wonders whether becoming a Master explains the sudden ease, then rejects that explanation.
counterexamples.explanation: The former single-digit Strengthening success rate and Shirou’s initial Master hypothesis survive.

contexts.japanese: マスターになったからなのか、成功率一桁だった強化は難なく行える
contexts.english: I don't know if it's because I became a Master, but Strengthening got a lot easier. I used to only have a success rate in the single digits.

counterexamples.description: Kiritsugu remains unlike a mage, while Shirou calls him a Magician.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou’s personal value distinction between ordinary magecraft identity and true wonder remains visible.
counterexamples.explanation: Kiritsugu remains unlike a mage, while Shirou calls him a Magician.

contexts.japanese: 俺にとっては切嗣こそが本当の魔法使いだったんだ。
contexts.english: he was a Magician to me.

counterexamples.description: The circuit distinction between making and revealing is directly retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Archer says circuits are not remade for every use; once made, they are brought to the surface or not.
counterexamples.explanation: The circuit distinction between making and revealing is directly retained.

contexts.japanese: 魔術回路とは作るものではなく表すものだ。
contexts.english: Magic Circuits are not something you make each time, but something you reveal.

counterexamples.description: Saber explicitly corrects the idea that recovery is completely absent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She generates some energy through her own circuits despite no external supply.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber explicitly corrects the idea that recovery is completely absent.

contexts.japanese: まったく回復しない、という訳ではありません。
contexts.english: It does not mean that energy is never restored.

counterexamples.description: The faucet model preserves the dependence of generation rate on remaining reserves and shutdown at zero.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Residual energy permits continued generation; exhaustion closes the faucet and risks disappearance.
counterexamples.explanation: The faucet model preserves the dependence of generation rate on remaining reserves and shutdown at zero.

contexts.japanese: 魔力を使い切った時、蛇口は完全に閉まってしまう
contexts.english: when I use up my magical energy—the faucet will completely shut off.

counterexamples.explanation: Servant combat exposed as redundant procedure.

contexts.english: "I see. Then I don't need to explain that the reality is the other way around, right? What about you, Shirou? Did you notice that the entire premise of having Servants fight each other is unnecessary?"

counterexamples.sourceReading: Defeated Heroic Spirits are collected rather than disappearing.
counterexamples.explanation: Absorbed souls prompt the objection.

counterexamples.explanation: Masters as tools versus needed spirits retained.

contexts.english: "...You're saying that the Holy Grail War only needs the Heroic Spirits, and that the Masters are tools to summon them...?"

counterexamples.sourceReading: Masters serve as summoning receptors and are expendable afterward.
counterexamples.explanation: Receptor ruby and post-summoning expendability retained.

contexts.english: "Yeah. In the Holy Grail War ritual, Masters are nothing but receptors for the Servants. As long as they can summon the Servants, it doesn't matter if they all die afterward.

counterexamples.sourceReading: Souls external to the time axis and local laws can still affect the world.
counterexamples.explanation: Spirits’ outside-time power retained.

contexts.english: They are pure souls which exist outside the time axis, separate from the world's laws, yet have power from outside the world which allows them to interfere with our world. That is the true essence of Heroic Spirits."

counterexamples.sourceReading: Outward rules conceal purpose and sustain mutual slaughter.
counterexamples.explanation: False contest deceives both Masters and Servants.

contexts.japanese: それを隠す為に聖杯戦争なんて表向きのルールを作って、サーヴァントとマスターを騙して、今まで殺し合いを続けさせた」
contexts.english: So, they came up with the Holy Grail War scheme to trick Servants and Masters into killing each other. It is a scheme that continues to this day."

counterexamples.description: Founders’ convenient elimination of collaborators retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Formal competition legally disposes of outsiders.
counterexamples.explanation: Founders’ convenient elimination of collaborators retained.

contexts.japanese: 三家にとってみれば、自分たち以外の協力者を合法的に始末できるんだから、都合が良かったのよ」
contexts.english: From the perspective of the founding families, it was a legal and convenient way to eliminate the other collaborators."

counterexamples.description: Obtain Grail versus use Grail to go outside retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The ritual’s final purpose reverses the apparent prize contest.
counterexamples.explanation: Obtain Grail versus use Grail to go outside retained.

contexts.japanese: ……要するに、聖杯戦争とは聖杯を手に入れる為の戦いではなく、聖杯を用いて外に出る為の儀式だった。
contexts.english: ...In other words, the Holy Grail War ritual wasn't meant to obtain the Holy Grail, but to use it to go outside of the world.

counterexamples.description: Cosmological account retains report qualifiers.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Arcane studies say a pinnacle power exists outside the world.
counterexamples.explanation: Cosmological account retains report qualifiers.

contexts.japanese: 神秘学によると、この世界の外側には次元論の頂点に在るという“力”がある。
contexts.english: According to studies of the arcane, a power said to be the pinnacle of dimensional theory is located outside of this world.

counterexamples.description: Rin’s excitement at taboo Third Magic retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She protests dismissal of exceptionally secret magical knowledge.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin’s excitement at taboo Third Magic retained.

contexts.japanese: 「か、関係ないって、魔法よ魔法！？　しかも三番目の魔法なんて、協会でもずっと秘密にされてきた禁忌中の禁忌じゃないっ！
contexts.english: "I-irrelevant!? This is Magic we're talking about! The Third Magic, no less! It's a taboo of taboos which the Association has kept under wraps forever!

counterexamples.description: Greater location versus human Lesser vessels retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He distinguishes the circle from Illya and Sakura while asking where the unknown entity is.
counterexamples.explanation: Greater location versus human Lesser vessels retained.

contexts.japanese: その何かっていうのが復讐者ってヤツなのか。そいつは聖杯……イリヤや桜の中じゃなく、大聖杯とかいう魔法陣の中にいると……？」
contexts.english: It's gotta be that Avenger thing you mentioned. Is it inside the Holy Grail? Not inside you or Sakura, but the Greater Grail?"

counterexamples.description: Becoming living form framed as ongoing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Avenger is on its way toward a successful Third Magic case.
counterexamples.explanation: Becoming living form framed as ongoing.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯の力で『生命』としてカタチを得ようとしている、第三魔法の成功例になりつつある英霊よ」
contexts.english: It's a Heroic Spirit that's on its way to becoming a successful case of the Third Magic, using the power of the Grail to acquire a shape as a living creature."

counterexamples.description: Innate attributes limit the Grail success claim.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Avenger’s materialization rests on its own preexisting attributes.
counterexamples.explanation: Innate attributes limit the Grail success claim.

contexts.japanese: 「いいえ、復讐者の物質化は、聖杯による魔法じゃない。アレはもとからそういう属性をもった英霊だった。
contexts.english: "No, Avenger's materialization doesn't use the Magic of the Holy Grail. It's a Heroic Spirit who's always innately had those attributes.

counterexamples.description: First failure and early second defeat motivate third gamble.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Einzbern desperation precedes summoning a killing-specialized spirit.
counterexamples.explanation: First failure and early second defeat motivate third gamble.

contexts.japanese: 一度目は失敗、二度目に序盤で敗れ去ったアインツベルンは追い詰められて、ただ殺す事だけに特化した英霊を召喚したの」
contexts.english: After failing in the first war and being eliminated early in the second, the Einzberns got desperate and summoned a Heroic Spirit specialized at killing."

counterexamples.description: Forbidden summon for monopoly retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kill other Masters, force activation, and monopolize results motivate the summon.
counterexamples.explanation: Forbidden summon for monopoly retained.

contexts.japanese: 他のマスターたちを皆殺しにして、問答無用で大聖杯を起動させ、成果を独り占めする為に呼んではならないモノを呼び寄せてしまった。
contexts.english: They summoned something forbidden in order to kill all the other Masters, force the Greater Grail to activate, and monopolize the spoils.

counterexamples.description: Source’s Persian devil account and nine-thousand-year span retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narrator reports the source’s light-versus-evil conflict.
counterexamples.explanation: Source’s Persian devil account and nine-thousand-year span retained.

contexts.japanese: 拝火教における最大の悪魔であり、人間の善性を守護する光明神と九千年間戦い続けるという、悪性の容認者。
contexts.english: It's the greatest devil of Zoroastrianism—an advocate of evil that has been battling for nine thousand years against the light god safeguarding humanity's goodness.

counterexamples.description: Rin rejects divine-scale summoning account.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Grail summons Heroic Spirits; divine-scale recreation would make it unnecessary.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin rejects divine-scale summoning account.

contexts.japanese: 「そんな訳ないでしょうイリヤ。聖杯は英霊しか呼べないし、そんな神霊レベルの現象を再現できるんなら聖杯なんて必要ない。
contexts.english: "That can't be true, Illya. The Holy Grail only summons Heroic Spirits, and if they were able to recreate Divine Spirit-level phenomena, then they wouldn't need the Holy Grail.

counterexamples.description: Nameless human versus literal devil retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: A title-bearing hero existed without being a literal devil in life.
counterexamples.explanation: Nameless human versus literal devil retained.

contexts.japanese: ……彼は確かに無名であったし、真実悪魔などではなかった。けれど、アンリマユの名を冠した英雄は確かに存在したの」
contexts.english: ...It's true he was nameless and not a literal devil. But a hero bearing the title of Aŋra Mainiiu definitely existed."

counterexamples.description: Genuine world-peace wish retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Village sincerely sought universal peace.
counterexamples.explanation: Genuine world-peace wish retained.

contexts.japanese: その村落の人たちはね、本気で世界中みんなが平和である事を望んでいた。
contexts.english: The people of that village genuinely wished for world peace.

counterexamples.description: Scapegoat logic explicitly a childish belief.
counterexamples.sourceReading: They sincerely believed concentrating evil in one person would absolve others.
counterexamples.explanation: Scapegoat logic explicitly a childish belief.

contexts.japanese: そんな子供みたいに単純なコトを、彼らは本気で信じてしまった」
contexts.english: They sincerely believed that simple, childish idea."

counterexamples.description: Captured body inscribed with curses retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Village selects and physically marks a victim and assigns evil deeds to him.
counterexamples.explanation: Captured body inscribed with curses retained.

contexts.japanese: 彼らは青年を捕らえ、その全身に人を呪うあらゆる言葉を刻み、彼らが知り得る全ての罪業を与え、全ての悪事を彼の責任とした。
contexts.english: They captured him and carved all manner of curses into his body. They charged him with every crime known to man, and blamed him for all evil deeds.

counterexamples.description: Killing corrected to denial of death retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya corrects killed until broken to never allowed merciful death until lifespan ended.
counterexamples.explanation: Killing corrected to denial of death retained.

contexts.japanese: 世界中の人々の善性を証明する為に、一人の青年を崩壊するまで殺し続けた。いえ、その寿命がつきるまで殺してなどあげなかった」
contexts.english: To prove the goodness of all the people in the world, they killed a young man until he broke. No, they refused to put him out of his misery until his life ran out."

counterexamples.description: Hatred and reverence coexist.
counterexamples.sourceReading: They curse, fear, and revere the scapegoat simultaneously.
counterexamples.explanation: Hatred and reverence coexist.

contexts.japanese: 「彼らは彼を心底呪い、侮蔑し、恐れ、同時に奉った。
contexts.english: "They cursed, scorned, and feared him, all while revering him.

counterexamples.description: Actual demon transformation left unknown.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya does not know if the process literally made him a demon.
counterexamples.explanation: Actual demon transformation left unknown.

contexts.japanese: 「その過程で、青年が本当に悪魔になったかどうかは知らない。
contexts.english: "I don't know if their process turned him into an actual demon.

counterexamples.description: His role supplies justification for their wrongdoing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His existence functions as an indulgence whatever evils they commit.
counterexamples.explanation: His role supplies justification for their wrongdoing.

contexts.japanese: その存在が在るだけで、どんなに人々が悪事を重ねようとも『清く正しい』と赦される免罪符。
contexts.english: His existence alone was a justification for other people to be forgiven, no matter what evils they committed.

counterexamples.description: If Illya is truthful limits inference.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou’s continued evil-bearing conclusion depends on her account being true.
counterexamples.explanation: If Illya is truthful limits inference.

contexts.japanese: イリヤの話が本当なら、アンリマユという英霊になったそいつは、今も人間の悪を背負い続けている事になる。
contexts.english: If what Illya is saying is true, the guy who became Aŋra Mainiiu would still bear the evil of humanity.

counterexamples.description: Revenge corrected to fulfilling imposed role.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He revises revenge into the duty wished by others and asks if Sakura is being used for it.
counterexamples.explanation: Revenge corrected to fulfilling imposed role.

contexts.japanese: 悪魔の名を冠したそいつは、自らを魔にしたてあげた人間への復讐……いや、人々が願った通りの役割をこなす為に、桜を利用しているというのか……？
contexts.english: Someone crowned with the name of a devil taking revenge on the people who turned him evil... No, is he using Sakura to carry out the duty that people wanted from him...?

counterexamples.description: Original human power cannot explain current monster.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin distinguishes label and treatment from actual capability.
counterexamples.explanation: Original human power cannot explain current monster.

contexts.japanese: けど、どうしてそいつが聖杯の中にいるワケ？　いいえ、そもそもそいつはただの人間でしょう？　いくら悪魔の名をつけられて、悪魔そのものとして扱われたとしても、能力は人間と変わらない。
contexts.english: But why is it inside the Holy Grail? I mean, isn't he just a human? Even if people label and treat him as a devil, his powers would be no different from a regular person.

counterexamples.description: Summoned spirit incredibly weak retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Original summoned Avenger is weak despite demon title.
counterexamples.explanation: Summoned spirit incredibly weak retained.

contexts.japanese: けど呼び出された英霊は、すごく弱かった。
contexts.english: But the Heroic Spirit they got was incredibly weak.

counterexamples.description: No own power and surrounding wishes retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Impossible spirit originates in others’ feelings, not intrinsic strength.
counterexamples.explanation: No own power and surrounding wishes retained.

contexts.japanese: ……もとから何の力も無く、周りの人間の想いだけで構成された、有り得ない筈のモノ。
contexts.english: ...He never had any power of his own. He was an impossibility created by the feelings of those around him.

counterexamples.description: Others’ wishes survive personality loss.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He was made hero by those around him and remains wished evil without personality.
counterexamples.explanation: Others’ wishes survive personality loss.

contexts.japanese: けどアンリマユは違った。彼は自分ではなく周りが願って創り上げた英雄。人格などなくとも、アンリマユである以上、悪であれと望まれる存在だった」
contexts.english: But Aŋra Mainiiu was different. He didn't become a hero on his own, but was made into one by the wishes of people around him. He was an existence which people wished to be evil, regardless of his own personality."

counterexamples.description: Absorption accepts a wish.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The Grail treats the absorbed wish-being as a wish to grant.
counterexamples.explanation: Absorption accepts a wish.

contexts.japanese: だから—アンリマユが聖杯に取り込まれた瞬間、聖杯は一つの願いを受諾してしまったの」
contexts.english: And that's why, the moment the Holy Grail absorbed Aŋra Mainiiu, it accepted a wish."

counterexamples.description: Five hundred and one thousand years comparison retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Makiri and Einzbern projects are contrasted with the older human ideal.
counterexamples.explanation: Five hundred and one thousand years comparison retained.

contexts.japanese: ……マキリの五百年、アインツベルンの一千年なんて子供だましよ。
contexts.english: ...The five centuries of the Makiris and the thousand years of the Einzberns are child's play,

counterexamples.description: Neutral Servant power feeds evil shell.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Other souls supply the energy for the shell to take form.
counterexamples.explanation: Neutral Servant power feeds evil shell.

contexts.japanese: アンリマユはサーヴァントたちの無色の魔力を糧に、自分の霊殻である“この世全ての悪”を体現してしまった。
contexts.english: Aŋra Mainiiu fed on the Servants' colorless power to manifest its shell, All the Evil in the World.

counterexamples.description: Gradual six-billion-curse capacity retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The developed Servant has the ability to curse the stated population.
counterexamples.explanation: Gradual six-billion-curse capacity retained.

contexts.japanese: 六十億の人間全てを呪う、六十億の人間全てを呪える宝具を備えたサーヴァントとして、少しずつ育っていったの」
contexts.english: He has gradually developed as a Servant who would curse six billion people, who possesses the ability to curse six billion people."

counterexamples.description: Kiritsugu’s knowledge remains unknown.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya cannot say how much he understood Avenger.
counterexamples.explanation: Kiritsugu’s knowledge remains unknown.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。キリツグがアンリマユというサーヴァントをどこまで理解していたかは判らない。
contexts.english: "Yes. I don't know how much Kiritsugu knew about the Servant Aŋra Mainiiu.

counterexamples.description: Kiritsugu destroys Lesser Grail to stop emergence.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Threatened Shadow exit motivates destruction of the vessel.
counterexamples.explanation: Kiritsugu destroys Lesser Grail to stop emergence.

contexts.japanese: けどキリツグは聖杯の外に出ようとしていた“黒い影”を危険視して、聖杯を破壊した」
contexts.english: But Kiritsugu saw the Shadow attempting to escape the Holy Grail as a threat, and destroyed the Lesser Grail."

counterexamples.description: Prevented birth leaves Avenger in Greater Grail.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kiritsugu’s decision interrupted emergence but did not erase the underlying entity.
counterexamples.explanation: Prevented birth leaves Avenger in Greater Grail.

contexts.japanese: 「けど、そのアンリマユはキリツグの英断で出産には至らず、大聖杯の中に残された。
contexts.english: "Still, Kiritsugu's decision prevented Aŋra Mainiiu's birth and left it inside the Greater Grail.

counterexamples.description: Sakura’s Master role intended for future control.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken made her Master to command the Servant when it emerges.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura’s Master role intended for future control.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯の中にいるサーヴァントが外に出てきた時、それを従えられるようサクラをマスターにしたのよ」
contexts.english: He made Sakura a Master so that she could control it if it ever emerged from the Holy Grail."

counterexamples.description: Shirou derives Servant contract as rescue opening.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He asks if Sakura is contracted with the established entity.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou derives Servant contract as rescue opening.

contexts.japanese: つまり桜は、アヴェンジャーというサーヴァントと契約している、という事になるのか……？
contexts.english: Does that mean Sakura is contracted with Aŋra Mainiiu...?

counterexamples.description: Soul-containing core worm enables body takeover.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His life extension depends on occupying bodies through that core.
counterexamples.explanation: Soul-containing core worm enables body takeover.

contexts.japanese: ……リンは知らないだろうけど、ゾウケンは自分の魂の容れ物である本体があれば、どんな人間の体だろうと自分のものにできる。いいえ、あいつはそうやって今まで生き長らえてきた。
contexts.english: ...You probably don't know that the core worm containing Zouken's soul can turn any human body into his own. That's how he's lived this long.

counterexamples.description: Illya key role versus Sakura host role retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He intends Illya to fulfill the Grail function while taking Sakura’s Master body.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya key role versus Sakura host role retained.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯としての役割はわたしにやらせて、自分はアンリマユのマスターになったサクラの体を乗っ取る」
contexts.english: He plans to make me fulfill the function of the Lesser Grail, while he takes over Sakura who's become Aŋra Mainiiu's Master."

counterexamples.description: Further Avenger takeover remains speculative analogy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken probably intends eventual materialized-soul host occupation; greed-degraded deity comparison follows.
counterexamples.explanation: Further Avenger takeover remains speculative analogy.

contexts.japanese: 「そうして—行く行くは、第三魔法の成功例、魂が物質化した架空の魔物に乗り換えるつもりなんでしょう。完全な神を、人間が自らの欲望で不完全な神に貶めるように」
contexts.english: "Then, he probably plans to take over the imaginary monster Aŋra Mainiiu once it succeeds in the Third Magic and materializes its soul. It's like a human's greed degrading a perfect god into an imperfect one."

counterexamples.description: Emergence threatens repeat of prior disaster.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If the entity comes out, the ten-years-earlier tragedy would recur.
counterexamples.explanation: Emergence threatens repeat of prior disaster.

contexts.japanese: そいつをこのまま外に出せば、十年前と同じ惨劇が起きてしまう。
contexts.english: If it comes out, it'll cause the same tragedy as ten years ago.

counterexamples.description: Two proposed options retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kill the Master or destroy Greater Grail before emergence.
counterexamples.explanation: Two proposed options retained.

contexts.japanese: で、その方法は二つだけ。
contexts.english: And there are two ways:

counterexamples.description: Separation proposal preserves rescue distinction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He agrees to fight Sakura while proposing separation from Avenger.
counterexamples.explanation: Separation proposal preserves rescue distinction.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだな。桜と戦って、アンリマユを引き離す。それが一番の近道だし、方針として判り易い」
contexts.english: "Yeah. We'll fight Sakura and separate her from Aŋra Mainiiu. That's the fastest and simplest way."

counterexamples.description: Illya’s account conditions impossibility claim.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If Avenger is as she says, humans cannot oppose it after emergence.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya’s account conditions impossibility claim.

contexts.japanese: 「……今はそれしかないだろう。アンリマユとやらがイリヤが言う通りのモノなら、人間に太刀打ちできるものじゃない。そいつを外に出した時点で俺たちの負けだ。
contexts.english: "...We don't have a choice right now. If Aŋra Mainiiu is what Illya says it is, then there's nothing humans can do about it. Once it gets out, we've lost.

counterexamples.description: Site inference follows briefing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin says one site matches Illya’s account and seeks confirmation.
counterexamples.explanation: Site inference follows briefing.

contexts.japanese: 「それなら問題ないわ。イリヤの言う事が正しいなら、大聖杯とやらの場所は一つしかない。そうでしょイリヤ？」
contexts.english: "No problem here. Based on what Illya said, the Greater Grail can only be in one place. Isn't that right?"

counterexamples.description: Cavern beneath Ryudou Temple retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Founding families selected this underground site two hundred years earlier.
counterexamples.explanation: Cavern beneath Ryudou Temple retained.

contexts.japanese: 堕ちた霊脈。二百年前、三家によって選ばれた始まりの土地—柳洞寺の地下に広がる大空洞に、アンリマユは受胎している」
contexts.english: The sunken ley lines. Two hundred years ago, the three families chose the cavern beneath Ryudou Temple to begin their work. That's where Aŋra Mainiiu is being conceived."

counterexamples.description: Circuits activate before any materialized weapon.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He starts Magic Circuits while watching Rider.
counterexamples.explanation: Circuits activate before any materialized weapon.

contexts.japanese: ライダーを見据えたまま、魔術回路を立ち上げる。
contexts.english: I start up my Magic Circuits, keeping my eyes on Rider.

counterexamples.description: Weapon withheld until last instant.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Projection with weapon ruby is not released yet.
counterexamples.explanation: Weapon withheld until last instant.

contexts.japanese: ……投影はギリギリまで出さない。
contexts.english: ...I won't Project my weapons until the last possible second.

counterexamples.description: Instant counterattack remains prospective.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He intends to form a sword when Rider steps in and intercept her.
counterexamples.explanation: Instant counterattack remains prospective.

contexts.japanese: ライダーが俺に踏み込んできた瞬間、ゼロ秒で剣を作り上げ全力で迎撃する—！
contexts.english: The instant Rider moves towards me, I'll create a sword in zero seconds flat and intercept her with all my might!

counterexamples.description: Person-as-Noble-Phantasm use direction retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider cannot fully employ Shirou, while a skilled swordsman could.
counterexamples.explanation: Person-as-Noble-Phantasm use direction retained.

contexts.japanese: 「…………投影魔術。私では貴方を使いこなせませんが、優れた剣士なら、貴方という宝具を最大限に発揮できるのでしょうね」
contexts.english: "...Projection magecraft. I cannot use you to your full potential, but an excellent swordsman might be able to best utilize you as a Noble Phantasm."

counterexamples.description: Sakura still supplies Rider’s magical energy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Continued source of power keeps Noble Phantasm available.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura still supplies Rider’s magical energy.

contexts.japanese: 「使えます。桜は未だ、私に魔力を供給していますから」
contexts.english: "Yes. Sakura still provides me with magical energy."

counterexamples.description: Embodied Saber cannot become spirit retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She has been given flesh and cannot return to spirit form.
counterexamples.explanation: Embodied Saber cannot become spirit retained.

contexts.japanese: セイバーは肉を与えられ、霊体に戻れない生命です。
contexts.english: Saber is a being given flesh, who cannot return to spirit form.

counterexamples.description: Greater Grail lower destination retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Underlying source of war requires going below, rather than upper temple.
counterexamples.explanation: Greater Grail lower destination retained.

contexts.japanese: ……聖杯戦争の大聖杯に行こうっていうんなら、上じゃなくて下に行かないとね」
contexts.english: ...If you want to go to the source of the Holy Grail War, you need to go down to find the Greater Grail."

counterexamples.description: Rin directs touch-through test.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She identifies right site and tells him to touch back rock to pass through.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin directs touch-through test.

contexts.japanese: 「—いいえ、ここで当たりよ士郎。奥の岩に触ってみなさい。簡単にすり抜けるから」
contexts.english: "No, this is the right place. Try touching the rock furthest in the back. You'll be able to slip through easily."

counterexamples.description: Bounded Field identification remains tentative.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin calls it a kind of bounded field and goes ahead.
counterexamples.explanation: Bounded Field identification remains tentative.

contexts.japanese: 「結界の一種でしょうね。—先、行くわよ」
contexts.english: "A Bounded Field, probably. Let's keep going."

counterexamples.description: Excess life causes nausea retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Too much raw vitality disgusts him.
counterexamples.explanation: Excess life causes nausea retained.

contexts.japanese: その、あまりの生々しさに吐き気がする。
contexts.english: It's so raw that it makes me nauseous.

counterexamples.description: Od and Mana designations retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Ruby specifies different energy labels.
counterexamples.explanation: Od and Mana designations retained.

contexts.japanese: それは夥しいまでの“生気”であり、視覚化できるほど垂れ流される魔力である。
contexts.english: Abundant od and flowing mana, as far as the eye can see.

counterexamples.description: Secret weapon preservation retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He knows ways to counter Saber and wants jeweled sword hidden from remaining enemies.
counterexamples.explanation: Secret weapon preservation retained.

contexts.japanese: 手の内が判っているセイバーなら、こっちにも対抗策がある。まだ臓硯とアサシンが控えている状況で、唯一“秘密”である宝石剣を使うのは—
contexts.english: I know Saber, so there are ways to deal with her. We shouldn't reveal our only secret weapon while Zouken and Assassin could still be waiting—

counterexamples.description: Previous Projection approach already insufficient.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He knows the Berserker solution alone cannot beat Saber.
counterexamples.explanation: Previous Projection approach already insufficient.

contexts.japanese: その方法では彼女には敵わないと、とうに結論は出ているのだが。
contexts.english: I've already concluded that this won't be enough to beat her.

counterexamples.description: Low-burden sword choice retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: These projected master swords burden him least.
counterexamples.explanation: Low-burden sword choice retained.

contexts.japanese: 投影の中でも、最も負担の少ない名剣。
contexts.english: They're the master-crafted swords that burden my Projection the least.

counterexamples.description: Paired Yin/Yang sword identities retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Bakuya is yin; Kanshou yang.
counterexamples.explanation: Paired Yin/Yang sword identities retained.

contexts.japanese: 陰剣莫耶、陽剣干将。
contexts.english: Yin sword, Bakuya. Yang sword, Kanshou.

counterexamples.description: Archer’s skill copied along with swords.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Projection includes combat skill, not only objects.
counterexamples.explanation: Archer’s skill copied along with swords.

contexts.japanese: 俺はアーチャーの腕から、ヤツの戦闘技術ごと双剣を複製した。
contexts.english: I've copied Archer's skills with the dual swords from his arm.

counterexamples.description: Holy-sword power withheld with motive uncertain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Context contrasts swordsmanship with using holy sword’s power; cave collapse or other motive remains speculative.
counterexamples.explanation: Holy-sword power withheld with motive uncertain.

contexts.japanese: こんな洞窟で聖剣を使えば天井を崩すからか、それとも別の理由か、とにかくセイバーは剣技だけで俺と戦っている。
contexts.english: Maybe it's because the ceiling will cave in if she uses her sword, or maybe it's some other reason, but for now, Saber's fighting me with her swordsmanship only.

counterexamples.description: Reserved rescue Projection useless without reaching Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saving a final use is pointless if Saber blocks access.
counterexamples.explanation: Reserved rescue Projection useless without reaching Sakura.

contexts.japanese: それも、桜に到達できないのでは何の意味もない。
contexts.english: It won't mean anything if I can't even reach her.

counterexamples.description: Pair attraction is part of tactic.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Yin and yang attract, alongside serial Projection and basic swordsmanship.
counterexamples.explanation: Pair attraction is part of tactic.

contexts.japanese: 引かれあう陰と陽。
contexts.english: Attraction between yin and yang.

counterexamples.description: First verse line keeps ruby and base layers.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Ruby spirit/technique and firmness are paired with crane-wing base line.
counterexamples.explanation: First verse line keeps ruby and base layers.

contexts.japanese: 「—鶴翼、欠落ヲ不ラズ」
contexts.english: "Spirit and technique must be flawless and firm. (Crane wings, ever intact.)"

counterexamples.description: Neck target retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Thrown arcs target enemy neck.
counterexamples.explanation: Neck target retained.

contexts.japanese: 狙いは敵の首。
contexts.english: I target the enemy's neck.

counterexamples.description: Saber intercepts both trajectories easily.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She changes Kanshou/Bakuya arcs with ease.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber intercepts both trajectories easily.

contexts.japanese: まったく同時に、左右から襲いかかる干将と莫耶を迎撃し、その軌道を容易くずらした。
contexts.english: She intercepts Kanshou and Bakuya's arcs with ease.

counterexamples.description: Replacement Projection already prepared.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Projection is done and advance-prepared paired swords are made again.
counterexamples.explanation: Replacement Projection already prepared.

contexts.japanese: 投影は済んでいる。
contexts.english: My Projection is already done.

counterexamples.description: Frontal Bakuya breaks after first returning Kanshou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Attack exploits rear distraction but sword is shattered against her sword.
counterexamples.explanation: Frontal Bakuya breaks after first returning Kanshou.

contexts.japanese: 敵の剣の前に砕かれた。
contexts.english: It shatters against the enemy's sword.

counterexamples.description: Second return belongs to originally thrown pair.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Bakuya from the first pair is the next rear attack.
counterexamples.explanation: Second return belongs to originally thrown pair.

contexts.japanese: 言うまでもない、それは投擲し、敵に弾かれた一度目の双剣だ。
contexts.english: It goes without saying that this is part of the first pair I threw and she blocked.

counterexamples.description: Held mate calls counterpart back.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Holding Kanshou automatically attracts Bakuya like the married swords’ magnet property.
counterexamples.explanation: Held mate calls counterpart back.

contexts.japanese: つまり—この手に干将がある限り、莫耶は自動的にオレの手元へと戻ってくる—！
contexts.english: In other words...as long as I'm holding Kanshou, Bakuya will automatically return to my hand!

counterexamples.description: Four-blade attack and no weapons left follow source.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Source says both pairs/four blades defended and all weapons broken.
counterexamples.explanation: Four-blade attack and no weapons left follow source.

contexts.japanese: 二つの干将莫耶、四つの刃による前後からの同時攻撃を防がれ、全ての武器を砕かれては策は無い。
contexts.english: She just defended against two pairs of Kanshou and Bakuya—four swords attacking from front and back at the same time. I don't have anything else after she destroyed all my weapons.

counterexamples.description: Further prepared move retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He has another step ready beyond apparent mutual stalemate.
counterexamples.explanation: Further prepared move retained.

contexts.japanese: この手には、その先が用意されている。
contexts.english: I still have more plans up my sleeve.

counterexamples.description: Foresight cannot overcome body response limit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She foresaw final strike but could not defend, because body cannot follow thought.
counterexamples.explanation: Foresight cannot overcome body response limit.

contexts.japanese: それを予知していながら、彼女には防ぐ事が出来なかった。
contexts.english: She foresaw the attack, but she can't defend against it.

counterexamples.description: Heart/head destruction necessary for permanent defeat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Regeneration and mana let her survive until decisive destruction.
counterexamples.explanation: Heart/head destruction necessary for permanent defeat.

contexts.japanese: 今の彼女を倒すには、確実に心臓か頭を潰すしかない。
contexts.english: The only way to defeat her in her current state is to destroy her heart or her head once and for all.

counterexamples.description: Less-than-ten-minute recovery retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If left, she recovers in under ten minutes; source next also speaks ten-minute exposure.
counterexamples.explanation: Less-than-ten-minute recovery retained.

contexts.japanese: このまま放置すれば、十分とかからずに彼女は回復する。
contexts.english: Failing that, she will recover in less than ten minutes.

counterexamples.description: Rapier comparison is qualified.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy likens thin weapon to a rapier within his own knowledge, then notes its unusual blade.
counterexamples.explanation: Rapier comparison is qualified.

contexts.japanese: 知っている中では西洋の細剣に近い。
contexts.english: From what I know, it's similar to a Western rapier.

counterexamples.description: Submachine gun is considered unsuitable rather than equipped.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest has only that gun option and gives the boy the sword instead.
counterexamples.explanation: Submachine gun is considered unsuitable rather than equipped.

contexts.japanese: 「切嗣は銃を好んだがな。あいにく今は短機関銃しかない。幽霊どもに鉛弾は効かんし、おまえには扱い辛いものだ。魔術使いのおまえには、そちらの方がらしいだろう」
contexts.english: "Kiritsugu preferred firearms. Unfortunately, I only have submachine guns. Lead bullets won't affect ghosts, and you wouldn't know how to use them. This is more suitable for a spellcaster like yourself."

counterexamples.description: Weight and tip distribution preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Approximate less-than-one-kilo weight and tip-heavy balance both remain.
counterexamples.explanation: Weight and tip distribution preserved.

contexts.japanese: 重さは一キロ弱程だろうが、明らかに切っ先の重さが違う。
contexts.english: The sword is less than a kilo, but it's obviously weighted towards the tip.

counterexamples.description: Sacrament distinguished from magecraft.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Black Key is named and explicitly called a sacrament rather than magecraft.
counterexamples.explanation: Sacrament distinguished from magecraft.

contexts.japanese: 「黒鍵という。更に言うのなら魔術ではなく秘跡だ。
contexts.english: "It's called a Black Key. Also, it's not magecraft, but a sacrament.

counterexamples.description: Limited efficacy requires a hit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Some effect against Servants depends on successfully hitting them.
counterexamples.explanation: Limited efficacy requires a hit.

contexts.japanese: もっとも当てられればの話だが、と余計な一言を足す言峰。
contexts.english: "Only if you hit them, of course," he adds unnecessarily.

contexts.japanese: 霊体を相手にするのは我々の専売特許だからな。その刀身におまえの魔術を載せれば、サーヴァントと言えど多少は有効だろう」
contexts.english: We specialize in dealing with spiritual entities. If you imbue its blade with your magecraft, it would even have some effect on Servants."

counterexamples.description: 空手 interpreted as empty-handed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest enters unarmed in contrast to the boy.
counterexamples.explanation: 空手 interpreted as empty-handed.

contexts.japanese: 俺とは違い、神父は空手で森へと歩き出した。
contexts.english: Unlike me, the priest strides into the forest unarmed.

counterexamples.description: Resonance rather than ordinary sensing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest corrects boy's sensing model to resonance and states retreat on fighting Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Resonance rather than ordinary sensing.

contexts.japanese: 「判るというよりは共鳴だ。……それはいいが。万が一、間桐桜と戦う事になれば私は撤退する。
contexts.english: "It is more that I resonate with her... I hope that is all. If we should happen to engage Sakura Matou in combat, I will retreat.

counterexamples.description: Priest cannot harm Darkened Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Personal inability and no winning chance both remain explicit.
counterexamples.explanation: Priest cannot harm Darkened Sakura.

contexts.japanese: おまえはともかく、私では黒化した間桐桜を傷つけられん。戦ったところで勝ち目はない」
contexts.english: I cannot harm Sakura Matou now that she has been Darkened. In a fight, I would have no chance."

counterexamples.description: Boy's current limit retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot defeat the Shadow now and can only sustain Sakura's mind until birth.
counterexamples.explanation: Boy's current limit retained.

contexts.japanese: 今のおまえに影を倒す術はない。おまえに出来る事は、影がこの世に生まれ落ちるまで、間桐桜の精神を繋ぎとめる事だけだ」
contexts.english: You have no way to defeat it now. All you can do is ground Sakura Matou's mind and wait for the Shadow to be birthed into the world."

counterexamples.description: Host-dependent material manifestation retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shapeless main body requires Sakura and exists materially as her shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Host-dependent material manifestation retained.

contexts.japanese: 彼女なくして影は存在できない。カタチのない本体は、間桐桜の影になる事で物質界に存在する」
contexts.english: The Shadow would not exist without her. The shapeless main body in the Holy Grail exists in the material world by turning itself into her shadow."

counterexamples.description: Literal pregnancy extraction rejected.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If the entity were in her womb extraction would simplify matters, but priest says it is not.
counterexamples.explanation: Literal pregnancy extraction rejected.

contexts.japanese: 「まさか。そうであれば話は簡単だろう。胎内にいるモノを摘出してしまえば事足りるのだから。
contexts.english: "Of course not. That would make this much easier. We would simply need to extract it from her womb.

counterexamples.description: Grail-location confidence is limited.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest reasons about location and indicates Rin should know.
counterexamples.explanation: Grail-location confidence is limited.

contexts.japanese: 「言峰、その場所を知っているのか」
contexts.english: "Kotomine. Do you know where it is?"

contexts.japanese: 「予測はつく。正確な入り口を知りたければ凛に訊け。
contexts.english: "I can make an educated guess. Ask Rin if you want to know where the exact entrance is.

contexts.japanese: 二百年前、アインツベルンが遠坂と手を結んだのは儀式の場所を確保する為。後継者である凛ならば教えられている筈だ」
contexts.english: Two hundred years ago, the Tohsakas joined with the Einzberns to secure a location for the ritual. Rin is their successor, so she should have been told."

counterexamples.description: Priest will oppose root destruction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His objective is activation formula fulfillment and he will not allow boy to destroy it.
counterexamples.explanation: Priest will oppose root destruction.

contexts.japanese: 「とっくに起動式を壊していたか？　そう上手くいかんさ。なにしろ私の目的は起動式の成就だ。おまえに起動式を壊させる訳にはいかん」
contexts.english: "You would have destroyed the activation formula already? That won't do. My objective is the successful activation of the formula. I will not allow you to destroy it."

counterexamples.description: Air toxicity and inability to breathe retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Darkening makes atmosphere poisonous to her and she cannot breathe.
counterexamples.explanation: Air toxicity and inability to breathe retained.

contexts.japanese: 大気はすでに猛毒。
contexts.english: The air is toxic.

counterexamples.description: Additional Grail intake beyond mana.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Keeping Servants requires more supply from Greater Grail, and more than mana flows through.
counterexamples.explanation: Additional Grail intake beyond mana.

contexts.japanese: 「うむ。恐らくワシに対する牽制なのだろうが、浅慮浅慮。サーヴァントを抱え込めば込むほど、アレは多くの魔力を聖杯から引き出す。大聖杯から魔力を受信する小聖杯ならではの魔力補給だが、流れてくるモノは魔力だけではない。
contexts.english: "Yes. She is probably keeping him to use against me. How thoughtless. The more Servants she holds on to, the more power she must draw from the Holy Grail. Only a Lesser Grail such as herself can receive such power from the Greater Grail, but she is receiving more than just magical energy.

counterexamples.description: Concealed bloodlust insufficient.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Once discrimination fails, mere suppression of killing intent cannot permit approach.
counterexamples.explanation: Concealed bloodlust insufficient.

contexts.japanese: そうなっては殺気を消す程度では近寄れぬ。
contexts.english: Once she reaches that point, it will be impossible to approach her even by concealing one's bloodlust.

counterexamples.description: Danger to both and house explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shadow could crush them with the house if it wished.
counterexamples.explanation: Danger to both and house explicit.

contexts.japanese: ソレがその気になるだけで、俺たちは屋敷ごと潰される。
contexts.english: If it wanted to, it could crush us along with the entire house.

counterexamples.description: Remote physical location distinguished.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura is under Ryudou Temple; courtyard figure is only her modeled shadow projection.
counterexamples.explanation: Remote physical location distinguished.

contexts.japanese: 本物の桜は柳洞寺の地下にいる。
contexts.english: The real Sakura is underground, beneath Ryudou Temple.

counterexamples.description: No will and no ability to sever retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura denies both intention and capacity to leave entity.
counterexamples.explanation: No will and no ability to sever retained.

contexts.japanese: 「ありません。弱いわたしはもう消えたと言ったでしょう？　折角手に入れた力だもの。わたしはアレから離れる気はないし、できない。
contexts.english: "No. I said the weak me is gone now, remember? I suffered so much for this power. I don't want to leave it, nor can I.

counterexamples.description: Restraint protects Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She will not permit entity to emerge while he remains in town.
counterexamples.explanation: Restraint protects Shirou.

contexts.japanese: そんな事、許すわけにはいかない。ここにはまだ先輩がいるんです。
contexts.english: I won't let that happen. Senpai is still here.

counterexamples.description: Mutual destruction proposed conditionally.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She asks Rin to take Shirou far away so she can take entity down with herself.
counterexamples.explanation: Mutual destruction proposed conditionally.

contexts.japanese: ……姉さん。先輩を連れて、遠いところに逃げてください。そうしてくれたら、わたしは安心してあの子と刺し違えるコトが出来ますから」
contexts.english: ...Nee-san, take Senpai and run somewhere far away. If you can do that, then I feel safe taking the child down with me."

counterexamples.description: Weapon's lethal purpose creates contradiction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin says helping her means preparing the sword she intends to use to kill Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Weapon's lethal purpose creates contradiction.

contexts.japanese: わたしと行くって事は桜を殺すっていう事よ。宝石剣だってそう。貴方は桜を殺す武器を、わたしの為に用意しなくちゃいけないのよ」
contexts.english: Going with me means killing Sakura. That goes for the Jeweled Sword, too. You need to provide me with a weapon to kill her."

counterexamples.description: Sword still needs Projection.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Prior promise and inability to resist Shadow make the future projected sword necessary despite contradiction.
counterexamples.explanation: Sword still needs Projection.

contexts.japanese: 「……そうだな。宝石の剣に関しては、確かに矛盾してる。けど今の桜は俺たちの手に負えないし、剣を作るのは以前からの約束だ。宝石の剣を投影する事で桜の影に対抗できるなら、それは絶対に必要なものだ」
contexts.english: "...Yeah. I'm definitely contradicting myself by making the Jeweled Sword. But we can't beat Sakura right now, and I already promised that I'd make it. If you need me to Project the Jeweled Sword to fight Sakura's Shadow, then it has to be done."

counterexamples.description: Approximate half-power hope, no exact duplicate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If all goes well original cannot be exactly copied but roughly half ability expected.
counterexamples.explanation: Approximate half-power hope, no exact duplicate.

contexts.japanese: 出来るだけ宝石剣に似せたアゾット剣と、士郎の投影とイリヤのサポート。うまくいけばオリジナルの複製とはいかないけど、半分ぐらいは能力の再現ができる筈よ」
contexts.english: I did my best to find you an Azoth Blade similar to the Jeweled Sword, and Illya will be supporting your Projection. If this goes well, we won't be able to replicate the original, but we should get something with about half of its power."

counterexamples.description: Boy recognizes huge stored mana.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even an incomplete mage can perceive strongly charged weapon.
counterexamples.explanation: Boy recognizes huge stored mana.

contexts.japanese: そればかりではなく、半人前の俺でさえ判るほど強大な魔力が蓄積されていた。
contexts.english: But not just that—even I can tell that it's charged with a massive amount of magical energy.

counterexamples.description: Relative mana scales retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Small handful against Sakura yet hundreds times boy's capacity.
counterexamples.explanation: Relative mana scales retained.

contexts.japanese: ……まあ、桜の纏った影に比べたら掌一つ分の魔力ではあるのだが、それでも俺の許容量からすれば何百倍という破格さだ。
contexts.english: ...It might just be a small handful compared to the Shadow cloaking Sakura, but it's hundreds of times my own capacity.

counterexamples.description: All jewels and decade reserves spent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin commits all remaining jewels and ten years' mana.
counterexamples.explanation: All jewels and decade reserves spent.

contexts.japanese: 「凄いのは当たり前。なにしろ残った宝石を全部つぎ込んだ、わたしの十年分の魔力なんだから」
contexts.english: "Of course it's amazing. I transferred all the jewels I have left into it, so it has ten years' worth of my magical energy."

counterexamples.description: Movement possible while ordinary magic unavailable.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She can manage physical activity but has not recovered enough mana for magecraft.
counterexamples.explanation: Movement possible while ordinary magic unavailable.

contexts.japanese: 「そうね、飛んだり跳ねたりぐらいはなんとか。けど魔術を使えるほど魔力は回復してないわ」
contexts.english: "I can still jump and run around, so I'll manage. I still haven't recovered enough power to use magecraft, though."

counterexamples.description: Projection still needs time.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even boy will take time and must begin to meet midnight.
counterexamples.explanation: Projection still needs time.

contexts.japanese: 「シロウ、そろそろ始めましょう。いくらシロウでもその剣の投影には時間がかかるわ。すぐに始めないと日付が変わる」
contexts.english: "Let's get started, Shirou. It'll take time to Project that sword, even for you. It'll be midnight if we don't start soon."

counterexamples.description: Rin expects Azoth to disappear.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She thinks Azoth is consumed once jeweled sword is made.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin expects Azoth to disappear.

contexts.japanese: 「？　貰うも何も、それを使って今から投影するんじゃない。宝石剣が出来たらアゾット剣はなくなるわよ」
contexts.english: "Huh? I mean, you're about to use it for the Projection. The Azoth Blade will be gone once you make the Jeweled Sword."

counterexamples.description: Personal never-seen versus inherited record.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya has not seen sword herself but contains its record.
counterexamples.explanation: Personal never-seen versus inherited record.

contexts.japanese: 「分かってるわ。シロウにはまず、わたしの記録に入ってもらう。わたしだって見た事はないけど、わたしの中には宝石剣の記録があるわ。
contexts.english: "I know. I'm going to have you search the records inside me. I haven't personally seen it, but there's a record of the Jeweled Sword inside my mind.

counterexamples.description: Sight and consciousness move into record.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Body stays while consciousness and eyes enter Illya's record to analyze sword.
counterexamples.explanation: Sight and consciousness move into record.

contexts.japanese: 「いいから目を閉じて。シロウの体はそのままで、意識だけを別の場所に移すわ。前もやったでしょ？　シロウの眼をわたしの記録に移すから、そこで宝石剣を解析して。
contexts.english: "Just close your eyes. Stay still. I'm going to send your consciousness somewhere else. I did it before, remember? I'll send your sight inside me, where you can analyze the Jeweled Sword.

counterexamples.description: Binding released after entry.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya unbinds left arm once he is inside and demands quick Projection.
counterexamples.explanation: Binding released after entry.

contexts.japanese: ……シロウが中に入ったら、わたしが左腕の拘束を外す。二百年前の記録へ遡る圧力と、左腕の侵食が同時に来るわ。気をしっかり持って、出来るだけ早く投影を終わらせなさい」
contexts.english: ...Once you're inside, I'll unbind your left arm. Your arm is going to invade you at the same time while you travel two hundred years into history. Keep a firm grip on yourself and try to finish the Projection as quickly as you can."

counterexamples.description: Do not look at unnecessary things.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She guides him to sword and tells him to exclude distraction.
counterexamples.explanation: Do not look at unnecessary things.

contexts.japanese: 「……宝石剣まではわたしが連れて行くから、シロウは息を止めているだけでいい。雑念は捨てて。余計なものは見ないで。シロウはわたしの中から、彼のゼルレッチを抜き取ってくるだけでいい—」
contexts.english: "...I'll take you until we find the Jeweled Sword so you just need to still your breathing. Don't get distracted. Don't look at anything you don't have to. You just need to draw out the Zelretch."

counterexamples.description: Cause of distortion unresolved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wonders whether sensory plunge or arm release causes the experience.
counterexamples.explanation: Cause of distortion unresolved.

contexts.japanese: それとも、左腕の拘束を外されたからか。
contexts.english: or because she undid the binding on my left arm?

counterexamples.description: Grail circuit remains huge.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Perceived structure is a giant circuit.
counterexamples.explanation: Grail circuit remains huge.

contexts.japanese: それは巨大な回路だった。
contexts.english: It's a giant circuit.

counterexamples.description: Heaven's Feel requires Justeaze's will.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her will is necessary beyond ordinary wish-granting.
counterexamples.explanation: Heaven's Feel requires Justeaze's will.

contexts.japanese: “天の杯”には彼女の意思が必要だ。
contexts.english: Heaven's Feel requires her will.

counterexamples.description: Understands he cannot understand.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He recognizes inability to grasp sword despite seeing it.
counterexamples.explanation: Understands he cannot understand.

contexts.japanese: 自分では理解できないと理解した。
contexts.english: I understand that I cannot understand it.

counterexamples.description: Analyzing structure distinguished from theory.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Can analyze form/structure and Project it but not governing principles.
counterexamples.explanation: Analyzing structure distinguished from theory.

contexts.japanese: その構造を解析し投影する事しかできない。
contexts.english: I can only analyze its structure and Project it.

counterexamples.description: Future knowledge beyond young humanity.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Old man embodies future common sense inaccessible to humanity in childhood.
counterexamples.explanation: Future knowledge beyond young humanity.

contexts.japanese: まだ幼年期にいる人類には届かない、遥か未来の常識を老人は体現している—
contexts.english: The old man embodies common wisdom from the far future, which our young species has yet to reach...

counterexamples.description: Reaching repetition retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Repeated reach lines enact continued effort with burning perception.
counterexamples.explanation: Reaching repetition retained.

contexts.japanese: 何十メートルと左手を伸ばして、伸ばして、伸ばして、伸ばして—
contexts.english: I reach out dozens of meters. I reach, reach, reach...

counterexamples.description: No sensed energy is boy's impression.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot feel mana in new sword and thinks it inferior.
counterexamples.explanation: No sensed energy is boy's impression.

contexts.japanese: いや、そもそもこの剣にはまったく魔力を感じない。
