contexts.english: In fact, I can't feel a speck of magical energy from this sword.

counterexamples.description: Flawless Projection limited to manufacture.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya specifically praises Projection and swordmaking.
counterexamples.explanation: Flawless Projection limited to manufacture.

contexts.japanese: 「そ。小言はいっぱいあるけど、とりあえずお疲れさまシロウ。投影だけなら完璧、非の打ち所のない剣製を見せてもらったわ」
contexts.english: "I have a lot to scold you about, but good work, Shirou. That was a perfect Projection. A flawless display of sword creation."

counterexamples.description: Only Schweinorg lineage can wield it.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Weapon's exceptional usability restriction explains boy's impression.
counterexamples.explanation: Only Schweinorg lineage can wield it.

contexts.japanese: 「それはそれでいいのよ。その剣はシュバインオーグの系譜の者にしか扱えない、とびっきりの魔剣なんだから。
contexts.english: "It's good enough. Only the Schweinorg lineage can use that sword. It's a magical sword unlike any other.

counterexamples.description: Third/Second distinction retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura receives Third's blessing while young Rin seeks to wield Second.
counterexamples.explanation: Third/Second distinction retained.

contexts.japanese: ま、考えてみると因果よね。サクラは第三の加護を受けて、リンは若輩の身でありながら第二を駆使しようっていうんだから。協会の連中がいたら調査どころの話じゃない、各部門あげての裁判沙汰になりかねないわ」
contexts.english: I guess you could call it fate. Sakura is blessed by the Third, while Rin's going to operate the Second at a young age. If the Association knew about this, they'd do more than just investigate. It would turn into a court battle against every single department."

counterexamples.description: Blueprint inherited rather than original sword.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Tohsakas received design alone.
counterexamples.explanation: Blueprint inherited rather than original sword.

contexts.japanese: 「と言っても、遠坂に継承されたのは設計図だけで宝石剣そのものじゃないわ。
contexts.english: "Still, the Tohsakas only inherited the blueprints, not the Jeweled Sword itself.

counterexamples.description: Return of master only possible.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zelretch seems absent from this world and might visit after Rin's achievement.
counterexamples.explanation: Return of master only possible.

contexts.japanese: ゼルレッチ本人はこの世界にはいないようだけど、リンが自分の手で宝石剣を作れるようになったらひょっこりやってくるかもしれない」
contexts.english: I think Zelretch isn't in this world at the moment, but he might pop in for a visit once he hears that Rin managed to make the Jeweled Sword herself."

counterexamples.description: Tourist reading is boy's joke.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wonders if world-travel statement amounts to ordinary wanderlust.
counterexamples.explanation: Tourist reading is boy's joke.

contexts.japanese: この世界にはいないだの、ひょっこりやってくるだの、それはただの放浪趣味の旅行好きってヤツではなかろうか。
contexts.english: Not in this world? Pop in for a visit? She makes him sound like some kind of wanderer who travels around for fun.

counterexamples.description: One-more estimate is self-assessment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks he can manage roughly one further Projection.
counterexamples.explanation: One-more estimate is self-assessment.

contexts.japanese: これなら、あと一回ぐらいはなんとか投影が使える。
contexts.english: I should be able to manage one more Projection.

counterexamples.description: Hand-off inferred after memory gap.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sword he apparently projected is already with Rin while his hand is empty.
counterexamples.explanation: Hand-off inferred after memory gap.

contexts.japanese: アレはついさっき俺が投影した＜らしい＞もので、左手はとうに空っぽで、つまりもう遠坂に手渡したのか。
contexts.english: I just Projected that (I think), and my left hand is empty, which means I must've given it to her.

counterexamples.description: Different remaining energy and prior use matter.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Hers empty, his has some remaining, and having been used carries significance.
counterexamples.explanation: Different remaining energy and prior use matter.

contexts.japanese: 「違うわ。わたしのは空っぽだけど、士郎のは少しだけ残ってる。取るに足りない量だけど、それでも、使われたからには意味があるんだわ」
contexts.english: "No, they're not. Mine's empty, but yours still has a little left in it. It isn't enough to use for anything, but... It has meaning because it was used."

counterexamples.description: Star altar retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Opening identifies star-worship altar.
counterexamples.explanation: Star altar retained.

contexts.japanese: —それは、星を祭る祭壇だった。
contexts.english: It is an altar enshrining the stars.

counterexamples.description: Heaven underground inversion retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Connected sky paradoxically under earth.
counterexamples.explanation: Heaven underground inversion retained.

contexts.japanese: 宙を繋ぐというが天は地の底であり、
contexts.english: The "sky" it connects to is deep underground,

counterexamples.description: Mana deprivation threatens body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Assassin cannot maintain body without supply.
counterexamples.explanation: Mana deprivation threatens body.

contexts.japanese: 「—ここまでか。魔力提供がなくては、もはや体が保たぬ」
contexts.english: "I suppose this is as far as I go. My body can no longer last without magical energy."

counterexamples.description: Forest body only swarm.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Destroyed forest form was worm aggregation.
counterexamples.explanation: Forest body only swarm.

contexts.japanese: 森で潰された間桐臓硯など、所詮は虫の集まりにすぎない。
contexts.english: The Zouken Matou which was crushed in the forest was no more than a swarm of worms.

counterexamples.description: Brain consumption only ordered.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Soul orders anchor worm to eat brain.
counterexamples.explanation: Brain consumption only ordered.

contexts.japanese: 腐敗する間桐臓硯の霊体が、本体である虫に、少女の脳を食えと命令する。
contexts.english: Zouken Matou's rotten spiritual body orders his worm body to eat the girl's brain.

counterexamples.description: Name recovery denial is her claim.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says Grail cannot return to past and restore his lost name.
counterexamples.explanation: Name recovery denial is her claim.

contexts.japanese: いくら聖杯でも、過去に戻って貴方の名前を取り戻すなんてコトはできないんだから」
contexts.english: Even the Holy Grail can't go back in time and give you back a name that you lost."

counterexamples.description: Host changed for heart size.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken selected suitable smaller worm to inhabit heart.
counterexamples.explanation: Host changed for heart size.

contexts.japanese: 老魔術師は少女の心臓に寄生する為、それに相応しい虫に依り代を切り替えた。
contexts.english: The old mage changed his host to a more suitable worm in order to parasitize the girl's heart.

counterexamples.description: His sufficiency claim turned against him.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If her success suffices, she needs no further help to open gate.
counterexamples.explanation: His sufficiency claim turned against him.

contexts.japanese: 「それでは尚更ですね。だって、もうお爺さまの手は要りません。あとはわたしだけでも、門を開ける事はできますから」
contexts.english: "That's all the more reason to do this. I don't need you anymore, Grandfather. Now I can open the gate on my own."

counterexamples.description: Release precedes staged Projection.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy loosens left-arm restraint while Rider attacks.
counterexamples.explanation: Release precedes staged Projection.

contexts.japanese: 左腕の拘束を緩め、
contexts.english: I loosen the binding on my left arm,

counterexamples.description: Rider chooses timing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy must follow her cue after freeing left hand.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider chooses timing.

contexts.japanese: タイミングはライダーがとる。
contexts.english: Rider will decide the timing.

counterexamples.description: Azoth shatters on contact.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Expected piercing sword breaks upon touching her.
counterexamples.explanation: Azoth shatters on contact.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの体に突き刺さる筈の剣は、セイバーに触れた途端砕け散った。
contexts.english: The dagger should have pierced her body, but it completely shattered as soon as it touched her.

counterexamples.description: Prepared Projection maintained during extra weapon.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He exceeds limits to make separate Saber-stopping weapon while holding Rider support.
counterexamples.explanation: Prepared Projection maintained during extra weapon.

contexts.japanese: いま、ライダーの為に作った投影を維持したまま、セイバーを止める“武器”を投影する。
contexts.english: I'm going to Project a weapon to stop Saber while maintaining the Projection I made for Rider.

counterexamples.description: Incantation carries both layers.
counterexamples.sourceReading: English source bone-of-sword phrase and Japanese twist/pierce layer both represented.
counterexamples.explanation: Incantation carries both layers.

contexts.japanese: 「—I am the bone of my sword.」
contexts.english: "My bones twist and pierce. (I am the bone of my sword.)"

counterexamples.description: Certain shot image precedes attack.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He holds hitting image, so believes arrow hits.
counterexamples.explanation: Certain shot image precedes attack.

contexts.japanese: 既に的るイメージがある以上、この一矢は必ずセイバーに食らいつく。
contexts.english: I've already imagined it striking home, so this arrow will absolutely hit Saber.

counterexamples.description: Name calls interleave.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Bellerophon and Excalibur released through alternating partial names.
counterexamples.explanation: Name calls interleave.

contexts.english: "...CALIBUR!!!"

counterexamples.description: Time arrest internally explained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy accelerates inner experience, making instant seem eternal.
counterexamples.explanation: Time arrest internally explained.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎の内部を総加速させ、刹那を永遠に偽装する。
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya accelerates his inner world, disguising a moment as eternity.

counterexamples.description: Rider attack alone insufficient.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Bellerophon cannot overpower Saber Phantasm unaided.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider attack alone insufficient.

contexts.japanese: ライダーの宝具を以ってしても、セイバーの宝具には敵わない。
contexts.english: Rider can't overcome Saber's Noble Phantasm, not even with Bellerophon.

counterexamples.description: Greatest defense scoped to Archer knowledge.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Defense greatest among what Archer knows.
counterexamples.explanation: Greatest defense scoped to Archer knowledge.

contexts.japanese: 弓兵が知る中で最大の守り、ライダーを勝利させる宝具を、
contexts.english: I'll make Rider win, using the greatest defense Archer knows...

counterexamples.description: Projection must remain active.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot stop while equal beams contend or protection fails.
counterexamples.explanation: Projection must remain active.

contexts.japanese: まだ投影は止められない。
contexts.english: I can't stop the Projection yet.

counterexamples.description: Ninety-percent cancellation retained in Caladbolg branch.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber sword cancels nine tenths of Rider light.
counterexamples.explanation: Ninety-percent cancellation retained in Caladbolg branch.

contexts.japanese: ベルレフォーンの光はその九割を、セイバーの聖剣によって相殺された。
contexts.english: Ninety percent of Bellerophon's light was cancelled out by Saber's sacred sword.

counterexamples.description: Parallel true-name release retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Names interleave here too.
counterexamples.explanation: Parallel true-name release retained.

contexts.english: "...CALIBUR!!!"

counterexamples.description: Four process stages explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Search, select, analyze, project separately punctuated.
counterexamples.explanation: Four process stages explicit.

contexts.japanese: 検索。選出。解析。投影。
contexts.english: Search. Select. Analyze. Project.

counterexamples.description: Knowledge-bounded best defense in other branch.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Archer-known greatest defense, not world's absolute maximum.
counterexamples.explanation: Knowledge-bounded best defense in other branch.

contexts.japanese: 弓兵が知る中で最大の守り、ライダーを勝利させる宝具を、
contexts.english: I'll make Rider win, using the greatest defense Archer knows...

counterexamples.description: Protection loss destroys Rider instantly.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If support lost, she vaporizes.
counterexamples.explanation: Protection loss destroys Rider instantly.

contexts.japanese: ライダーは一瞬で蒸発する—！
contexts.english: Rider will be vaporized!

counterexamples.description: Rider reserve exhausted as inference.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Unable to rise, possibly spent mana.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider reserve exhausted as inference.

contexts.japanese: ライダーは魔力を使い切ったのか、立ち上がる事もできず倒れ伏している。
contexts.english: Rider's down, unable to stand. She might be out of magical energy.

counterexamples.description: Full bodily restoration retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her gradual healing has completed.
counterexamples.explanation: Full bodily restoration retained.

contexts.japanese: 刻一刻と回復していた体は、もう完全に復元していた。
contexts.english: Her gradually healing body is already fully restored.

counterexamples.description: Expended power recovers too.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Recovery includes magical power as well as injuries.
counterexamples.explanation: Expended power recovers too.

contexts.japanese: 回復したのは肉体だけでなく、消費した魔力すら元通りだ。
contexts.english: She's recovered all the power she spent, on top of her injuries.

counterexamples.description: One more Projection is a bounded self-estimate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Combined remaining mana seems usable, but one last Projection is limit before uncontrollable arm.
counterexamples.explanation: One more Projection is a bounded self-estimate.

contexts.japanese: 合わせればまだいけそうだが、投影はあと一度が限界だ。その後は何をしても、アーチャーの腕を抑えきれなくなる。
contexts.english: I think I can manage with that combined power, but I'm limited to one last Projection. I won't be able to control Archer's arm anymore, no matter what I do afterwards.

counterexamples.description: Avoiding excess thought protects last weapon.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Extra considerations must not degrade remaining Projection.
counterexamples.explanation: Avoiding excess thought protects last weapon.

contexts.japanese: その最後の武器を、余分な“考察”で劣化させる訳にはいかない。
contexts.english: I can't allow any excess considerations to degrade my final weapon.

counterexamples.description: Calls herself back, not silently repaired to Saber.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura says she will recall herself.
counterexamples.explanation: Calls herself back, not silently repaired to Saber.

contexts.japanese: ごめんなさい、いますぐわたしを呼び戻しますね？
contexts.english: I'm sorry. I'll call myself back right now, okay?

counterexamples.description: Black Command Spells crumble.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Spells wrapping Sakura break apart.
counterexamples.explanation: Black Command Spells crumble.

contexts.japanese: 桜の体を覆っていた、黒い令呪が砕け散っていく。
contexts.english: The black Command Spells wrapping her body crumble away.

counterexamples.description: Contract-resetting function preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Dagger resets magical effects and breaks Servant contracts.
counterexamples.explanation: Contract-resetting function preserved.

contexts.japanese: あらゆる魔術効果を初期化し、サーヴァントとの契約を破る宝具。
contexts.english: A Noble Phantasm that resets all magical effects and breaks Servants' contracts.

counterexamples.description: Crest protects unconscious heir.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Inherited Tohsaka Crest will not easily let successor die even without consciousness.
counterexamples.explanation: Crest protects unconscious heir.

contexts.japanese: 刻印は遠坂家が遺してきた魔術の結晶だ。遠坂が意識を失っても、易々と後継者を死なせはしない。
contexts.english: The Crest is a crystallization of the Tohsakas' inherited magecraft. Even if she loses consciousness, it won't allow its heir to die so easily.

counterexamples.description: Release does not erase Shadow.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shadow persists after Sakura ceases to be vessel.
counterexamples.explanation: Release does not erase Shadow.

contexts.japanese: 桜という依り代を無くしても、黒い影は消え去らない。
contexts.english: The Shadow isn't disappearing, even though Sakura isn't its host anymore.

counterexamples.description: Grail condition on eventual emergence retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shadow will emerge eventually while Greater Grail remains.
counterexamples.explanation: Grail condition on eventual emergence retained.

contexts.japanese: この大聖杯がある限り、いずれ、自分から外に這い出て来るだろう。
contexts.english: As long as the Greater Grail exists, it'll come crawling out someday.

counterexamples.description: Cave collapse alone may not destroy it.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He does not think cave-in would erase entity.
counterexamples.explanation: Cave collapse alone may not destroy it.

contexts.japanese: ……だが、この洞穴が崩れたところでアレが消え去るとは思えない。
contexts.english: ...But I don't think it'll disappear even if the cave comes down.

counterexamples.description: Strongest weapon limited to his knowledge.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Plan uses strongest Noble Phantasm he knows.
counterexamples.explanation: Strongest weapon limited to his knowledge.

contexts.japanese: 俺が知り得る限り最強の宝具で、あの怪物を一掃する。
contexts.english: To blow it away with the most powerful Noble Phantasm I know of.

counterexamples.description: Remastering risk remains hypothetical.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He warns Angra Mainyu may try to make Sakura Master again.
counterexamples.explanation: Remastering risk remains hypothetical.

contexts.japanese: 「アレを閉じてから行く。すぐ終わるだろうけど、遠坂の傷は一刻を争う。桜だって、ここにいたらアイツの影響を受けるだろう。アンリマユとやらは、懲りずに桜をマスターにするかもしれない」
contexts.english: "I'm going to shut that thing off. I think it'll be quick, but Tohsaka's wound needs help soon. It's going to affect Sakura if she stays here. Aŋra Mainiiu might not have learned its lesson and still try to make her its Master."

counterexamples.description: Left arm unsealed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He releases left arm.
counterexamples.explanation: Left arm unsealed.

contexts.japanese: 左腕を解放する。
contexts.english: I unseal my left arm.

counterexamples.description: Intent to destroy both Grail and curse.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Strongest known sword is to destroy curse together with Greater Grail.
counterexamples.explanation: Intent to destroy both Grail and curse.

contexts.japanese: 俺が知り得る中で最強の剣を以って、大聖杯ごと、この呪いを破壊する。
contexts.english: I'll make the strongest sword I know and destroy the entire Greater Grail, and this curse.

counterexamples.description: No control or interference intention.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei cannot interfere and has no desire to do so.
counterexamples.explanation: No control or interference intention.

contexts.japanese: 「当然だ。私はこれに干渉する事はできんし、これに干渉する気もない。
contexts.english: "Of course. I can't interfere with it, nor do I intend to.

counterexamples.description: Entity's own judgment stays unknown.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even if actions evil, people do not yet know its own opinion.
counterexamples.explanation: Entity's own judgment stays unknown.

contexts.japanese: だが—その行為が悪だとしても、アレ本人がそれをどう思うかはまだ判るまい」
contexts.english: However...even if its actions are evil, we do not know what it personally thinks of them."

counterexamples.description: No magical battle.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration denies magecraft battle here.
counterexamples.explanation: No magical battle.

contexts.japanese: 魔術戦になどなる訳がない。
contexts.english: This won't be a battle of magecraft.

counterexamples.description: Use bars return.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Using last Projection means no going back.
counterexamples.explanation: Use bars return.

contexts.japanese: 使えば、絶対に戻れない。
contexts.english: If I use this, there's no going back.

counterexamples.description: Curse destruction required in boy's moral formulation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He sees curse destruction as absolute condition for her happiness after sins.
counterexamples.explanation: Curse destruction required in boy's moral formulation.

contexts.japanese: 桜の罪。桜に幸福が許される絶対条件が、この呪いの破壊にある。
contexts.english: Sakura's sins. Destroying this curse is the absolute condition to let her be happy.

counterexamples.description: Sword in hand before interruption.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sword appears in his hand.
counterexamples.explanation: Sword in hand before interruption.

contexts.japanese: 手に剣を。
contexts.english: A sword in my hand.

counterexamples.description: Magecraft and Magic distinguished.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is Magic everyone wished to see.
counterexamples.explanation: Magecraft and Magic distinguished.

contexts.japanese: なんていったって、みんなが見たがってた魔法なんだから。
contexts.english: This is the Magic everyone wishes they could see.

counterexamples.description: Imperfect body and Rin trial-and-error preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Only her body can be used; imperfect result expected fixable with Rin.
counterexamples.explanation: Imperfect body and Rin trial-and-error preserved.

contexts.japanese: 使えるのはわたしの体しかないから、完全に再現はできないの。けどだいじょうぶ。リンといっしょに試行錯誤すれば、すぐに元通りにしてもらえるわ。
contexts.english: We only have my body to use, so I can't completely recreate it. It'll be okay, though. If you do some trial and error with Rin, I'm sure you can go back to normal.

counterexamples.description: Sacrificial key and first ritual callback retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: White figure becomes sacrificial key and closes Greater Grail like first rite.
counterexamples.explanation: Sacrificial key and first ritual callback retained.

contexts.japanese: 白い装束の誰かは、初めの儀式のように、起動のための生贄になって、大聖杯を閉ざしていく。
contexts.english: Someone in a white dress becomes a sacrificial key and closes the Greater Grail, just like the very first ritual.

counterexamples.description: Smiling farewell and closed gate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says goodbye, smiles and closes Grail gate.
counterexamples.explanation: Smiling farewell and closed gate.

contexts.japanese: じゃあねと微笑って、パタン、と大聖杯の門を閉めた。
contexts.english: She said goodbye, smiled, and shut the door to the Greater Grail.

counterexamples.description: No mana remains in body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Not even fragment of power left.
counterexamples.explanation: No mana remains in body.

contexts.japanese: この体には、一欠片の魔力も残っていない。
contexts.english: There isn't a single bit of power left in this body.

counterexamples.description: Only one breath of mana.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Pendant holds one breath's mana.
counterexamples.explanation: Only one breath of mana.

contexts.japanese: ほんの一呼吸分の魔力。
contexts.english: One breath of magical energy.

counterexamples.description: Front-gate restriction is reported.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy asks Rider about barrier and heard front-gate-only rule.
counterexamples.explanation: Front-gate restriction is reported.

contexts.japanese: 「……ライダー、大丈夫か？　柳洞寺は結界が張ってあるんだろ。サーヴァントは正門からしか山に入れないって聞いたけど」
contexts.english: "Are you all right, Rider? I know there's a Bounded Field around the temple. I heard Servants can't go in except by the front gate."

counterexamples.description: Barrier pressure bearable.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider feels pressure but tolerable.
counterexamples.explanation: Barrier pressure bearable.

contexts.japanese: 「……多少の重圧はありますが、耐えられるレベルです。
contexts.english: "...There is a pressure, but it's bearable."

counterexamples.description: Natural-looking blocked cavity hides magic.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider senses camouflage despite apparent one-meter dead end.
counterexamples.explanation: Natural-looking blocked cavity hides magic.

contexts.japanese: 「……ありますね。天然の洞穴ですが、人間が入れない事もない。ここからでは一メートルほどで行き止まっているように見えますが、魔術による偽装が感じられます」
contexts.english: "...There is. It's a natural cave. A human could fit through the opening. It looks like a dead end one meter beyond that, but I can sense magical camouflage."

counterexamples.description: Rin asks why jeweled sword made.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Question names weapon made for her.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin asks why jeweled sword made.

contexts.japanese: 「宝石剣。なんで作ってくれたの」
contexts.english: "The Jeweled Sword. Why did you make it for me?"

counterexamples.description: Second sword-projection promise retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He had promised to Project sword.
counterexamples.explanation: Second sword-projection promise retained.

contexts.japanese: ……それに、剣を投影するのは約束だった。
contexts.english: ...Plus, I promised you that I'd Project the sword.

counterexamples.description: Boy still lacks sword-power knowledge.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He says he does not know abilities.
counterexamples.explanation: Boy still lacks sword-power knowledge.

contexts.japanese: あの剣がどんな能力を持っているかは知らないが、セイバーとまともに斬り合うハラらしい。
contexts.english: I don't know what powers that sword has, but she seems to think it'll work in a clash against Saber.

counterexamples.description: Only secret weapon kept for remaining foes.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wants jeweled sword unrevealed against supposed Zouken/Assassin presence.
counterexamples.explanation: Only secret weapon kept for remaining foes.

contexts.japanese: 手の内が判っているセイバーなら、こっちにも対抗策がある。まだ臓硯とアサシンが控えている状況で、唯一“秘密”である宝石剣を使うのは—
contexts.english: I know Saber, so there are ways to deal with her. We shouldn't reveal our only secret weapon while Zouken and Assassin could still be waiting—

counterexamples.description: Superior mana blocks petrification but pressure works.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider cannot petrify Saber due mana superiority yet can weigh her down.
counterexamples.explanation: Superior mana blocks petrification but pressure works.

contexts.japanese: 魔力で上回る彼女を石化する事はできませんが、重圧をかける事はできる。全力でかかれば、二分は拮抗できるでしょう」
contexts.english: I cannot petrify her because her magical energy exceeds mine, but I can weigh her down. I should be able to hold out against her for two minutes at maximum effort."

counterexamples.description: Two-century system retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: System operates for200 years.
counterexamples.explanation: Two-century system retained.

contexts.japanese: そこに、二百年間稼動し続けたシステムが存在する。
contexts.english: Therein lies a system that's been operating for two hundred years.

counterexamples.description: Practical inexhaustibility explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Vortex effectively inexhaustible.
counterexamples.explanation: Practical inexhaustibility explicit.

contexts.japanese: アレは、もう『無尽』とさえ呼べる魔力の渦だ。
contexts.english: It's an effectively inexhaustible vortex of magical energy,

counterexamples.description: Theoretical limit still conceded.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even if finite, human lifetime cannot exhaust it.
counterexamples.explanation: Theoretical limit still conceded.

contexts.japanese: 人間が一生を以ってしても使い切れない魔力は、たとえ限度があろうとも、無尽と称しても間違いではない。
contexts.english: A human could never use it all up in their lifetime, and even if there was a limit to it, it's still correct to call it inexhaustible.

counterexamples.description: Host directs and externalizes curse.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura functions to give curse direction and spill outward.
counterexamples.explanation: Host directs and externalizes curse.

contexts.japanese: “この世全ての悪”という呪い、それを外界に流出させ、指向性を持たせる「機能」が、間桐桜という少女なのである。
contexts.english: She now serves the function of taking the curse of All the Evil in the World, giving it direction and spilling it into the world.

counterexamples.description: Ordinary jewels amplification category.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin's jewels are orthodox backup implements.
counterexamples.explanation: Ordinary jewels amplification category.

contexts.japanese: これはオーソドックスな補助礼装とされ、魔術師ならば一つは保有する魔術品だ。凛の宝石もこの系統に属する。
contexts.english: They are treated as orthodox support Mystic Codes, and any mage owns at least one. Rin's jewels fall into this category.

counterexamples.description: Powered implement executes otherwise impossible magecraft.
counterexamples.sourceReading: User can activate spell they personally cannot reproduce by mana supply.
counterexamples.explanation: Powered implement executes otherwise impossible magecraft.

contexts.japanese: 最大の利点は、魔力さえ流せば使用者が再現できない魔術であろうと実行できる、という事。
contexts.english: Their greatest advantage is that a user can execute magecraft that they personally can't perform, as long as they have magical energy.

counterexamples.description: Reset/cancel ruby retains operation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Dagger cancels magical effects.
counterexamples.explanation: Reset/cancel ruby retains operation.

contexts.japanese: あらゆる魔術効果を初期化する短刀。
contexts.english: or a dagger that cancels out all magical effects.

counterexamples.description: Most Noble Phantasms, not all.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Broad majority belong second category.
counterexamples.explanation: Most Noble Phantasms, not all.

contexts.japanese: サーヴァントの持つ宝具も、大部分はこの系統に属する。
contexts.english: Most Noble Phantasms are classified as Limited Functions.

counterexamples.description: Jeweled sword category still question.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narrator asks which of two types fits sword.
counterexamples.explanation: Jeweled sword category still question.

contexts.japanese: では、凛の持つ宝石剣はどちらなのか。
contexts.english: And which type does Rin's Jeweled Sword fall into?

counterexamples.description: Insufficiency remains Rin's judgment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She doubts weapon works whichever category.
counterexamples.explanation: Insufficiency remains Rin's judgment.

contexts.japanese: そのどちらであろうと、今の間桐桜に通用する武装があるとは思えない。
contexts.english: No matter what it is, she doesn't feel like it'll work against Sakura.

counterexamples.description: More than one absorption mass rises.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Multiple masses rise sequentially.
counterexamples.explanation: More than one absorption mass rises.

contexts.japanese: それは一つだけに留まらず、次々と鎌首をもたげていく。
contexts.english: And not just one—more rear up, one after another.

counterexamples.description: Four shadows retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Four bodies rise as giants.
counterexamples.explanation: Four shadows retained.

contexts.japanese: 湧き上がる影は四身。
contexts.english: Four shadows tower over them.

counterexamples.description: Rin swallowed but outcome not settled.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Overwhelming power swallows Rin, cannot dodge or block.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin swallowed but outcome not settled.

contexts.japanese: 防ぐ事も躱す事もできぬ絶大な力が、遠坂凛を呑み込んだ。
contexts.english: Rin Tohsaka is swallowed by a massive power that can't be dodged or blocked.

counterexamples.description: Six already destroyed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Six shadows down before seventh.
counterexamples.explanation: Six already destroyed.

contexts.japanese: 既に六体。
contexts.english: Six down already.

counterexamples.description: Each giant comparable to Noble Phantasm.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Individual giant has that scale.
counterexamples.explanation: Each giant comparable to Noble Phantasm.

contexts.japanese: 黒身の巨人は、その一体一体がサーヴァントの持つ宝具に匹敵する。
contexts.english: Each of the black giants can rival a Servant's Noble Phantasm.

counterexamples.description: Seventh wiped with one stroke.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Next shadow erased with blade flick.
counterexamples.explanation: Seventh wiped with one stroke.

contexts.japanese: 七体目の影を、短剣の一振りでかき消していた。
contexts.english: She erases the seventh shadow with a flick of the blade.

counterexamples.description: Panic cause still alternative.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Either Sakura panics or behind-entity senses threat.
counterexamples.explanation: Panic cause still alternative.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜の焦りか、それとも、彼女の背後に浮かぶモノが、主の危機を感じ取ったのか。
contexts.english: Is Sakura panicking, or has the thing behind her sensed that she's in danger?

counterexamples.description: Above hundred-million deployed mana.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Amount against one human exceeds100 million.
counterexamples.explanation: Above hundred-million deployed mana.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂凛という、取るに足らない人間一人に対して繰り出された魔力は、数値にして一億を超えていた。
contexts.english: The amount of magical energy brought to bear against a single human, Rin Tohsaka, exceeds one hundred million units if it were to be quantified.

counterexamples.description: Century departmental reserve joke retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Association department could use it for next hundred years.
counterexamples.explanation: Century departmental reserve joke retained.

contexts.japanese: 「—また大盤振舞ね。協会の人間がいたら卒倒するわよ。それだけの貯蔵量があれば、むこう百年は一部門を永続できるってね」
contexts.english: "Another banquet, huh? If anyone from the Association was here, they'd faint. You've got enough resources here to last a department for the next century."

counterexamples.description: No curse dispelling.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin explicitly cannot dispel curses and meets source mana.
counterexamples.explanation: No curse dispelling.

contexts.japanese: わたしは呪いの解呪なんてできない。単に、影を創り上げている貴女の魔力を、わたしの魔力で打ち消しているだけ。そんなの見て判らない？」
contexts.english: I can't dispel curses. I'm only matching the energy you use to create the shadows with my own. Can't you tell by looking?"

counterexamples.description: Resemblance initially Sakura guess.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She notices light looks like something before identification.
counterexamples.explanation: Resemblance initially Sakura guess.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんにはそれだけの魔力はない。いいえ、さっきから何度も放ってる光は、まるで」
contexts.english: You don't have enough power to do that. No, that light you keep blasting is almost like..."

counterexamples.description: Neither Saber copy nor shadow-slaying sword.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin names Zelretch and Tohsaka heirloom after denying both guesses.
counterexamples.explanation: Neither Saber copy nor shadow-slaying sword.

contexts.japanese: 「説明も何もない。これはセイバーの宝剣のコピーでもないし、影殺しの魔剣でもない。これはね、桜。遠坂に伝わる宝石剣で、ゼルレッチって言うの」
contexts.english: "There's no special explanation. This isn't a copy of Saber's sword, nor a magical shadow-slaying blade. This is the Jeweled Sword Zelretch. It's a Tohsaka family heirloom."

counterexamples.description: Third-Magic failure taunt retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Soul acts perpetual engine; she calls it failed Third Magic.
counterexamples.explanation: Third-Magic failure taunt retained.

contexts.japanese: 今の貴女は魂を永久機関にして魔力を生み出す、第三魔法の出来そこない。
contexts.english: Your soul is acting as a perpetual motion engine to produce magical energy; a failed attempt at the Third Magic.

counterexamples.description: Magecraft corrected to Magic.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration corrects term in explanatory question.
counterexamples.explanation: Magecraft corrected to Magic.

contexts.japanese: どのような魔術—いや、魔法を使ったのか。
contexts.english: What magecraft—no, what Magic is she using?

counterexamples.description: Each swing severs arm muscle.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Weapon penalty physically cuts muscles each use.
counterexamples.explanation: Each swing severs arm muscle.

contexts.japanese: 一撃振るう度に腕の筋肉を切断していく、宝石剣からの代償に。
contexts.english: Each time she swings the blade, her arm muscles are severed. It's the price for using the Jeweled Sword.

counterexamples.description: Supply confidence but body doubt.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Stock can match but body endurance uncertain.
counterexamples.explanation: Supply confidence but body doubt.

contexts.japanese: 「っ—貯蔵に関しちゃあ負けないんだけど、わたしの体が何処までもつか、か—」
contexts.english: "Ngh... I've got enough energy stocks to not lose, but how long will my body last...?"

counterexamples.description: Overall disparity still unchanged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration says sisters' original strength difference persists.
counterexamples.explanation: Overall disparity still unchanged.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂凛と間桐桜。二人の戦力差は変わっていない。
contexts.english: The difference in Rin Tohsaka and Sakura Matou's combat strength has not changed.

counterexamples.description: Reservoir versus outlet analogy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Output limited by nozzle size despite water volume.
counterexamples.explanation: Reservoir versus outlet analogy.

contexts.japanese: わかる？　どんなに水があったって、外に出す量は蛇口の大きさに左右される。
contexts.english: Get it? No matter how big a reservoir is, the output of a hose is limited by its nozzle size.

counterexamples.description: Under thousand instant output.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura circuits put out just under1000 at once.
counterexamples.explanation: Under thousand instant output.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜っていう魔術回路の瞬間放出量は一千弱。
contexts.english: Sakura Matou's Magic Circuits can put out just under a thousand units at once.

counterexamples.description: Matching each release, not whole reserve.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin prepares thousand-scale each time instead of Sakura whole stock.
counterexamples.explanation: Matching each release, not whole reserve.

contexts.japanese: 「だから！　わたしが用意するのはアンタと同じ貯蔵量じゃなく、毎回一千程度の魔力でいい……！
contexts.english: "That's why! I don't need to prepare the same amount as you. I only need to prepare the same thousand units of magical energy each time...!

counterexamples.description: Intrinsic Rin energy under hundred.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin has less than100.
counterexamples.explanation: Intrinsic Rin energy under hundred.

contexts.japanese: だが、遠坂凛の魔力は百にも届かない。
contexts.english: But Rin's magical energy numbers less than a hundred.

counterexamples.description: Sword does not amplify her mana.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No personal power amplification.
counterexamples.explanation: Sword does not amplify her mana.

contexts.japanese: それは遠坂凛の魔力を増幅しての事ではない。
contexts.english: It doesn't amplify her own power.

counterexamples.description: Ambient mana loaded into blade.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She gathers mana in cavern and feeds sword.
counterexamples.explanation: Ambient mana loaded into blade.

contexts.japanese: 彼女はただ、この大空洞に満ちる魔力を集め、宝石剣に載せて放っているだけである。
contexts.english: All she's doing is pulling in the mana that fills the cave and feeding it into the Jeweled Sword.

counterexamples.description: Od/Mana distinction explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Individual mage energy versus natural atmospheric energy.
counterexamples.explanation: Od/Mana distinction explicit.

contexts.japanese: 魔術師個人が持つ魔力と、大気に満ちる自然の魔力。
contexts.english: Od is the magical energy that an individual mage possesses, while mana is the natural magical energy in the atmosphere.

counterexamples.description: Single world's atmosphere finite.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Ambient Mana limited.
counterexamples.explanation: Single world's atmosphere finite.

contexts.japanese: 大気の魔力とて有限である。
contexts.english: Atmospheric mana is limited.

counterexamples.description: Another cavern means another use.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Hypothetical second corresponding cave adds one response.
counterexamples.explanation: Another cavern means another use.

contexts.japanese: ここに、もう一つの『大空洞』があるとしたら、対抗できる回数はもう一度だけ増える事になる。
contexts.english: What if there were another cave? Then she could fight back one more time.

counterexamples.description: Mirror places supply unused mana.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Opening corresponding parallel place draws unspent cavern mana.
counterexamples.explanation: Mirror places supply unused mana.

contexts.japanese: 合わせ鏡のように列なる『ここと同じ場所』に穴を開け、そこから、未だ使い切っていない『大空洞の魔力』を引き出せるとしたらどうなるのか。
contexts.english: What if you could open a way to a mirror image of this exact same place, and pull mana from another cavern that hasn't been exhausted?

counterexamples.description: Aperture cannot pass human.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Tiny opening peers to neighboring possibility.
counterexamples.explanation: Aperture cannot pass human.

contexts.japanese: わずかな隙間、人間など通れぬ僅かな穴を開け、隣り合う『違う可能性を持つ』世界を覗く礼装。
contexts.english: It is a Mystic Code that creates the slightest opening, too narrow for a man to pass through, to peer into a neighboring world with different possibilities.

counterexamples.description: Neither amplification nor creation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sword neither amplifies mana nor produces1000 per swing.
counterexamples.explanation: Neither amplification nor creation.

contexts.japanese: そこには魔力を増幅する機能もなく、一撃振るう度に千の魔力を生み出す力もない。
contexts.english: It does not have the power to amplify magical energy, nor create a thousand units of energy with each swing.

counterexamples.description: Drain local then neighbor.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Once this cave exhausted borrow unused neighbor energy.
counterexamples.explanation: Drain local then neighbor.

contexts.japanese: この世界における大空洞の魔力を使い切ったあと、隣り合った世界の大空洞から、まだ使われていない魔力を引き出せばそれでいいのだ。
contexts.english: Once the mana in this world's cave is exhausted, she can just pull unused energy from a neighboring world's cavern.

counterexamples.description: Endless possibilities retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Parallel possibilities unbounded.
counterexamples.explanation: Endless possibilities retained.

contexts.japanese: 並行世界に果てはない。合わせ鏡の可能性は無限なのだ。
contexts.english: There are endless parallel worlds. Infinite mirrored possibilities.

counterexamples.description: Bottomless stock versus recurring supply.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Distinct resource models can sustain equal contest.
counterexamples.explanation: Bottomless stock versus recurring supply.

contexts.japanese: 無尽蔵の貯蔵と、無限に続けられる供給。
contexts.english: A bottomless stockpile versus an infinite supply.

counterexamples.description: Circuit performance makes equivalence.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Equal circuit performance yields practical equality.
counterexamples.explanation: Circuit performance makes equivalence.

contexts.japanese: 魔術回路として性能が互角である以上、二つの事柄はまったくの同位である—！
contexts.english: Since their Magic Circuits perform on an equal level, they stand on equal ground!

counterexamples.description: Excess firepower collapses cave.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Blade surplus gradually damages cavern.
counterexamples.explanation: Excess firepower collapses cave.

contexts.japanese: その余りある火力で、少しずつ大空洞を崩壊へと傾かせている。
contexts.english: The excess firepower is slowly collapsing the cave.

counterexamples.description: Continued battle means Sakura defeat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration states losing implication of prolonged fighting.
counterexamples.explanation: Continued battle means Sakura defeat.

contexts.japanese: このまま徒に戦いを続けては間桐桜の敗北となる。
contexts.english: Continuing this vain battle would mean failure for Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Engraved body becomes suffering tool.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Training directly carves body into implement, greater pain allegedly improves tool.
counterexamples.explanation: Engraved body becomes suffering tool.

contexts.japanese: 体に直接刻んで、ただ魔術を使うだけの道具にしたてあげた。苦痛を与えれば与えるほどいい道具になるって笑うんです」
contexts.english: They carved things into my body and turned me into a tool for using magecraft. They laughed and said that the more I suffered, the better of a tool I'd be."

counterexamples.description: Throws irreplaceable relic lightly.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Weapon tossed as playing catch despite magus inheritance.
counterexamples.explanation: Throws irreplaceable relic lightly.

contexts.japanese: 何物にも替えがたい魔法使いの遺産を、ぽーん、とキャッチボールのように投げて、
contexts.english: She tosses the Magician's irreplaceable relic like she's playing catch.

counterexamples.description: Sword self-destruction erases shadows.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Collapsing miracle blade clears all shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Sword self-destruction erases shadows.

contexts.japanese: 人の手では届かぬ奇跡を体現した宝石の剣は、崩壊の際において全ての影を打ち消していく。
contexts.english: The Jeweled Sword embodying miracles that humans cannot achieve crumbles, erasing all shadow.

counterexamples.description: Another dagger behind back.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Second knife drawn after jeweled weapon sacrificed.
counterexamples.explanation: Another dagger behind back.

contexts.japanese: 走り抜ける中、背中に隠したもう一本の短剣を握り締める。
contexts.english: While running, she grips another knife she was hiding behind her back.

counterexamples.description: Dagger crumbles with Saber disappearance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Both disappearance and blade collapse coincide.
counterexamples.explanation: Dagger crumbles with Saber disappearance.

contexts.japanese: ……セイバーが影になって消えていくのと同時に、手にした短剣が崩れていく。
contexts.english: ...The dagger in my hand began to crumble as soon as Saber disappeared back into the shadows.

counterexamples.description: Azoth fully destroyed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Blade crumbles to dust after all-reserve investment.
counterexamples.explanation: Azoth fully destroyed.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂がありったけの貯蓄を注ぎ込んで作り上げたアゾット剣は、跡形もなく砕け散ってしまった。
contexts.english: The Azoth Blade that Tohsaka put her life savings into has crumbled to dust.

counterexamples.description: One final Projection estimated.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Combined reserves seem usable once, then uncontrollable arm.
counterexamples.explanation: One final Projection estimated.

contexts.japanese: 合わせればまだいけそうだが、投影はあと一度が限界だ。その後は何をしても、アーチャーの腕を抑えきれなくなる。
contexts.english: I think I can manage with that combined power, but I'm limited to one last Projection. I won't be able to control Archer's arm anymore, no matter what I do afterwards.

counterexamples.description: Entity took Sakura in boy's framing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He calls it thing that took Sakura from him.
counterexamples.explanation: Entity took Sakura in boy's framing.

contexts.japanese: 俺から桜をとっていった奴か。
contexts.english: The thing that took Sakura from me.

counterexamples.description: Incarnation nearly underway.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He says entity almost incarnated.
counterexamples.explanation: Incarnation nearly underway.

contexts.japanese: 「—受肉、しかけてる」
contexts.english: "It's almost incarnated..."

counterexamples.description: Complete body needed to emerge.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He judges it cannot exit before complete flesh.
counterexamples.explanation: Complete body needed to emerge.

contexts.japanese: あそこで完全に“肉体”を形成しなければ、ヤツは外に出て来れない。
contexts.english: It can't come out unless its body is fully formed.

counterexamples.description: Contempt becomes clear refusal.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Not-on-my-watch rejects entity's emergence.
counterexamples.explanation: Contempt becomes clear refusal.

contexts.japanese: 「—ふざけろ」
contexts.english: "...Not on my watch."

counterexamples.description: Deeper emergence convulsion.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Squirming giant attempting emergence explains fundamental collapse.
counterexamples.explanation: Deeper emergence convulsion.

contexts.japanese: これはもっと根本的な部分の崩壊であり、あの巨大な影が、外に出ようとする惷動だった。
contexts.english: This is destruction on a more fundamental level. It's the frenzied squirming of that giant shadow attempting to come out.

counterexamples.description: Command Spells visibly bind Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Black whole-body Command Spells bind her.
counterexamples.explanation: Command Spells visibly bind Sakura.

contexts.japanese: あの、全身を覆った黒い令呪が桜を縛っている。
contexts.english: The black Command Spells covering her whole body chain her in place.

counterexamples.description: Entity prevents suicide retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If she attempts to kill herself, shadow won't permit it.
counterexamples.explanation: Entity prevents suicide retained.

contexts.japanese: 桜が自分を殺そうとすれば、影がそれを許さない。
contexts.english: She's trying to kill herself, but the Shadow won't allow it.

counterexamples.description: All remaining mana spent on one replication.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou's remaining energy entirely poured into copy.
counterexamples.explanation: All remaining mana spent on one replication.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎に残った魔力を、全てその複製に注ぎ込む。
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya devotes all of his remaining magical energy into its replication.

counterexamples.description: Contract-breaking dagger function retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Raises final projected contract-breaking dagger.
counterexamples.explanation: Contract-breaking dagger function retained.

contexts.japanese: 契約破りの短剣を振り上げる。
contexts.english: I raise a dagger of contract-breaking.

counterexamples.description: Heart stab apparent lethality retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: One breath thrust into her heart.
counterexamples.explanation: Heart stab apparent lethality retained.

contexts.japanese: 一息で、彼女の心臓を突き刺した。
contexts.english: In a breath, I stab her in the heart.

counterexamples.description: Distinct pursuit durations retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Einzbern thousand years versus Makiri five hundred.
counterexamples.explanation: Distinct pursuit durations retained.

contexts.japanese: 千年をかけたアインツベルンの探求。
contexts.english: The Einzberns' thousand-year quest.

contexts.japanese: 五百年をかけたマキリの悲願。
contexts.english: The Makiris' five-hundred-year wish.

counterexamples.description: Destroyed soul anchor and obsession sustain temporary survival.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Crushed main body anchors soul, obsession keeps mage here.
counterexamples.explanation: Destroyed soul anchor and obsession sustain temporary survival.

contexts.japanese: マキリ臓硯。魂をこの世に留める本体を潰された老魔術師は、その執念だけでこの世界に残留していた。
contexts.english: Zouken Makiri. The old mage, his main body anchoring his soul having been crushed, clings to this world by his obsession alone.

counterexamples.description: Foreign-law decline explanation rejected.
counterexamples.sourceReading: First recalls external cause then says it is wrong.
counterexamples.explanation: Foreign-law decline explanation rejected.

contexts.japanese: —だが、それは違う。
contexts.english: But that wasn't true.

counterexamples.description: Decline already in Zouken's generation retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Mage line already declining in his own generation.
counterexamples.explanation: Decline already in Zouken's generation retained.

contexts.japanese: マキリという魔術師は、臓硯の代で既に衰退していた。
contexts.english: The Makiri mages were already in decline by Zouken's generation.

counterexamples.description: Former comrade's self-sacrifice and Heaven's Cup retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Two hundred years earlier she sacrificed herself to build Greater Grail.
counterexamples.explanation: Former comrade's self-sacrifice and Heaven's Cup retained.

contexts.japanese: 大聖杯を築き上げる為、自ら生贄となった、天の杯であった我が同胞。
contexts.english: She was his comrade—the Cup of Heaven who sacrificed herself to build the Greater Grail.

counterexamples.description: Finite body versus infinite soul retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Surpass finite flesh for unlimited soul.
counterexamples.explanation: Finite body versus infinite soul retained.

contexts.japanese: 肉体という有限を超え、魂という無限に至る。
contexts.english: He would surpass the limits of the flesh and reach the limitlessness of the soul.

counterexamples.description: Human transformation rather than building new world retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Change himself/human life into new rather than create new world.
counterexamples.explanation: Human transformation rather than building new world retained.

contexts.japanese: 新しい世界を作るのではなく、自身を、人という命を新しいものに変えるのだと。
contexts.english: Not to create a new world, but to turn himself, to turn the life called humanity into something new.

counterexamples.description: Original abolition of all evil retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Founders stake lives for elimination of world's evil.
counterexamples.explanation: Original abolition of all evil retained.

contexts.japanese: この世、全ての悪の廃絶の為。
contexts.english: The abolition of all the evil in the world.

counterexamples.description: Third Magic/Angra Mainyu layers both retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Written Third Magic, ruby Angra Mainyu, judged an error.
counterexamples.explanation: Third Magic/Angra Mainyu layers both retained.

contexts.japanese: 生み出された、間違いでしかない“第三魔法”は、陽炎のように揺らめいている。
contexts.english: Aŋra Mainiiu, the birthed, completely flawed embodiment of the Third Magic is flickering like heat haze.

counterexamples.description: Maturation of humanity with thousand/ten-thousand horizon retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Remote human-species growth beyond private five-century life.
counterexamples.explanation: Maturation of humanity with thousand/ten-thousand horizon retained.

contexts.japanese: これより幾星霜の時間を超え、千の年月、万の年月の末に手に入れる、人間という種の成長だ。
contexts.english: the maturation of humanity, whether it takes thousands or tens of thousands of years.

counterexamples.description: Only one of two endings grand finale.
counterexamples.sourceReading: One of two is work's true ending.
counterexamples.explanation: Only one of two endings grand finale.

contexts.japanese: このどちらかがグランドフィナーレ、
contexts.english: One of them is the grand finale

contexts.japanese: 『Fate/stay night』の真のエンディングです。
contexts.english: and the true ending to Fate/stay night.

counterexamples.description: Rin qualifies original confidence.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Maybe defeating Zouken won't erase shadow; maybe end war won't either.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin qualifies original confidence.

contexts.japanese: 臓硯を倒してもあの影は消えないかもしれない。
contexts.english: Maybe it won't disappear even if we defeat Zouken.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯戦争が終わってもあの影は消えないかもしれない。
contexts.english: Maybe it won't disappear even if the Holy Grail War ends.

counterexamples.description: Own power rather than uncertain Grail reliance retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Can't rely on Grail may not obtain, must beat both by own resources.
counterexamples.explanation: Own power rather than uncertain Grail reliance retained.

contexts.japanese: だから今は一番確実な方法をとる。手に入るかどうかも分からない聖杯なんかには頼れない。わたしたちはわたしたちだけの力で、臓硯とあの影を倒さないといけない」
contexts.english: But I'm going to take the surest method I know. We can't depend on a Holy Grail that we're not even sure we'll obtain. We have to do everything within our own power to defeat Zouken and the Shadow."

counterexamples.description: Mystic Eyes analogy and knowledge limit retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks imitation concerns Mystic Eyes but as far knows Rin lacks them.
counterexamples.explanation: Mystic Eyes analogy and knowledge limit retained.

contexts.japanese: ライダーの真似事というと魔眼の真似事というコトだが、知っているかぎり遠坂は魔眼持ちじゃない。
contexts.english: She must be talking about Rider's Mystic Eyes, but as far as I know, Tohsaka doesn't have Mystic Eyes of her own.

counterexamples.description: Improvised suggestion merely proposed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She might improvise sleep suggestion but can't Rider feat.
counterexamples.explanation: Improvised suggestion merely proposed.

contexts.japanese: 「正解。今まで興味はなかったけど、魔眼も悪くないかなって。流石にあんな離れ業は無理だけど、眠りの暗示ぐらいなら即興で出来そうだなって」
contexts.english: "That's right. I wasn't really interested in them before, but Mystic Eyes don't seem so bad. I can't get on her level, obviously, but I might be able to improvise and hypnotize you to sleep."

counterexamples.description: Too-effective spell could paralyze instead of sleep.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If works excessively effect becomes paralysis.
counterexamples.explanation: Too-effective spell could paralyze instead of sleep.

contexts.japanese: 「あ、そうか。うまくかかりすぎたら睡眠じゃなくて麻痺になるものね。士郎、単純だからかかりやすそうだし」
contexts.english: "Oh, right. If it goes too well, I might paralyze you instead of just putting you to sleep. You haven't got much of a resistance after all."

counterexamples.description: Appearing corrected to opening Grail.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Strictly war-end means Grail opens.
counterexamples.explanation: Appearing corrected to opening Grail.

contexts.japanese: いや、厳密に言えば聖杯が“開かれる”。
contexts.english: To be more precise, it will open.

counterexamples.description: Gate/contents theory remains conditional.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If Zouken's gate explanation true, asks Sakura fate.
counterexamples.explanation: Gate/contents theory remains conditional.

contexts.japanese: ……それが確かなら、聖杯である桜はどうなるのか。
contexts.english: ...IF that's true, then what will happen to Sakura, who's a Holy Grail?

counterexamples.description: Automatic appearance versus last-Master summoning unresolved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He doesn't know which process applies.
counterexamples.explanation: Automatic appearance versus last-Master summoning unresolved.

contexts.japanese: マスターが最後の一人になった時点で現れるものなのか、最後の一人になったマスターが召喚するものなのか。
contexts.english: It might show up once only one Master is left, or it might need the last Master to summon it.

contexts.japanese: ……これが後者なら問題はない。
contexts.english: ...If it's the latter, that won't be a problem.

counterexamples.description: Waiting leaves shadow casualties retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Waiting deadline means leaving shadow unattended.
counterexamples.explanation: Waiting leaves shadow casualties retained.

contexts.japanese: 戦いの期限切れを待つ、という事はあの影を放置する、という事。
contexts.english: Waiting the war out would mean allowing the Shadow to keep killing.

counterexamples.description: No death-concept hypothesis conditional.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If contents overflow, shadow probably lacks death concept.
counterexamples.explanation: No death-concept hypothesis conditional.

contexts.japanese: アレが聖杯の中からこぼれてくるモノだとしたら、影自体には死の概念はないだろう。
contexts.english: If it's something that spilled out of the Holy Grail, then the Shadow itself probably has no concept of death.

counterexamples.description: Fellow Grail sensing remains uncertain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy asks whether same vessel nature allows sensing condition.
counterexamples.explanation: Fellow Grail sensing remains uncertain.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂とは違う諦め。……同じ聖杯だからこそ、イリヤには桜がどんな状態なのか感じ取れるのか。
contexts.english: Her resignation is different than Tohsaka's. Maybe she can feel exactly what Sakura's going through, as a fellow Holy Grail.

counterexamples.description: Sakura's technique inferior but intuition equal.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Below Rin in skill, same class intuitive talent.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura's technique inferior but intuition equal.

contexts.japanese: 「トオサカリン。次があるのなら、もっと出来のいい監視役を仕掛けなさい。翡翠の鳥程度の使い魔ではサクラは欺けない。技量でこそ貴女には及びませんが、直感という才能は貴女と同格なのですから」
contexts.english: "Rin Tohsaka. If there is a next time, you should set a better lookout. A kingfisher familiar cannot fool Sakura. She may not be your equal in skill, but her instincts are just as sharp."

counterexamples.description: Monitoring insects destroyed, voice soon lost.
counterexamples.sourceReading: All left bugs crushed, channel will soon stop.
counterexamples.explanation: Monitoring insects destroyed, voice soon lost.

contexts.japanese: 『おお、これは怖い。監視役にと残した蟲どもが軒並み潰れおったわ。はは、これではすぐに声すら届かなくなるな』
contexts.english: "Oh, how fearsome. You've crushed all the bugs I left there to monitor the room. Haha, soon, my voice won't be able to reach you."

counterexamples.description: Only remote familiars, mage never there.
counterexamples.sourceReading: House contains limb-like insects, no actual mage from outset.
counterexamples.explanation: Only remote familiars, mage never there.

contexts.japanese: 始めからこの建物にはいなかった。
contexts.english: He was never in the building to begin with.

contexts.japanese: ヤツは蟲使いだ、この屋敷にいたのは手足となる蟲だけだった……！
contexts.english: He's an insect-user, so there's nothing here except for his bug familiars...!

counterexamples.description: Ritual sites retain ordered four-stage history.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Temple, Tohsaka house, hill church, burned field; fifth first again.
counterexamples.explanation: Ritual sites retain ordered four-stage history.

contexts.japanese: 一度目は柳洞寺。
contexts.english: The first was Ryudou Temple.

contexts.japanese: 二度目は遠坂邸。
contexts.english: The second was the Tohsaka house.

contexts.japanese: 三度目は丘の教会。
contexts.english: The third was the church on the hill.

contexts.japanese: 四度目はあの焼け野原。
contexts.english: The fourth was that burned field.

contexts.japanese: となれば、今回の降霊は一度目の土地に戻る。
contexts.english: And this time, it will return to the land it first appeared in.

counterexamples.description: Future calamity contrasted with founders' wish.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Coming thing catastrophe remote from intended miracle.
counterexamples.explanation: Future calamity contrasted with founders' wish.

contexts.japanese: これから起きること、これから生まれるものは彼らが望んだものとはかけ離れた“災厄”である。
contexts.english: Whatever happens next, whatever will soon be born, will be a catastrophe far removed from what they desired.

counterexamples.description: Assigned opening role distinguished from closing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No one tasked her closing gate.
counterexamples.explanation: Assigned opening role distinguished from closing.

contexts.japanese: 「……放っておけばいい。わたしの役目は開ける事だもの。閉じろなんてコト、誰もわたしに言わなかった」
contexts.english: "...I should leave it alone. My job is only to open the way. No one told me to close it."

counterexamples.description: Other gate and superior Sakura restrict interference.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Einzbern Grail can't affect different Makiri-opened gate.
counterexamples.explanation: Other gate and superior Sakura restrict interference.

contexts.japanese: マキリの聖杯が開いた門は、アインツベルンの聖杯では手が出せない。
contexts.english: The Einzbern Grail cannot interfere with the gate that the Makiri Grail has opened.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯は同じモノを開いたつもりで違うモノを開いたのだ。
contexts.english: Zouken Matou meant to open the same thing, but he opened something different.

counterexamples.description: Barrier classification remains unanswered alternative.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Slipped through versus not counted as intruder.
counterexamples.explanation: Barrier classification remains unanswered alternative.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮邸に張られた結界をすり抜けたのか、それとも結界は彼女を“侵入者”とみなさなかったのか。
contexts.english: Did it infiltrate the Bounded Field around the home, or did the barrier fail to identify her as an intruder?

counterexamples.description: Sakura magecraft distinct from independent shadow.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin realizes tentacles her own techniques, not simply black shadow's attack.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura magecraft distinct from independent shadow.

contexts.japanese: それが“黒い影”による物ではなく、間桐桜が保有する“魔術”なのだと凛は悟る。
contexts.english: Rin realizes that this isn't coming from the Shadow, but from Sakura's own magecraft.

counterexamples.description: Two aptitudes enable manifestation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Matou binding plus original shadow element.
counterexamples.explanation: Two aptitudes enable manifestation.

contexts.japanese: その二つの属性を持つ間桐桜だからこそ、あの“黒い影”をあそこまで具現化できる—！
contexts.english: She can manifest the Shadow to this extent because of her two alignments!

counterexamples.description: Reserve disparity preserves roughly300 versus100million.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin reserve300, Sakura hundred-million bottomless monster perspective.
counterexamples.explanation: Reserve disparity preserves roughly300 versus100million.

contexts.japanese: 貯蔵量が三百ほどの凛から見れば、今の桜は底なしの“怪物”だった。
contexts.english: From the perspective of Rin's three hundred units, Sakura is a monster with a bottomless reserve.

counterexamples.description: Equal-source hypothetical not finished solution.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If equal mana supply fight differs, not ready.
counterexamples.explanation: Equal-source hypothetical not finished solution.

contexts.japanese: 仮に、今の桜—つまり聖杯と同位の魔力の供給源があれば話は違うのだが、そんなものは出来ていない。
contexts.english: It would be a different story if she had a power source on par with Sakura—the Holy Grail itself—but she doesn't.

counterexamples.description: Worm reduction doesn't disable other monitoring.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest reduced worms, merely insurance; different means tracks heartbeat.
counterexamples.explanation: Worm reduction doesn't disable other monitoring.

contexts.japanese: あの神父の治療で体内の刻印虫が減っていようと関係ない。
contexts.english: It doesn't matter that the priest reduced the number of worms in my body.

contexts.japanese: ……だって、あんなものはただの保険だ。
contexts.english: ...They were just insurance.

contexts.japanese: いまのわたしの体調。心拍音すら聴いている。
contexts.english: Of knowing my physical condition. He's even listening to my heartbeat.

counterexamples.description: Not lie yet not whole truth.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken explanation partial, power originally colorless.
counterexamples.explanation: Not lie yet not whole truth.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだな。臓硯の説明に嘘はなかろう。だが真実も語ってはいない。
contexts.english: "Yes. Zouken's explanation was not false. But he also has not told you the entire truth.

counterexamples.description: Directionless power disperses rather than attacks.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Colorless lacks purpose, not self-attacks.
counterexamples.explanation: Directionless power disperses rather than attacks.

contexts.japanese: 無色である以上、自分から人を襲う、などという事はない。目的のない力は、目的のないまま霧散するものだろう」
contexts.english: Because it lacks any color or will, it would never do anything such as attacking people on its own. Power without direction simply disperses without anything to focus it."

counterexamples.description: Contamination doesn't remove wish function.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Still wish engine, result ethics distorted.
counterexamples.explanation: Contamination doesn't remove wish function.

contexts.japanese: 願望機としての機能は損なわれていない。
contexts.english: It has not lost its function as a wish-granter.

counterexamples.description: Gate/opening dual layer retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Grail gate with hole/opening ruby.
counterexamples.explanation: Gate/opening dual layer retained.

contexts.japanese: 「そう、聖杯という門だ。
contexts.english: "The opening, the gate which we call the Holy Grail.

counterexamples.description: Third-ritual origin remains likely.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Most likely forbidden Einzbern summoning caused impurity.
counterexamples.explanation: Third-ritual origin remains likely.

contexts.japanese: 「おそらくな。三度目の儀式のおり、アインツベルンは喚んではならぬモノを召喚した。その結果、彼らが用意した聖杯戦争という儀式に不純物が混入した。
contexts.english: "Most likely. During the third ritual, the Einzberns summoned something forbidden. In doing so, they introduced an impurity into their Holy Grail.

counterexamples.description: Fifty-year waiting with failed emergence.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Third to fourth50years awaiting birth, couldn't emerge.
counterexamples.explanation: Fifty-year waiting with failed emergence.

contexts.japanese: 三度目から四度目の間。五十年の歳月をかけて聖杯の中で出産を待った不純物は、しかし外界に出る事は叶わなかった」
contexts.english: For the fifty years between the third and fourth wars, that impurity awaited its birth in the Holy Grail. But it was never allowed to emerge."

counterexamples.description: Incomplete Grail nevertheless gate opens then destroyed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber/Archer remain, expired ritual incomplete; gate promptly destroyed.
counterexamples.explanation: Incomplete Grail nevertheless gate opens then destroyed.

contexts.japanese: 前回はセイバーとアーチャーが残ったまま期限を迎え、聖杯は完成しなかった。門こそ開いたものの、それは即座に切嗣によって破壊された」
contexts.english: While it was still incomplete, time ran out while Saber and Archer were still intact. Then, Kiritsugu destroyed the gate as soon as it opened."

counterexamples.description: Not person, directed pure power.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Tainted still power vortex with orientation.
counterexamples.explanation: Not person, directed pure power.

contexts.japanese: 黒く染まろうと聖杯の中身は純粋な“力”の渦にすぎない。中にあるものは方向性を持った魔力だ。
contexts.english: The contents of the Holy Grail are still pure power, even if it is tainted. It is magical energy with an orientation.

counterexamples.description: Still unborn and manifestation depends on Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Unborn child cannot cast shadow without her.
counterexamples.explanation: Still unborn and manifestation depends on Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 「それが聖杯の中にいる現象—夜に徘徊する影の本体だ。まだ生まれておらず、間桐桜がいなければ影さえ落とせない“出産予定児”にすぎないが」
contexts.english: "That is the identity of the phenomenon within the Holy Grail, the Shadow, which roams at night. It is an unborn fetus which would not even cast a shadow if not for Sakura Matou."

counterexamples.description: Proper-vessel delivery contrasted with special Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If normal correct Grail body would release entity; she special.
counterexamples.explanation: Proper-vessel delivery contrasted with special Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 「いいや。間桐桜が正しく作られた聖杯ならば、たしかに彼女の肉体からソレは現れるだろう。
contexts.english: "No, no. If Sakura Matou had been a properly constructed Holy Grail, her body would give birth to it.

counterexamples.description: Power inheritance permits existence without ordinary flesh.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Give own force to Sakura to become from nothing.
counterexamples.explanation: Power inheritance permits existence without ordinary flesh.

contexts.japanese: 「己が誕生。無から有に至るため、彼女に自身の力を受け渡す事で、この世に存在まれようとしているのだ。
contexts.english: "In passing its own power to Sakura, it is trying to exist in this world. It is attempting to make its own birth happen, to become something from nothing.

counterexamples.description: Shadow already Sakura, not only spill.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Explicitly she herself now shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Shadow already Sakura, not only spill.

contexts.japanese: アレは既に間桐桜そのものだ。
contexts.english: It is already Sakura Matou herself.

counterexamples.description: Alternative amorphous vessels remain hypothetical.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Gold/bronze alternatives would lack form, might proliferate flesh.
counterexamples.explanation: Alternative amorphous vessels remain hypothetical.

contexts.japanese: 通常の聖杯……アインツベルン製の黄金や、魔術師の肉体を使った青銅の聖杯ならば象にはならず、不確かなカタチになっていただろう。なにしろ質量を持つほどの呪いだ。場合によっては、ただ増殖するだけの肉の塊になるやもしれん」
contexts.english: With a normal Holy Grail, such as one made out of the Einzberns' gold or a bronze chalice using a mage's body, it would have remained amorphous and indefinite. It is a bundle of curses potent enough to have actual mass. Under some circumstances, it might have multiplied into a great lump of flesh."

counterexamples.description: Rational resistance limits entity via her command.
counterexamples.sourceReading: While closes gate, resides within cannot emerge fully.
counterexamples.explanation: Rational resistance limits entity via her command.

contexts.japanese: いかに呪いが間桐桜を汚染しようと、命令権は彼女にある。彼女が聖杯として門を閉じようとするかぎり、中のモノは間桐桜に宿るだけで、完全には外に出られない」
contexts.english: No matter how tainted she is by the curse, she is in command. As long as she tries to keep the gate closed, it will continue to stay within her and cannot completely emerge."

counterexamples.description: Master–Servant analogy explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Curse servant can't overturn Sakura mastery.
counterexamples.explanation: Master–Servant analogy explicit.

contexts.japanese: 「マスターとサーヴァントの関係と同じだ。
contexts.english: "It is like the relationship between Master and Servant.

counterexamples.description: Different born thing is Kirei's distinction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Current shadow modeled on host, future something different.
counterexamples.explanation: Different born thing is Kirei's distinction.

contexts.japanese: 「それが間違いだ。あの影は間桐桜という依り代から象った影にすぎん。聖杯より生まれ出ようとするものはアレとは違う何かだ。
contexts.english: "You are mistaken. The Shadow you speak of is a shade modeled after its host, Sakura Matou. It is a separate entity from the thing which wishes to be born from the Holy Grail.

counterexamples.description: Crest worms and inhabiting thing both purge targets.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kill both using corrupted killing-power itself.
counterexamples.explanation: Crest worms and inhabiting thing both purge targets.

contexts.japanese: 要は力ずくだ。間桐桜を聖杯に仕立て上げる刻印虫も、彼女の肉体を依り代にするモノも、聖杯の力で『殺して』しまえばよい。
contexts.english: It is a brute-force approach. One need merely use the power of the Holy Grail to kill the Crest Worms upon which her Grail was built, and the thing inhabiting her body.

counterexamples.description: Soul anchor and purification alternatives retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Find main body or purify soul for full destruction.
counterexamples.explanation: Soul anchor and purification alternatives retained.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯はある意味不老不死だ。魂を世に留めている手のひらほどの本体を探し出すか、魂そのものを浄化させなければ完全には滅ぼせん」
contexts.english: He is immortal, in a way. He will never completely disappear unless you find the main body which anchors his soul, or cleanse his soul itself."

counterexamples.description: Defeat Zouken then winner/control/purge sequence.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Outlined policy tentative, must gain/control engine.
counterexamples.explanation: Defeat Zouken then winner/control/purge sequence.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯を倒し、間桐桜を勝者にする。その後に現れる聖杯を制御し、間桐桜の身体を洗浄する。方針としてはそんなところか」
contexts.english: Your next steps are to defeat Zouken Matou and make Sakura Matou the victor. Then, control the Holy Grail once it appears and use it to cleanse Sakura Matou's body."

counterexamples.description: Own standing shadow identified.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her sunlit shadow stands/sways behind killing.
counterexamples.explanation: Own standing shadow identified.

contexts.japanese: 陽に当たる自分の影が、のっぺりと立ち上がって揺らめいている。
contexts.english: Her own sunlit shadow smoothly rises, quivering and swaying.

counterexamples.description: Night killings recognized as own acts.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Dream not dream, herself killing men who approached nightly.
counterexamples.explanation: Night killings recognized as own acts.

contexts.japanese: 夜な夜な街を徘徊して、いい寄る男の人たちを殺していたのは、紛れもなく自分自身。
contexts.english: The person that goes out every night and kills all the men who approach her is none other than herself.

counterexamples.description: Even a non-mage can recognize abnormality.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The energy is palpable; recognizing something wrong doesn't require being a mage.
counterexamples.explanation: Even a non-mage can recognize abnormality.

contexts.japanese: そんなもの、魔術師でなくとも異常を感じ取れる。
contexts.english: You don't need to be a mage to know that something's wrong.

counterexamples.description: Liquid-rubber obstacle and rapid restoration survive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Mud cannot be gripped properly and immediately returns after peeling.
counterexamples.explanation: Liquid-rubber obstacle and rapid restoration survive.

contexts.japanese: 掴んでも掴めないし、剥がしてもすぐさま元に戻ってしまう……！
contexts.english: I can't get a decent handhold on it, and it bounces back as soon as I tear it off...!

counterexamples.description: Only Sakura dispels shadow, inadequate skill risks absorption.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She claims sole dispelling power and Shirou's skill insufficient against her shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Only Sakura dispels shadow, inadequate skill risks absorption.

contexts.japanese: 「—無駄ですよ先輩。わたしの影はわたししか解呪できない。先輩程度の技量じゃ逆に取り込まれてしまいます」
contexts.english: "It's no use, Senpai. Only I can dispel my own shadow. With your skill level, it'll only consume you, instead."

counterexamples.description: Unfamiliar Command Spell identification remains qualified.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Looks unlike conventional seal but he identifies it as Command Spell.
counterexamples.explanation: Unfamiliar Command Spell identification remains qualified.

contexts.japanese: あれは—とてもそうは見えないが、令呪だ。
contexts.english: It doesn't look like it at all, but that's...a Command Spell.

counterexamples.description: Unexpected intake makes further Servants unnecessary but Rider threatened anyway.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura says she absorbed unexpected something and no longer needs Servants.
counterexamples.explanation: Unexpected intake makes further Servants unnecessary but Rider threatened anyway.

contexts.japanese: なら、貴女も取り込みます。予定外のモノを摂ったから、これ以上サーヴァントは要らないのだけど—
contexts.english: Then I'll take you, too. I ate something I didn't expect earlier, so I don't need any more Servants...

contexts.japanese: 貴女は、特別にセイバーと同じにしてあげる」
contexts.english: But I'll do to you what I did to Saber."

counterexamples.description: Further absorption creates no-return threshold.
counterexamples.sourceReading: More intake would make return impossible.
counterexamples.explanation: Further absorption creates no-return threshold.

contexts.japanese: —貴女、これ以上取り込むと戻れなくなるから」
contexts.english: There's no going back if you swallow anything else."

counterexamples.description: Sakura needs only Illya's heart, not necessarily her living company.
counterexamples.sourceReading: All she wants is heart, with accompanying implying acceptance of being killed.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura needs only Illya's heart, not necessarily her living company.

contexts.japanese: 「正気ですか？　わたしが欲しいのは貴女の心臓だけ。
contexts.english: "Are you insane? All I want is your heart.

contexts.japanese: わたしと来る、という事は殺されても構わない、という事です」
contexts.english: You're saying that you don't mind me killing you."

counterexamples.description: Rin's covering recedes with courtyard shadow.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Both general shadow and Rin-covering mud fade as if never there.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's covering recedes with courtyard shadow.

contexts.japanese: 中庭に満ちた影だけでなく、遠坂を覆っていた泥も、初めから存在しなかったかのように薄れていく。
contexts.english: Even the mud covering Tohsaka fades away as if it was never there.

counterexamples.description: Saber's claimed salvation can include Sakura's death.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Grail only liberation; even resulting death she is saved.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber's claimed salvation can include Sakura's death.

contexts.japanese: その結果が彼女の死であったとしても、それで間桐桜は救われる」
contexts.english: She will be saved, even if she dies as a result."

contexts.japanese: 「……これは最後の忠告だ。どのような形であろうと、桜は聖杯を手に入れる。それだけが桜を解放する手段だ。
contexts.english: "...This is my last warning. One way or another, Sakura will obtain the Holy Grail. It is the only way to set her free.

counterexamples.description: Saber exception to other Servants is explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Different from us; no interest human nourishment and customs unsuitable.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber exception to other Servants is explicit.

contexts.japanese: 「彼女は私たちとは別です。私は人間としての栄養摂取に興味はありませんし、それに—貴方たちの作法は、私には合いません」
contexts.english: "She is different from the rest of us. I have no interest in human nutrition, and to begin with...your way of eating is not suited to me."

counterexamples.description: Gaze activation remains supposition.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken implanted worms so probably could activate by looking alone.
counterexamples.explanation: Gaze activation remains supposition.

contexts.japanese: が、刻印虫を仕掛けた術者である臓硯なら、それこそ桜を見るだけで虫どもを動かせるだろう。
contexts.english: but Zouken was the one who implanted the Crest Worms, so he can probably activate them again just by looking at her.

counterexamples.description: Four remaining Masters and Sakura winner plan survive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He will make Sakura win among four, then use Grail.
counterexamples.explanation: Four remaining Masters and Sakura winner plan survive.

contexts.japanese: ……残ったマスターは四人。俺はこの中から桜を勝たせて、桜に聖杯を使ってもらう」
contexts.english: ...There are four Masters left. I'm going to make sure that you're the one who wins, and then we'll have you use the Holy Grail."

counterexamples.description: Failed Grail rescue can leave Rin with stronger means to kill.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If even Grail can't save, gets stronger-than-Archer ally and ends Sakura life.
counterexamples.explanation: Failed Grail rescue can leave Rin with stronger means to kill.

contexts.japanese: もし聖杯でも桜が助からないとなったら、あいつは聖杯っていうアーチャー以上の味方を得て、桜の命を止めるだろう。
contexts.english: If it turns out that even the Holy Grail can't save Sakura, she'll have gained a weapon even more powerful than Archer that she can use to end Sakura's life.

counterexamples.description: Suppressing power cannot easily exclude target.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even saving magical energy can't make him non-target.
counterexamples.explanation: Suppressing power cannot easily exclude target.

contexts.japanese: 私本人が魔力をセーブしたところで、貴方を対象外にするのは難しい」
contexts.english: Even if I conserve my magical energy, it would be difficult to stop them from affecting you."
